Walmart’s own help documentation, gathered into one document

2026-08-02

Walmart Help Guide

This guide gathers Walmart’s own help documentation, as it stood on 2 August 2026.

The arrangement is Walmart’s own. Its articles carry no category inside them – the breadcrumb on each one says only that it is a help article – so the categories here are the twelve topics Walmart groups them under on its own help home page.

A word about what a retail help centre contains. A large part of this is legal terms rather than instructions: guarantee conditions, policies, terms of use, and the same guarantee written out separately for different states. Those are kept, under Walmart’s own Terms of Use and Policies headings rather than scattered through the guide, so that the how-to material stays findable. If you are looking for how something works rather than what the contract says, the topics to read are Your Order, Returns & Refunds, Account & Payments and Shopping with Walmart.

What is not here. The shop itself. walmart.com is a catalogue of millions of pages and this guide is fenced to the help centre; there are no products, prices or listings in it.

This document holds 12 categories, 173 articles and about 150,820 words.

Account & Payments

Account Security and Unrecognized Charges or Orders

Account Security

Be careful not to open suspicious emails and avoid clicking any links inside a suspicious email. 

  • See our tips for cybersecurity on the Stay Secure Online-Cybersecurity Hygiene page.

Unrecognized Charges or Orders

If you see a Walmart.com charge on your card, but you don’t recognize it as yours, your card may be compromised. Select the Chat with us button to get help right away. When prompted, type Unauthorized Charges in the chat window.

What do I need to do when a charge or order is unrecognized? 

  • Contact your bank or credit card company to let them know about the unauthorized use and dispute any charges. Your financial institution is always the best place to turn to recover those funds.
  • Reset your password immediately.
  • Delete any saved payment information.
  • If you use the same email address and password for accounts outside of Walmart.com, change your passwords for those accounts as well.

We understand you would want to take every measure possible to protect your information. If you want to close your account and start over, see How to Delete Your Account for step-by-step instructions.

CareCredit Card FAQs

What can I purchase with my CareCredit credit card at Walmart.com?

Your CareCredit credit card can be used to pay for health, wellness and personal care items.

  • Pharmacy
  • Over-the-Counter (OTC) Medications
  • Durable Medical Equipment (DME)
  • Health and Beauty Aids (HBA)
  • Baby Care
  • Fitness
  • Sleep

Please go to CareCredit.com/Walmart for a more extensive list of approved items.

What if I have items in my basket that are not health and wellness?

At checkout, once all items are in your basket, use your CareCredit credit card first. Qualifying health and wellness items will be automatically charged to your CareCredit credit card. You will then be prompted to use another payment method to purchase your remaining items.

The card is not working; the transaction is not going through or I do not know my CareCredit card account number. What should I do?

Call CareCredit Customer Service at (866) 893-7864 and speak with one of our Customer Service representatives.

What happens if I purchase something from Walmart.com with my CareCredit credit card and need to return the item?

Refunds or returns at Walmart.com will follow the standard Walmart Policies and will be credited to the CareCredit credit card account that was used for the sales transaction. The card that was used in the transaction will need to be present.

Can I pay my CareCredit bill within a Walmart location?

No, all CareCredit payments must be made directly to Synchrony Bank.

Question Is promotional financing available on purchases at Walmart.com?

Promotional financing is not available at this time.

Changes to the Country/Region Setting in Your Account

We may use your country/region selection to determine which programs, services, and functionality are appropriate for your location.

Walmart+ is not available outside of the U.S. If you are a Walmart+ member, your membership will end immediately.

Visit the Privacy Notice for more details.

Please see below for details on how changing your country or region will affect the services.

From USA to Mexico/Canada (including Quebec)

If you plan to change your country/region setting from the United States to Mexico or Canada (including Quebec), please note that the following features will be disabled as a result of this change:

  • Access to new or existing Registries.
  • Use of the Walmart mobile application.
  • Pharmacy access.
  • Walmart+ (If you have a current membership, it will be canceled).
  • Marketing related emails.
    • Please note that you will still receive emails about your orders.

From Mexico/Canada (including Quebec) to USA

If you plan to change your country/region setting from Mexico or Canada (including Quebec) to the United States, please note that the following features will be enabled as a result of this change:

  • Access to new or existing Registries.
  • Use of the Walmart mobile application.
  • Pharmacy access.
  • Walmart+.
  • Marketing related emails.

Between Mexico and Canada (including Quebec)

If you plan to change your country/region setting between Mexico and Canada (including Quebec), please note that there will be no changes to your access to other services. However, the following features will remain disabled as a result of this change:

  • Access to new or existing Registries.
  • Use of the Walmart mobile application.
  • Pharmacy access.
  • Walmart+ (If you have a current membership, it will be canceled).
  • Marketing related emails.
    • Please note that you will still receive emails about your orders.

Create or Edit an Account

Creating and editing an account on Walmart is easy! 

Why create a Walmart account? 

A Walmart account makes shopping easier and more convenient. You can track and manage your orders, save addresses for faster checkout, access your cart across multiple devices, view your order history and digital receipts, and start eligible returns more easily. Having an account also helps Customer Care better assist you with your online orders when needed. 

Create a Walmart.com account

  1. Select Account.
  2. Select Sign in or create account.
  3. Enter your Email Address or Mobile Phone Number and select Continue.
    • If we recognize your email address or mobile phone number you’ll be directed to sign in.
    • If we don’t recognize your email address or mobile phone number we’ll direct you to create an account.
  4. On the Create Your Walmart Account page you’ll be asked to provide First Name, Last Name, email address, mobile phone number, and a password.
    • Your password must include:
      • Eight characters
      • Uppercase letters
      • Lowercase letters
      • At least one number/special character
  5. Select Continue.
    • You’ll receive a text with a one-time code at the mobile phone number you entered.
  6. Enter the verification code.
  7. Select Verify number and create account.

You can only have one mobile phone number associated with one Walmart account. If you create a new account with the same phone number, the number will be removed from any other account.  

Email Verification 

Use a valid email address to create an account. 

  • If the email address is already associated with another Walmart account, use a different email address. 

 

  • Check your inbox for a verification email after creating your account. 

Phone Number Verification 

Use a mobile phone number that can receive text messages. 

  • You’ll receive a one-time security code by text message to verify your phone number. 

 

  • A phone number can only be linked to one Walmart account at a time. 

Warning: Walmart now requires a valid phone number for every new and existing Walmart account even if the customer previously shopped with us before. Our system will check phone numbers used to create new accounts. If we’ve verified a phone number using a one-time password (OTP) within the past 45 days, that number can’t be used to create an account.  

If it’s past 45 days, the system will allow the customer to use that phone number, but it will remove that phone number from any other account. 

Invalid Password Error  

If you receive this message during sign-up: 

We couldn’t create an account. Please try again and use a different password. 

Create a new password that meets the password requirements. 

Edit an account

You can edit your name, phone number, email, and shipping address from your account. You will need to verify that the mobile number associated with your account is updated before checkout. A one-time passcode will be sent to the email address we have on file with your account. If you’re unable to access your email to update the mobile phone number to the account, you must set up a new Walmart account to continue shopping with us.

Edit Your Personal Info and Password

  1. Log into your Walmart.com account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select the Settings gear icon at the top right. 
  4. Under Personal Information, select Contact info and password.
  5. Select Edit next to the information you wish to change.

Remove/Edit a Delivery Address

  1. Log into your Walmart.com account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select the Settings gear icon at the top right.
  4. Select Addresses.
  5. Select Add address at the top or Edit or Remove next to the delivery address you wish to change.

Delete Account

Walmart.com

  1. Sign in to Walmart.com.
  2. On the homepage and scroll down to the bottom. 
  3. On the blue ribbon, select Delete Account.

Walmart App

  1. Sign in to the Walmart App.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Scroll to the bottom of the page.
  4. Select Delete Account.

Duty and Import Related Fees for Shipments from the US

When you order products for delivery to destinations outside the U.S., you are considered the Importer of Record. This means you are responsible for:

  • Ensuring that the items comply with the import laws of the destination country.
  • Paying any applicable import fees, which will be estimated and displayed at checkout, and paid to the relevant authorities on your behalf. In checkout, these fees may be referred to as “import fees”, “import fee deposit”, “import charges” or similar.

How import fees are determined

Import Fees vary by destination and may typically be determined by:

  • Destination regulation
  • Product Category
  • Value
  • Shipping method

Import Fees typically include:

  • Carrier fees
  • Customs clearance and filing fees
  • Customs duties, import taxes and fees, and related amounts

Important Information

These fees are estimates and may differ from the actual amounts ultimately paid.

  • If the actual fees are lower than estimated, you will automatically receive a refund for the difference.
  • If the actual fees are higher, you will not be charged anything additional.

The fees are collected at checkout, and a third-party service will manage customs processing and submit the required payments to the appropriate authorities on your behalf.

Duty and Import Related Fees for Shipments to the US

What to Do if You’re Contacted AboutDuty and ImportFees

If you’re contacted by a shipping carrier or seller requesting payment for duty or import related fees after your original purchase, here’s what you should do:  

  • Reach Out to Customer Care: Please chat with us before making any payments.  

 

  • Report the seller: You can report sellers using the online form. 

Important Information

  • Avoid Paying Import Fees Directly: Carriers and sellers should not be contacting you after purchase to pay extra fees. If they do and you choose to pay the import fees directly to the carrier or seller, please be aware that these fees cannot be refunded later by Walmart.  

 

  • Understanding Fee Compensation: Any fees paid outside of Walmart to the carrier or seller will not be refundable by Walmart.

We appreciate your understanding and are here to support you. If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to get in touch with us via chat.

Flexible Spending Accounts and Health Savings Accounts

You can use your Flexible Spending Accounts (FSH) and Health Savings accounts (HSA) in store or on Walmart.com.

What is a Flexible Spending Account (FSA)?

A Flexible Spending Account (FSA) can help you save money. It is a special account offered by some employers that lets you set aside money before taxes to pay for health-related and medical expenses, including selecting over the counter (OTC) products.

In general, you must use most of the money in your FSA by the end of the year, or you might lose it.

What is a Health Savings Account (HSA)?

Like an FSA, a Health Savings Account (HSA) is a type of savings account that allows you to set aside pre-tax dollars to pay for certain health-related and medical expenses, like over the counter (OTC) products. However, you need to have a special type of health insurance called a high-deductible health plan to use an HSA. Check with your health plan to see if your plan is eligible for an HSA. 

In general, you don’t have to spend all the money in your HSA by the end of the year. It rolls over and stays with you, even if you change jobs.

Add a payment method

Adding your FSH or HSA to your Walmart account makes checking out faster and easier.

To add your FSA or HSA card to your Walmart account:

  1. Open the Walmart app or go to Walmart.com.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select the Settings gear icon at the top right.
  4. Select Wallet.
  5. Select Add new payment method.
  6. Select credit/debit card.
  7. Enter your card details.
  8. Select Save Card.

To Find Eligible Items

To use your card instore:

  1. Open the Walmart app.
  2. Open the scanner.
    • You can use Check a price or Scan & go.
  3. Scan the product’s barcode.
  4. Look for the FSA/HSA eligible badge on the product page.

To use your card online:

To use your card online you can check out with your FSA/HSA card in two ways:

  • Search for items and look for the FSA/HSA eligible badge on the product page.
  • Use the FSA/HSA shop to discover eligible items by category.

Help with Text Messages for Online Orders

Common Questions

How can I opt in to online order related text messages?

To opt in to online order related text messages, please visit the communication preferences page in your account settings and enable the categories of messages you want to receive.

You can also opt in by selecting the option to receive order-related text messages during checkout when making a purchase on walmart.com.

I am not receiving text messages after opting in, how can I fix this?

If you are not receiving online order related text messages after opting in, please text START to the following number to resume messages:

  • U.S. phone numbers can text START to 61746 or 68494 to opt-in and resume messages.
  • Mexican phone numbers can text START to 89624 to opt-in and resume messages.
  • Canadian phone numbers can text START to 956652 to opt-in and resume messages. 
How can I opt out of receiving order related text messages after I opted in?

You can opt out of receiving order related text messages in multiple ways:

  • Visit the communication preferences page in your account settings and disable the categories of messages you do not want to receive.  

  • During the checkout process for an order on walmart.com, uncheck the box for receiving order related text messages and use the toggle to save your preference.  

  • Text STOP to the following number: 

  • U.S. phone numbers can text STOP to 61746 or 68494 to opt out of online order related text messages.  

  • Mexican phone numbers can text START to 89624 to opt-in and resume messages.

  • Canadian phone numbers can text START to 956652 to opt-in and resume messages. 

How to Shop with Your SNAP EBT Card at Walmart

You can use your SNAP EBT card to shop for eligible items in store, at Walmart.com or on the Walmart app.

Shopping In Stores

It’s easy to use your SNAP EBT card at Walmart stores:

  1. Shop for eligible foods listed in your SNAP EBT benefits. To confirm eligibility, use your Walmart app to Scan the item barcode or look up the item on www.walmart.com, eligible items are marked with a “SNAP eligible” badge.
  2. Proceed to the checkout register.
  3. Swipe your SNAP EBT card first at the register and enter your PIN to pay for eligible items.

Shopping Online or Walmart app

Using your SNAP EBT card for online shopping at Walmart is easy:

  1. Go to www.walmart.com/snap.
    • Sign in or create a free Walmart account and add your SNAP EBT card to your Walmart wallet.
  2. Search for eligible items using the SNAP EBT filter or look for the ‘SNAP EBT’ eligible badge.
  3. Add eligible food items to your cart.
    • Continue to shop regularly on non-SNAP EBT items, too.
  4. At the checkout, follow the instructions for payment using your SNAP EBT card.
  5. Review your order and confirm that eligible items were purchased correctly.

For the most accurate information, always consult with your state’s official SNAP EBT resources or call the phone number at the back of your card.

Troubleshooting Tips

  • Double-check that your SNAP EBT card balance covers the items you’re purchasing.
  • If shopping online, select SNAP EBT-eligible items using website filters.

Further Assistance

If you face any issues or have questions about your SNAP EBT card:

  • Contact your local SNAP EBT office for support. Remember, SNAP EBT eligibility is defined by the USDA and your state, not Walmart.
  • Call the phone number at the back of your card.

Maximizing Your SNAP EBT Benefits

  • Plan your shopping trip ahead of time.
  • Look for sales and promotions on eligible items to stretch your benefits further.
  • Use online tools, like the SNAP EBT filters on the Walmart website or scan the item barcode on the Walmart app and look for the ‘SNAP Eligible” badge, to simplify your search for eligible items. Open the app, select the scanner in the search bar, scan item barcode and look for the ‘SNAP eligible’ badge (Replaced with Use online tools to find eligible items. On Walmart.com, apply the SNAP EBT filter, or in the Walmart app, open the scanner from the search bar, scan the item’s barcode, and look for the “SNAP Eligible” badge on the item page.)

Common Questions

Here are answers to common questions about shopping with your SNAP EBT card:

Which items are eligible?

When shopping online, look for the SNAP EBT eligible badge.

When shopping in store, scan the item in the Walmart app and look for the SNAP eligible badge

For the most accurate information, always consult with your state’s official SNAP EBT resources.

Can I use my SNAP EBT card for non-food items?

No, the card only covers SNAP EBT- eligible foods.

What happens if my SNAP card doesn’t work?

  1. Double-check your pin.
  2. Ensure the items are SNAP EBT eligible.
  3. Contact your state’s SNAP EBT help line or call the phone number at the back of your SNAP EBT card.

If you believe that the item is incorrectly marked, you can let Walmart know by selecting Chat with us at the bottom of this page.

SNAP is a federal program administered by the USDA. Eligible food items are defined by federal SNAP EBT guidelines and your state. Walmart provides tools to help identify eligible items but does not define eligibility. For questions about your benefits or card balance, contact your state’s SNAP EBT office or the number on the back of your card.

Issues Adding or Saving Payment Methods

If you’re having trouble adding or saving a payment method, make sure the name and billing address you enter match exactly what your card issuer has on file. Even small differences, such as a missing suffix (Jr., Sr.) or an incomplete address, can cause the payment method to be declined. 

You also can’t use multiple debit or credit cards on the same order. If your payment method still isn’t accepted after verifying your information, try using a different payment method. 

ZIP Code Validation Issues

If your ZIP code isn’t being accepted, make sure the ZIP code and billing address entered in Walmart match the information on file with your card issuer. Be sure to include any apartment, suite, unit number, or street suffix if it is part of your billing address. 

If your information is correct and the issue continues, contact your card issuer for assistance or try a different payment method. 

Split Payments

You may be able to split your payment between eligible benefit cards, such as FSA, WIC, or EBT, and a debit or credit card for any remaining balance. Available payment options depend on the items in your order and the payment methods accepted at checkout. 

Please note that you can’t use multiple debit cards or multiple credit cards on the same order. 

Remove a Saved Payment Method

  1. Go to your Account  

 

  1. Go to Wallet 

 

  1. Look the card you wish to remove from the payment method 

 

  1. Click Edit 

 

  1. Select Remove Card 

Some payment methods may not be available for removal if they’re linked to an active order, subscription, or membership. 

Change Your Default Payment Method 

To change your default payment method, go to your Wallet, select the payment method you’d like to use by default, and choose Set as Default. 

Your default payment method will be used for future eligible purchases unless you select a different payment method during checkout. 

Update Your Walmart+ Payment Method

You can update the payment method for your Walmart+ membership at any time from the Manage Membership page at Payments & Billing Section. 

Manage Password

Steps to Reset Your Password

If you lost or forgot your Walmart.com password, you can easily reset it using the following steps:

  1. On the sign-in screen, enter your email address and select Continue.
  2. On the password entry screen, select Forgot password below the password field.
  3. Select Send code.
  4. Check your email for the 6-digit verification code. Be sure to check your junk or spam folder.
    • This code expires after 30 minutes. If your code expired, request a new one using the steps above.
  5. Enter the 6-digit code and select Continue.
  6. Enter a new password you’ve never used before.
    • Your password must include:
      • Eight characters
      • Uppercase letters
      • Lowercase letters
      • At least one number or special character.
  7. Select Create new password and sign in.

If you received an email saying your password was changed and you have unrecognized charges on your account, you can learn more about how to protect your information.

Steps to Change Your Password

  1. Log into your Walmart account on the app or website.
  2. Go to Account.
  3. Select Personal info.
  4. Find the box labeled Password and select Edit.
  5. Enter your current password.
  6. Enter a new password you’ve never used before and select Save.

Choose How You Sign In

You have options for how you sign in to your Walmart.com account.

  1. Log into your Walmart account on the app or website.
  2. Go to Account.
  3. Select Personal info.
  4. Choose from these options:
    • Password: Use a password each time you sign in.
    • Password-less: Have a one-time verification code sent to your phone or email instead of a password.
    • Two-Factor Authentication: Use a password plus have a one-time verification sent to your phone or email.

How to Troubleshoot

You Can’t Access Your Email Account

If you don’t have access to the email account linked to your Walmart.com account, you must create a new account.

You Didn’t Get a Verification Code

If you didn’t get an email with your code:

  • Check your spam/junk folder.
  • Check to make sure you’re entering the same email you used to sign up for your Walmart.com account.

Your New Password Isn’t Working

If you get a message saying you can’t use your new password, you may be trying to use the old one. Pick a new password.

Passkeys

A passkey is a password alternative that helps you securely sign into your Walmart account. Passkeys can be saved in your cloud service account (E.g., Apple or Google account) and you’ll be able to use it on all devices associated with that account.

How to Use Passkeys

Follow the steps below to add a Passkey to your Walmart account:

  1. Open the Walmart app or website.
    • Sign into your account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Under Manage Account
    • For Android, Select Passkeys.
    • For iOS, Select Face ID & passkeys.
  4. Create passkey.

Removing a Passkey from your Walmart account:

  1. Open the Walmart app or website.
    • Sign into your account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Under Manage Account
    • For Android, Select Passkeys.
    • For iOS, Select Face ID & passkeys.
  4. Review passkeys you use to sign in.
  5. Select Remove from the appropriate passkey.

You’ll need to remove your Walmart account passkey from your device. Follow more details see your device operating systems help page:

  • Apple
  • Google
  • Windows

Use Passkeys with Two-Factor Authentication

If you’ve turned on Two-Factor Authentication and use a passkey instead of a password to sign-in, you won’t need to verify a one-time verification code after logging in with the passkey.

Privacy Consideration

Our website or app doesn’t receives or store your biometric information with passkeys. Your personal device doesn’t release biometric material.

Temporary Holds and Charges

What is a temporary hold?

When we authorize an estimated order amount from the credit or debit card, the bank places a hold on that amount to ensure there are enough funds to complete the purchase. It’s sometimes called an authorization hold and shows as pending in your account.

Why is my temporary hold different from my order total?

The hold may be more than the order’s final charge for many reasons:

  • Items priced by weight 
  • Substitutions 
  • Change in the number of items
  • Any order cancellations
  • Bag fees, depending on the state

When will I be charged my final order total?

We charge the final order total to your credit or debit card once your order is picked up, delivered, or shipped.

When will the temporary hold tobe removed?

Once the order is complete, the bank will remove the hold based on their policies. This can take up to 10 days after the order is complete to remove the hold.

We can’t remove the hold, only the bank can. Please contact your bank with any other questions.

What is an order adjustment debit?

When your payment method includes a prepaid or EBT card, an order adjustment debit is charged to make sure there are enough funds to complete your purchase.

How long does it take to get a refund for an order adjustment debit?

This charge covers adjustments to your final order. Once your final total is confirmed, you’ll be refunded any amount that is left over. Refunds to an EBT, gift card or refund credit should be refunded within three hours. Refunds to a credit or debit card can take up to 7 business days.

Why am I seeing two authorization charges on my account for an online order?

This can happen if there’s an issue with the pickup or delivery time slot of your order. If it took longer than 15 minutes to complete checkout after selecting your timeslot, and you had to pick a new timeslot, you may see two temporary authorization holds.

This can also happen if you add items to your order after it’s initially placed. You may see a new hold for the additional items. 

Please contact your bank if you need more help with authorization holds.

Why am I seeing a $.28 fee on my delivery?

The state of Colorado has a retail delivery fee on all deliveries made by a motor vehicle. Colorado requires us to charge this delivery fee within the state for any item(s) that are subject to sales tax.

We can’t refund this charge. We can only reverse it if the order is canceled, and the delivery doesn’t occur.

For more details, you can visit the Official Colorado State website, Retail Delivery Fee.

Why am I seeing a $0.50 fee on my delivery? 

The state of Minnesota has a retail delivery fee of $0.50 on all retail deliveries where charges for applicable items equals or exceeds $100. 

We can’t refund this charge. We can only reverse it if the order is cancelled, and/or the delivery doesn’t occur. 

For more details, you can visit the Official Minnesota State website, Retail Delivery Fee.

View Store Purchases and Find Receipts

When you buy items in-store, we make it easy to see those items on Walmart.com. You can view previously bought items, start a return, and add protection plans from your Purchase History.

When you use a payment card in-store that’s saved in your Walmart.com account, we’ll automatically add your store purchase to your online purchase history – there’s nothing more for you to do. We’ll also add other store purchases made with saved cards in the last 12 months. We’ll email you the first time we add a store purchase to let you know it’s available in your account.

To opt-out:

  1. Select Account.
  2. Select Communications & privacy.
  3. Select Store purchases.
  4. Switch the toggle to Off.

Remember, even if you opt-out of store purchases, your Purchase History will still show purchases made with Walmart Pay and any store receipts you’ve scanned with the Walmart app.

How do I link in-store purchases to my account?

Scan your store receipt with the Walmart app.

  1. Open your Walmart app.
  2. In the search bar, select the barcode icon.
  3. Scan the barcode on your receipt.

Checkout in-store with a payment that’s saved in your Walmart.com account.

  • Store purchases will automatically appear in your purchase history if the name on your credit card matches the name on your Walmart.com account.
  • If you want to stop seeing in-store purchases made with a certain credit card, you can remove that card from your Walmart.com account. You won’t see new purchases made with that card, but you’ll still see the ones made before you removed the card.

How do I find my store receipts?

If your in-store purchase aren’t showing in your Purchase History and you don’t have the receipt, access the receipt lookup tool.

Make sure you have these details so we can find your receipt:

  • ZIP code or city and state of the store location where you made your purchase.
  • Purchase date and total receipt amount.
  • Use your financial statement to verify purchase date and amount.
  • Card type and last four digits of card number.

Follow these steps:

  1. Enter the store location.
  2. Select the purchase date.
  3. Enter your card type and last 4 digits of card number.
  4. Enter your receipt total.
  5. Confirm the Captcha.
  6. Select Lookup receipt.
  7. Download your receipt.

If you made a purchase using a form of payment other than a debit or credit card, or if you need more help, please select the Chat with us button.

Where can I find my Pickup, Delivery and Shipping receipts?

You can use the barcode at the bottom of your order on Walmart.com or in the Walmart app (top right) in Purchase History as a proof of purchase.

  1. Select Account.
  2. Select Purchase History.
  3. Select the desired purchase.
  4. Scroll down to view totals and payment information.
  5. The bar code at the bottom serves as your proof of purchase.

To print a receipt:

  1. Go to your account on Walmart.com.
  2. Select Purchase History.
  3. Find the order for which you need the receipt.
  4. Select View details.
  5. Select the Print icon at the top left.

Walmart Cash

Walmart Cash is a promotional currency available to customers with a Walmart account through certain programs offered by Walmart from time-to-time. You can redeem Walmart Cash for future purchases in-store and online, or you can redeem your Walmart Cash and cash out in store.

  • You earn Walmart Cash by claiming Manufacturer Offers for products in the app or on Walmart.com, then purchasing those items.
  • You will get your Walmart Cash after your order is fulfilled and won’t be awarded if your item is substituted or returned.

How to Find Manufacturer Offers

Online
  1. Go to Walmart.com or open the app.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Get More next to your Walmart cash balance at the top of the screen.
  4. Select View Eligible Items to see available offers.

You can also search for a product. If there’s a Manufacturer Offer available, you’ll see it on the item’s detail page. To claim the offer, select the box next to Get Walmart Cash. We’ll award the Walmart Cash to your account once the item is purchased and delivered.

In Store

If you’re in-store, you can use the Walmart app to scan barcodes.

  1. Open the Walmart app.
  2. Open the scanner.
    • You can use Check a price or Scan & go.
  3. Scan the product’s barcode.
  4. If there’s a manufacturer offer, you’ll see it on your screen.
    • To claim the offer, select the box next to Get Walmart Cash. 
  5. Scan the QR code at checkout to link your online account to your in-store transaction.
  6. Once you purchase the item, we’ll award the Walmart Cash to your account.
Through Scan Your Receipt

If you have already claimed Manufacturer Offers in the app or Walmart.com, but purchased the relevant products at a store using a method other than Walmart Pay or Scan and Go, you may still be able to get Walmart Cash for those products by scanning a copy of your receipt.

  1. Open your Walmart app.
  2. Select the barcode icon in the search bar.
  3. Scan the barcode on your store receipt. It may take up to 48 hours for the Walmart Cash to be awarded to your account.

How to Check for Awarded Walmart Cash

  1. Open the Walmart app or go to Walmart.com.
  2. Select Account.
    • If you earned Walmart Cash, you’ll see the balance at the top of the page. 
  3. Select Get More next to Walmart Cash located at the top of the page.
  4. Select View your Walmart Cash Activity for more details. 

How to Redeem Walmart Cash for Purchases

You can redeem your Walmart Cash on purchases in-store and online.

Online
  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. At checkout, select Apply next to your Walmart Cash balance in the Payment Method section.
  3. Select the payment method for the remaining balance, if any.
In-Store
  1. Sign into your Walmart.com account.
  2. Scan the on-screen QR code to connect to your account.
  3. Select Walmart Cash as a payment method.
  4. Select payment method for the remaining balance, if any.
    • We won’t charge your payment method if you have more Walmart Cash than your basket total.

How to Redeem Walmart Cash for Cash In-Store

You can redeem your Walmart Cash and receive cash in-store once you have accumulated at least $25 in Walmart Cash.

In-Store
  1. Log into your Walmart account.
  2. Select Get more.
  3. Scroll down to Walmart Cash Tools. 
  4. Select Cash out in store.
  5. Agree to the required terms and then select Show cash out barcode.
    • Your code expires in three hours.
  6. Go to the MoneyCenter or customer service desk at any Walmart store.
  7. Show your barcode to the associate to scan.

For security reasons, we’ll ask to see your identification. The name on the identification shown to a Walmart associate must match the name on your Walmart+ account.

Returned Items

If you earned Walmart Cash and then return the item, the Walmart Cash previously awarded will be deducted from your Walmart Cash balance.

  • This may give you a negative balance. Future Walmart Cash awards will be used to first offset that negative balance, after which you can begin to accrue a positive Walmart Cash balance again.
  • You can’t use a negative balance towards your purchases, but we’ll never ask you to repay a negative balance.

If you return an item you purchased with your Walmart Cash, it will be refunded to your Walmart Cash balance within approximately 24 hours.

See the Walmart Cash Terms of Use for additional information.

Health and Wellness

Accessibility to Walmart Healthcare Services

Our Commitment to Accessibility

Walmart is committed to providing accessible health programs and activities to all patients, free of discrimination based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability. Walmart provides healthcare customers with language assistance and auxiliary aids and services at no cost. Walmart will provide reasonable modifications for qualified individuals with disabilities, when necessary to ensure accessibility and equal opportunity to participate in our programs, activities, services, or other benefits.

Individuals with Limited English Proficiency

Call or visit your local Walmart pharmacy or vision center for language access services available in more than 220 languages.

Individuals who are Blind or have Low Vision

Walmart provides various large print resources. Our pharmacies also offer ScripTalk® “talking labels” and Braille prescription labels upon request.

Individuals with a Hearing or Speech Disability

Walmart will work to support your preferred method of communication. Please call 7-1-1 to utilize Telecommunications Relay Services (TRS). If you prefer American Sign Language (ASL), ask your local Walmart pharmacy or vision center to arrange an interpreter.

Individuals with Limited Mobility

Walmart stores comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act and our associates are trained to provide assistance for you upon request.

Service Animals

Walmart welcomes customers and patients using service animals in all areas of the store used by the public. You may, upon entering the store, be asked if the animal accompanying you is a service animal. If so, simply indicate that this is the case, and your service animal will be welcome to accompany you.

If You Have a Healthcare Accessibility Question, Concern, or Suggestion

We welcome our customers to contact us about any accessibility questions via email at HWPatientComments@walmart.com. Walmart strictly prohibits retaliation against any person making a complaint of discrimination. You may initiate a formal accessibility or discrimination grievance by contacting:

  1. The Office of Walmart’s Vice President, US Ethics & Compliance:
    • 1-800-WM-ETHIC (1-800-963-8442),
    • www.walmartethics.com, or
    • ethics@walmart.com
  2. The Office of Civil Rights, U.S Dept. Health & Human Services:
    • Electronic: 0
    • Via Mail: U.S. Department of Health & Human Services 200 Independence Avenue, S.W. – 509F Washington, D.C. 20201

Add or Update Insurance Information

Follow the steps below to add or update your prescription drug insurance.

To update insurance online:

  1. Sign in to your Walmart Pharmacy account in the app or visit Walmart.com/Pharmacy.
  2. Scroll to My Account.
  3. Select Manage my insurance.
  4. Select Add prescription insurance.
  5. Walmart will look up your insurance details automatically.
    • You can add details manually if needed.
  6. Select the insurance you’d like to add.
  7. Select Add and continue.

You may also update your insurance during any online refill or transfer request. Just select Add or Change insurance before submitting and follow the steps.

To update insurance by phone:

  1. Call your local Walmart Pharmacy store.
  2. Provide your updated insurance information over the phone.
  3. Confirm that we’ve saved the new information before placing your Rx order.

To update insurance in person:

  1. Visit your local Walmart Pharmacy store.
  2. Provide the pharmacy staff with your updated insurance information.

Add Pharmacy Access and Verify Identity Online

To add pharmacy access, you must first have a Walmart account. Visit Create or Edit an Account to create a new Walmart account. Once you have a Walmart account, follow the steps below to add pharmacy access and verify your identity online.  

Walmart app:

  1. Download the Walmart app on an Android or iOS mobile device.
  2. Enter your Walmart.com phone number or email.
  3. Select Continue.
  4. Choose a method to sign in, either text/email a verification code or Enter your password.  
  5. Select Sign in. 
  6. Select Services.
  7. Select Pharmacy.
  8. Select Get started.
  9. Complete the required fields (legal name, phone, date of birth, etc.).
  10. Select Continue.
  11. To ensure we protect your healthcare information, you will be required to verify your identity. 

    • If you are enrolled in text messaging with the pharmacy, you will be required to verify identity via an OTP (One Time Passcode) sent to your enrolled phone number. 

    • If you are not enrolled in text messaging with the pharmacy, you will need to answer a few short security questions to verify your identity.  

      **If you see the error message, We couldn’t verify your identity, follow the error help guide for help. 

  12. Create a 4-digit PIN to complete verification.
  13. Once we verify your account, choose how to manage your prescriptions: 
    • Select Refill Prescriptions to manage existing refills. 
    • Select Pharmacy History for a list of prescriptions from the past two years. 
    • Select Transfer Prescriptions to transfer a new prescription to Walmart Pharmacy. 
    • Select Manage family members to link your family members and pets to your account to manage prescriptions for your whole family in one place.  
    • Select Add insurance to update insurance information for the whole family. 

Pharmacy website:

(For full pharmacy services, use the Walmart app.)

  1. Open the Walmart Pharmacy sign-in page on a computer or mobile browser.
  2. Select Sign In.
    • Or if you are new to Walmart, select Create a new account.
  3. Enter your email address.
  4. Select Continue.
  5. Select Add Pharmacy Access.
  6. Complete the required fields (legal name, date of birth, etc.).
  7. Select Continue. 
  8. To ensure we protect your healthcare information, you will be required to verify your identity. 

    • If you are enrolled in text messaging with the pharmacy, you will be required to verify identity via an OTP (One Time Passcode) sent to your enrolled phone number. 

    • If you are not enrolled in text messaging with the pharmacy, you will need to answer a few short security questions to verify your identity.  

      **If you see the error message, We couldn’t verify your identity, follow the error help guide for help. 

  9. Create a 4-digit PIN to complete verification.
  10. Once we verify your account, choose how to manage your prescriptions:
    • Select Refill Prescriptions to manage existing refills.
    • Select Pharmacy History for a list of prescriptions from the past two years.
    • Select Transfer Prescriptions to transfer a new prescription to Walmart Pharmacy.
    • Select Manage family members to link your family members and pets to your account to manage prescriptions for your whole family in one place.  
    • Select Add insurance to update prescription insurance information for all managed family members.

Find the Right Glasses for You

To find the right glasses for your face shape, use the descriptions below.

Oval face: Balanced features and gentle curves.

  • Oval faces can wear nearly any frame style.
  • To add a little pizzazz, try square and rectangular frames, which contrast with your face shape.
  • Consider frames that are not too large or too small or a natural balance of your features.

Oblong face: Elongated, tapers toward the chin.

  • Look for deep frame styles with low temple attachments.
  • Consider frames that are not too narrow to balance your features.

Round face: Width and length are about the same, with the widest point at the cheeks.

  • Look for square, rectangular, and angular frames.
  • Angular frame shapes play off your fuller cheeks and rounded chin.
  • Also try shapes that upsweep at the corners to emphasize your eyes.

Square face: Straight lines, square chin, and broad forehead.

  • Look for oval and round frames.
  • Choose frames with soft, rounded edges to balance the lines of your face, while allowing your features to shine.

Triangular face: Narrower forehead with wider cheeks and jawline.

  • Try aviator style frames that are wider at the temples and narrow toward the chin.
  • Try frames that add width to the forehead and soften the jawline.

Diamond face: Very angular and wider at the temples.

  • Look for softly curved frames that are no wider than the cheekbones.
  • Try frames that are not too thick or decorative at the temples.

Heart face: Strongly tapers toward the chin with a wider forehead.

  • Look for frames that balance the different widths of your facial features.
  • For example, bottom-heavy frames balance the narrowness of the lower half of your face, while oval shapes can soften a more pointed chin.

Choose eyeglass colors that complement your skin undertone, hair color, and eye color

The right frame color says a lot about you! Rich, dark colors are essential to every wardrobe. Soft pastels make eye color pop. Splashes of color add interest and fun.

  • Go to your personal wardrobe and think about the colors of clothes that you feel most comfortable wearing. Use this as a guide to help you select your frames.
  • Knowing what colors suit your skin tone will also help you find the perfect frames.

Metal or Plastic Frames?

  • Plastic frames provide great definition and are available in many color choices.
  • Metal frames are smooth and sleek for a classic look.

Manage Family Prescriptions

You can add adults (18+ years), minors (under 18), and pets to your Walmart Pharmacy account to manage their prescriptions.

  • Adults (18+ years) must register their own Walmart.com account with a unique email address.
  • Adult (18+ years) family dependents must approve requests before another member can manage their Walmart prescriptions (see Step 3 below).
  • Child and pet family members will automatically appear in your Walmart Pharmacy account to start managing prescriptions once added.

Step 1: Verify your account:

  • If your Walmart account is not verified for online pharmacy access, you must add pharmacy access first.

Step 2: Add a family member (adult, child, or pet):

  1. Go to the Walmart Pharmacy website via Walmart.com/pharmacy or select Services > Pharmacy in the app.
  2. Select Sign In or Create account.
  3. Enter your registered email address phone number.
    • This should match what your pharmacy store has on file.
  4. Choose a sign in method: text verification code, email verification code, or enter password.
  5. Enter your 4-digit PIN.
    • You may use face recognition or fingerprint to bypass PIN if you have previously enabled biometrics.
  6. Scroll down and select Mange family members.
  7. Select Add a family member.
  8. Select a method to add family member and follow on screen instructions:
    • Scan a Walmart Rx barcode – scanning the family member’s rx label or manually entering the data from the family members rx. (Requires that you have access to the prescription number and store number.)
    • Phone number lookup – enter your phone number to add any family member who receives pharmacy text notifications on that number. You will be required to enter an OTP (one time password) sent to your phone.
    • Add via insurance – provide the family member’s insurance details and demographic information.
  9. Verify family member’s Date of Birth (DOB) for a minor and select Confirm.
    • If this is a pet check This family member is a pet.
  10. Verify family member’s Date of Birth (DOB) and email for an adult.
    • For an adult with an existing Pharmacy profile, the email will be pre-filled.
    • For an adult without an existing Pharmacy profile, email will need to be added.
  11. Select Send request for an adult family member.

Step 3: Approve request to manage adult dependent prescriptions:

When adding an adult (18+) to a Walmart Pharmacy account, the adult must approve the Pending Request in their Walmart Pharmacy account before access is granted.

An adult without an existing Walmart Pharmacy online account will click the link in the request email and follow the instructions on the screen to create an account. The request to be managed will appear after account creation.

An adult with an existing Walmart Pharmacy online account should sign into their account to approve the management request.

  1. Select link in request email or go to the Walmart Pharmacy website via Walmart.com/pharmacy or select Services > Pharmacy in the app.
  2. Select Sign in or Create account.
  3. Enter your registered phone number or email address.
    • This should match what your pharmacy store has on file.
  4. Choose a sign in method: text verification code, email verification code, or enter password.
  5. Enter your 4-digit PIN.
    • You may use face recognition or fingerprint to bypass PIN if you have previously enabled biometrics.
  6. Find the Pending request dialog on your pharmacy dashboard.
  7. Select Accept to allow your requesting family member to manage your prescriptions.
    • Select Decline if you do not want the requesting family member to have access to manage your prescriptions.

Unable to Verify Identity (Pharmacy)

When you follow the steps to add Pharmacy Access online, the personal details entered must match what your local pharmacy store has saved in their system. If any data is incorrect or doesn’t match, you’ll see one of these errors:

  • Sorry, we couldn’t verify your identity. You can try again in 24 hours.
  • We couldn’t verify your identity.

To troubleshoot pharmacy access errors, follow these steps:

Part 1: Refresh your device/account settings.

  1. Sign out of the Walmart.com website and Walmart app.
  2. Open a new private or incognito window in your web browser or use a new browser that hasn’t accessed Walmart.com before.
  3. Go to your web browser’s Settings/Preferences.
  4. Clear the browser cache and history.

Add Pharmacy Access:

  1. Sign in to the Walmart Pharmacy website with your Walmart.com registered email.
  2. Select Add Pharmacy Access.
    • Do not select Create a new account.
  3. Enter your personal information exactly as it’s saved at your local pharmacy.
    • To confirm your personal details on file, call your local pharmacy.
  4. Select Continue and complete the verification process.
    • Don’t exceed this step more than twice in 24 hours.
    • If you still see an error, continue to Part 2.

Part 2: Contact your local pharmacy store.

  1. Call your local Walmart Pharmacy store where you fill your medications.
  2. Confirm all information below is saved in the store’s system to match what you enter online:
    • First and last name
    • Date of birth
    • Phone number
    • Current address
    • Walmart.com sign-in email
  3. Confirm that the pharmacy has only one pharmacy profile created for you.
    • If you have more than one profile, the pharmacy must merge all profiles into one before you can move forward.
  4. Once you update your details, repeat the steps in Part 1.
  5. If you still see an error, continue to Part 3.

Part 3: Verify in person at your local store.

  1. Bring your photo identification to your local Walmart Pharmacy store.
  2. Inform the pharmacy that you can’t add pharmacy access online due to an error.
  3. Ask the pharmacy to verify your identification in person using their store system.
    • If the pharmacy isn’t familiar with this request, ask for help from the pharmacy manager.
  4. Show your photo identification so the pharmacy can find your pharmacy profile in the store system.
  5. Confirm that the pharmacy has only one pharmacy profile created for you.
    • If the pharmacy finds more than one profile, they must merge all profiles into one before you can move forward.
  6. Confirm all info below is saved in the store’s system to match what you enter online:
    • First and last name
    • Date of birth
    • Phone number
    • Address
    • Sign-in email
  7. Once your identification is verified in the system, you’ll receive an email with instructions.
    • Open the email from Walmart Pharmacy when you receive it.
    • Select the Get started button in the email.
    • Verify your personal details to complete verification.
    • Once verification is complete, your pharmacy profile will be connected to your Walmart.com account
  8. If you can’t verify your identification at your pharmacy store, continue to Part 4.

Part 4: Contact Customer Care.

  1. Call 1-800-WALMART
  2. Select Option 1 on your phone keypad.
  3. Say Pharmacy account after the automated voice prompt.
  4. Let the agent know you can’t add Pharmacy Access online and at your local store.
  5. Provide your account details and a valid Walmart Pharmacy prescription number.
  6. If we can’t resolve the issue remotely, the Customer Care agent can open a support case for more help.

Walmart Pet Prescription Process

Walmart Pet Prescriptions is an online pharmacy that allows you to order pet medications and vet diet food on Walmart.com with your vet’s approval.

How To Shop Pet Prescriptions

  1. Begin shopping for pet prescriptions by searching for items individually or by going to Services > Pharmacy > Pet Pharmacy to browse. 
    • Items can also be found under Account > Pets > Pet Pharmacy.
  2. Add the item(s) to your cart.
  3. Enter your pet and vet information.
  4. We’ll contact the vet to verify the prescription. 
  5. With approval, we’ll fill the prescription. RX orders will ship to your home after authorization from the vet.

If the vet doesn’t respond within two business days, we’ll contact them again. It can take up to five business days for the vet to respond. If we can’t verify the prescription with the vet, we’ll contact you. If you no longer wish to wait, you can cancel the order if it’s still in Placed status or request a cancelation if it’s in Preparing status. 

Pet Prescription Substitutions

Pet Prescription orders may have a substitution if the vet makes a change to the prescription. These changes can be:

  • Item (E.g., Simparica Trio instead of Simparica)
  • Strength (5 mg instead of 3 mg)
  • Dosage (E.g., Instead of one pill ordered, vet approved 15 pills)
  • Weight (E.g., Simpartica for 11 lbs dog instead of five lbs.)

If the change results in a price increase:

  • 10% or less price increase (and the item has not been changed by vet): We automatically approve the change.
  • Over 10% price increase or item changed by the vet: You must approve the change.
    • We’ll notify you via SMS, app notification, and/or email.
    • If you decline the change or do not respond by the deadline, the order will be canceled.

Refills

After placing a Walmart pet prescription order, whether a one-time purchase or a subscription, you’ll be notified of how many refills you have remaining via email. You will also be able to find this information in your pet prescription management page. If you do not have any refills, you won’t be able to set up a subscription for the prescription.

Reminder Notifications

We’ll remind you when your pet prescription is ready to refill so you won’t run out of medication. You’ll get refill reminders through:

  • Email
    • Subject: It’s time to refill prescriptions
  • Walmart app push notifications
    • Subject: Refill your pet prescription

We only send reminders when there are available refills. Reminders are sent 7 to 10 days before the refill is due. If there is pending refill we won’t send the reminder.

To place a refill order:

  1. Go to My Account > Pets > Prescriptions.If refills are available:

  2. Select Refill now.

    • The refill will be added to your cart.

  3. Proceed to checkout and your pet’s medication will be shipped.

If no refills remain:

  1. Select Reorder Now.

    • Your order will be added to your cart.

    • After checkout, the system will contact your vet for approval. Once approved, the medication will be delivered in a few days.

Email: Select Refill now. App notification: Select the notification to view details.

Expired or Out of Refills

If you would like to reorder an expired prescriptions or renew a prescription, you can add the item to your cart and select Reorder now on your prescription management page. We’ll contact your vet to approve it.

Vet Initiated Orders

If you have an existing PetRX order, your vet can add recommend prescriptions to your account. If you agree with the recommendations, you can add these items to our cart and check out.

Walmart Pharmacy Delivery

Walmart Prescription Delivery is a pharmacy delivery service that allows you to receive your eligible medications directly at your doorstep, providing convenience while helping you stay on top of your health needs.

  • Delivery fees may vary based on location, delivery time chosen (Express, Today, or Standard) and membership.
    • Walmart+ members can enjoy free prescription delivery with no order minimum when placing or refilling orders on Walmart.com and in the Walmart app.
  • If delivery is available in your area, an option for delivery will display as a fulfillment option on Walmart.com and in the Walmart app when your prescription is ready.
  • To get Pharmacy Delivery, you must have or set up a Walmart Pharmacy Account.

How Pharmacy Delivery Works

  1. Place your Pharmacy Delivery order on Walmart.com or in the Walmart app.
    • Visit our Pharmacy Services page to learn more about managing prescriptions and adding Pharmacy access to your Walmart account.
  2. The Walmart Pharmacy fills the order and marks it ready for pickup.
  3. When your prescription is ready for pickup, you can add your prescription to your cart along with your groceries and essentials.
  4. Select the link, pick a timeslot, and we’ll deliver your prescription with your delivery items. You can choose to have your prescription dropped off at your door, or you can opt-in to sign for your delivery.

Exceptions

We deliver most prescriptions excluding the following:

  • Pseudoephedrine containing products
  • Compounds
  • Federal Controlled Substances
  • State Specific Drugs of Concern
  • All State Specific Controlled Substances
  • Medicare Part B prescriptions
  • Medicaid restrictions in FL, IL, NY, OK, UT, WA, and WI unless a Walmart+ member
  • Delivery across state lines

Common Questions

What other services does Walmart Pharmacy offer?

In addition to getting your prescription medications, Walmart Pharmacy also offers affordable immunizations to help protect you from the flu, COVID-19, shingles, and more. Just select schedule now to find an appointment and Walmart Pharmacy location that’s convenient for you. There’s also no-cost interpretation with over 200 languages available for those who need an interpreter.

Can I have my family’s prescriptions delivered along with my own? 

Yes, to have your family members’ prescriptions delivered along with your own, you must first link them to your pharmacy account. Visit Walmart.com/pharmacy, scroll down to the My account section, and select Manage family prescriptions to add your family member(s).

How will I be notified if there’s a problem with my prescription or order?

You will receive notifications via the mobile app, text message and/or email about the status of your delivery including problems or delays.  

Select the Chat with us button for any other concerns about wait times.  

Can I get my prescription medication from Walmart Pharmacy?

Yes. Walmart Pharmacy offers an easy prescription experience, from medication refills with just a few clicks to low-cost generic meds starting at just $4. You can also transfer your prescription online quickly and easily. Just select start a transfer to create an account. Walmart’s Specialty Pharmacy can also make it easy for you to get the medications you need at an affordable price. Check out our key health resources and more wellness services to learn more about selecting an insurance that’s right for you, get your questions about Medicare answered, connect with a pharmacist for medication management, and information on pet meds for everyday low prices on medications for your furry friends.

Wellness App Data Export

The Walmart Wellness App retired on January 31, 2023. It is no longer available to install or use. If you had an active Wellness app account prior to this day, you can download your data by following the steps below.

The new Walmart app now supports managing both Health & Wellness needs and shopping, all in one place. Wellness features in the app include:

  • Manage, track, and order Walmart Pharmacy prescription refills.
  • Access information about our Pharmacy services and other Health & Wellness offerings.
    • We’re working on adding more Health & Wellness features to improve the experience in the future.

Deleting Walmart Wellness App Data

We’re required to retain Health & Wellness-related customer data for six years, so we can’t delete account data by request. We can provide a copy of your data by request. Please visit the Pharmacy and Vision Center/Optical HIPAA Forms page to complete the form and return it completed to your local Walmart or Sam’s Club Pharmacy, Vision Center/Optical location or mail the form to the address provided.

Pharmacy Customer and Prescription Orders

You can view and refill your Walmart pharmacy prescriptions in two places:

  1. Sign in to the Walmart app.
  2. Select Services.

  4. Sign in to the Walmart Pharmacy website.
    • You can also call your local Pharmacy store.
    • Visit Prescription status and pharmacy refill orders to learn more.

Note: Any prescriptions previously added to the Wellness app that aren’t managed by Walmart Pharmacy won’t be visible in the Walmart app or Walmart Pharmacy website.

Data Export (Download Wellness App Data)

The last day to download Wellness app data online was January 31, 2024. To request a formal copy of your Wellness app data, follow the instructions in this article below under Request to Access Data.

Information Included

After you successfully request your Wellness app data, we’ll send you a .ZIP file with your Walmart Wellness app data. It will include all relevant account and individual profile data, including:

  • medication lists
  • health tracking data
  • journal entries

Examples of what may be included in your file:

  • PDF: Text file with all your Walmart Wellness app data. (This will look different than how your data appeared in the Wellness app, but all saved data is included.)
  • CSV: Trackers data for each profile in your account. (Open with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or import into another application).
  • JPG: All images you can open with any compatible image software. 
Accessing ZIP File Content on Your Phone or Tablet

If you download your data on a mobile device, check your device’s default application for managing files:

iPhone or iPad: Open the blue Files app and search for your Walmart Wellness app data. 

  • iOS device instructions.
  • Zip file instructions.

Android: Open the default file explorer usually called Files or My files (look for the paper file folder icon).

  • Android device instructions.
  • Zip file instructions.

Transferring Downloaded Data from Phone to Computer

The easiest way to save your data onto a computer is to access the link sent via email on your desktop.

  • It is required to request the export in the app b efore a data file will be available online.
  • After you access the site, you can download your data directly to the location where you’d like to store it.

If you download your data on a mobile device, you can transfer it to your computer by sending an email to yourself from your phone.

  1. Open your email app.
  2. Compose an email to yourself and attach your data file(s).
  3. Open the email on a computer and download the attachment. 

If your file size is too large to email, upload the file to a cloud storage service like Google Drive, Dropbox, or iCloud and access it from your computer.

To learn more about how to transfer files from your phone or tablet to a computer, use the links below:

Data Export Download Troubleshooting

Request to Access Data

For privacy and security reasons, if you would like to access your data after the online data export site closes (January 31, 2023), submit a Request to Access Records.

If you’re submitting a request as a personal representative of someone you care for, you’ll also need to provide one of the following:

  • A valid Authorization to Release PHI form completed and signed by the patient, or
  • A document that verifies your authority to access the patient’s records as the patient’s Personal Representative
    • E.g. letter or order of guardianship, power of attorney .

To fulfill your request and adequately protect personal health information, five pieces of personal data must be confirmed on both the Request to Access Records form and listed on the Walmart Wellness app account profile you want to access:

  • Name
  • Date of birth
  • Address
  • Email address
  • Phone number
Data Export File is Not Available

If you didn’t request your data export in the Wellness app before it retired on January 31, 2023, follow Data Export (Download Wellness App Data) at the top of this article to save a copy of your data export.

Data is Missing from Your Data Export

The data contained in your export will be based on the sharing permissions as of January 31, 2023. If you didn’t have access to a profile that was previously shared with you by another account on that date, the data in the shared profile won’t be included in your export.

As of January 31, 2023, all exports are now final. No additional changes can be made to sharing permissions for profiles.

How to Download Data Saved to Someone Else’s Account

As of January 31, 2023, all exports are now final, and no additional changes can be made to sharing permissions for profiles.

For privacy and security reasons, if you’d like to access your data, but don’t have sharing permission granted from the original account owner, you’ll need to complete the Request to Access Records form and submit your request in writing.

To fulfill your request and adequately protect personal health information, four pieces of personal data Must be confirmed on both the Request to Access Records form and listed on the Walmart Wellness app account Profile you wish to access.

  • Name
  • Date of birth
  • Address
  • Email address
  • Phone number
How do I stop sharing a profile that I don’t want others to access?

As of January 31, 2023, we can’t fulfill these requests. On this date, we created historical exports for all users using the sharing permissions in force on that date. We can’t retroactively remove or add data from these files.

CareZone Troubleshooting

If you were a CareZone user that never migrated to the Wellness app, we can’t provide access to CareZone data. Connecting your CareZone data to an active Walmart Wellness account was required before January 31, 2023, to generate a data export. We can’t create new Walmart Wellness accounts or link Walmart Wellness accounts to CareZone accounts because the Wellness app is decommissioned. The last day to create a Walmart Wellness account was January 30, 2023. Any CareZone accounts not migrated were deactivated and your personal data removed from our servers. We’re sorry for any inconvenience.

Import Data Into Another App

Options to import your health tracking data into other apps:

  • Computer: You can import health tracking data in the CSV file into Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Double click on the CSV file (which you can most likely find in the downloads folder), and your computer will open your default spreadsheet application with the data. 
  • iPhone and iPad: You can import your health tracking data in the CSV file into Apple Health using Health CSV Importer app ($1.99 to install). 
  • Android devices: You can import your data and view it in Google Sheets, Excel or a similar app. Follow the How do I access my files on my phone or tablet? instructions above to open your file.
