InHome

Home and Garage Keypads

As a Walmart+ InHome member you can choose where we deliver your groceries. 

  • InHome delivers to your kitchen, garage, or your door.
  • InHome service doesn’t require a smart device.
  • For more information on InHome delivery preferences, see myQ Smart Garage Control and Level Smart Locks and Other InHome Delivery Options.

If you already have a keypad on your door or garage, you can link it to InHome for free to get delivery into your home or garage with keypad access.

To link a keypad, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Walmart app and select your Account.
  2. Select the gear-icon on the top right to open Account settings.
  3. Select Addresses.
  4. Select InHome preferences on the address you want to link a keypad to.
  5. Select Set up kitchen or garage delivery.
  6. Select Kitchen or Garage.
  7. Select My keypad.
    • Enter your keypad code and select where your keypad is located.
  8. Select Property type (optional).
  9. Enter the gate code or call box code if you live in a gated community.
  10. Enter any specific delivery instructions you want the Walmart associate to follow.
  11. Select Finish Set Up.

We’ll make your next InHome delivery to the location you chose (kitchen or garage).

You can also link your keypad during the checkout process when you’re placing an InHome order. Select Edit on the Review Order page to open InHome preferences.

To update your keypad code, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Walmart app and select your Account.
  2. Select the gear-icon on the top right to open Account settings.
  3. Select Addresses.
  4. Select InHome preferences on the address you want to update your keypad code for.
  5. Under Home access, select Edit next to your Keypad code.
  6. Enter your keypad code and select Done.

You can also update your keypad code during the checkout process when you’re placing an InHome order. Select Edit on the Review Order page to open InHome preferences.

Unlinking Your Keypad

  1. Log into your Account.
  2. Select the gear-icon on the top right to open Account settings.
  3. Select Addresses.
  4. Select InHome preferences on the address you want to unlink your keypad on.
  5. Under Home access, select Unlink device.
  6. Select Confirm.

Your delivery preferences will be set to doorstep for InHome delivery.

InHome Billing and Payments

We offer InHome for free for the first 30 days.

  • There are no charges for the first 30 days of trial.
  • We’ll renew your membership and charge you for the selected plan once the trial ends.
  • You must have a Walmart+ membership to add on InHome.
    • See InHome Plus Up for sign up and pricing.

InHome Payment Methods

You must use a credit/debit card or PayPal to sign up for Walmart+ InHome.

Updating InHome Payment Method

To update your payment method:

  1. Sign into your account.
  2. Select Walmart+.
  3. Select Manage Membership.
  4. Select the arrow by Payments & Billing. 
  5. Select Change by Current payment method.

Failed Payment Method Reminder

A few days before your free InHome trial or billing cycle ends, we’ll check your payment method to see if we can use it. If there’s a problem, we’ll send you an email that we’ll try your payment again soon and instruct you to update your payment method in your Walmart account.

You’ll need to change your payment method to prevent your InHome Plus Up from expiring.

Prorated Fees

If your Walmart+ membership and InHome Plus Up are billed on separate days, your next payment for InHome will be prorated.

  • The prorated charge for InHome covers the days between renewing your plan and your next Walmart+ membership payment date.
  • This will combine your billing dates, ensuring your Walmart+ membership and InHome Plus Up share the same billing date going forward.

To Change Your Billing Date

  1. Sign into your account.
  2. Go to Account.
  3. Select Walmart+.
  4. Select Manage Membership.
  5. Select Manage by Walmart+ Plan.
  6. Select Change by Change billing date. 
  7. Select the date on the calendar.
  8. Select Continue.
  9. Select Confirm.

You can’t change your billing date:

  • During your trial period.
  • You’re within 48 hours before your current billing date.
  • Your current billing dates are not the same for Walmart+ and InHome.
  • You’ve already changed the billing date five times in a 12-month rolling period.

Changing your billing date will apply to Walmart+ and InHome. You can change your billing date on the Manage Membership page up to 48 hours before your upcoming billing date.

Examples of Walmart+ InHome Charges on Your Bank Statement

  • InHome Plus Up: “WPLUS INHOME JAN 2024”
  • Walmart+ Membership: “WMT PLUS JAN 2024”

See the Walmart+ InHome Terms of Use article for more information.

InHome Ordering

With InHome, you get free deliveries into your home, garage, or door (and it’s tip-free)! You must be an active Walmart+ InHome member to see InHome time slots.

Placing an InHome Order

  1. Visit Walmart.com or open the Walmart app.
  2. Fill the cart with everything you need.
  3. Check the filters when adding items to the cart.
    • For InHome delivery, the items must have the tag Delivery to ensure delivery by one of our Walmart associates.
  4. After filling the cart, select the Delivery from store.
  5. Select an InHome delivery timeslot at checkout.
    • InHome timeslots are 9 a.m. - 1 p.m. or 2 p.m. - 6 p.m.
    • InHome delivery offers same-day delivery for the afternoon time slot (2 p.m. - 6 p.m.) if you order before 10 a.m. local time.
  6. On the Review Order page, you can update your:
    • Delivery location
    • Property type
    • Gate code or call box code
    • Delivery instructions for your associate to follow
  7. The InHome order arrives on the day you select.

Bag Recycling

You can recycle plastic bags with InHome in select states and counties. Leave the used plastic bags in your InHome delivery location and we’ll collect them on your next InHome delivery.

Please note, this service is not available in the following states — Connecticut, Colorado, Delaware, Maine, New York, Oregon, Rhode Island, Washington D.C., Washington, Vermont, New Jersey, Hawaii, Alaska and in certain counties in Massachusetts, including Hampden, Middlesex, Plymouth, Norfolk, and Bristol.

Changing your Walmart Delivery Store

You can select your preferred store for InHome delivery at checkout.

  1. After filling the cart, select the Delivery from store.
  2. Select Change next to Delivering from.
    • Choose another nearby Walmart store.
  3. If the store shows a green checkmark for InHome delivery, they can deliver.
  4. Select Save as my store.
  5. Continue the checkout process.

Changing your InHome Delivery Address

You can get InHome delivery to any address on your Walmart account that’s eligible.

  1. After filling the cart, select the Delivery from store.
  2. Select Change next to your address.
  3. Choose another address.
    • If your address shows a green checkmark for InHome delivery, we can deliver there.
  4. Select Continue.
  5. Continue the checkout process.

If you want to add a new delivery address to your Walmart account, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Walmart app or visit Walmart.com.
  2. Select Account.
  3. SelectAddresses.
  4. Add the new address.

An address is eligible for InHome if it shows W+ Eligible for InHome under the address.

InHome Plus Up

You can upgrade your Walmart+ membership by adding the InHome Plus Up. It’s an enhanced delivery service that uses Walmart associates to handle every step of your order. Benefits include:  

  • Delivery by a trusted Walmart associate  
  • Delivery to your door, garage, or kitchen  
  • Tip and delivery-fee free delivery when you select an InHome time slot at checkout  
    • Time slots: 9 a.m.-1 p.m. or 2 p.m.-6 p.m.
  •  Returns pick-up service  

If you’re already an InHome member and want to get delivery beyond your doorstep

  • See myQ Smart Garage Control and Level Smart Locks, Home & Garage Keypads, or Other InHome Delivery Options to set up your InHome delivery preferences.
  • Visit Manage Account and select InHome preferences to get started.   

Membership Fees 

The InHome fee is in addition to your Walmart+ membership fee. InHome charges on the same day as your Walmart+ membership. You may see prorated charges if you add the InHome Plus Up after you sign up for Walmart+. 

  • Annual: $40/year (Saves you $44/year)
    • $138/year with Walmart+
  •  Monthly: $7/month 
    • $19.95/month with Walmart+ 

Sign Up

If you already have a Walmart+ membership, you can add on InHome at any time. If you don’t have Walmart+ already, you’ll need to sign up by visiting Walmart+ InHome or in the Walmart app.

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Walmart+.
  4. Select Manage Membership.
  5. Select Explore Plus Ups.
  6. Select the checkbox next to InHome.
  7. Select Review changes.
  8. Select Start InHome membership.

Pause Membership

You can temporarily pause your Walmart+ InHome membership. We won’t bill you while your membership is on pause, however you won’t have access to any member benefits until your membership resumes. 

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. Select Walmart+.
  3. Select Manage Membership.
  4. Select Manage by Walmart+ Plan.
  5. Select Pause Membership.

You can undo a paused membership if it’s before the end of the current billing cycle, in which case you’ll be billed for your membership in the usual course.

Your billing date must match your Walmart+ membership to be able to pause Walmart+ and InHome.

Cancel InHome Plus Up

You can cancel InHome at any time. When you cancel, your InHome benefits will continue until the end of your billing cycle.

To cancel your InHome Plus Up plan, please visit My Account and select Cancel InHome under Your Plus Ups.

This will only cancel InHome; your Walmart+ membership will remain active. To cancel your full membership, see Manage Walmart+ Membership.

Reactivate InHome Plus Up

If you change your mind about cancelling the InHome portion of your Walmart+ membership before the end of your billing cycle:

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Walmart+.
  4. Select Manage Membership.
  5. Select Manage by Plus Ups.
  6. Select the Reactivate button.

For more information about InHome, see the InHome FAQ.

InHome Returns Pick-Up

Walmart+ InHome members can start a return and have items picked up from their home. 

Return from Home Pickup

To initiate a return from home:

  1. When you’re logged into Walmart.com select Account.
  2. Select Purchase History and locate the order with the item(s) you want to return.
  3. Select Start a Return and place a checkmark next to the item(s) you wish to return. 
    1. Only eligible items will be available to return. Some restrictions apply – See Return pick up policy underTerms of Use.
  4. Select the reason you’d like to return and add comments. (optional)
    1. Repeat the above steps if you’re returning more than one item.
  5. Select the From Home option.
  6. Once From Home is selected, the member will see one or both the options below:
    • Return from Home pickup options
    • Some InHome members may see only the FedEx Pickup option.
  7. Select date & time of pickup.
  8. Select the above as per your choice, review your return. 
    • If everything is correct, select Submit.

Cancel Return Pickup

To cancel return pickup:

  1. When you’re logged into Walmart.com select Account.
  2. Select Purchase History and locate the order with the item(s) that you set up the return for.
  3. Select Cancel return.

For more information about InHome, see the InHome FAQ. 

On Pickup Day

If FedEx pick up is selected:

  1. Print the FedEx return label from the app, website, or return confirmation email.
  2. Package the item and attach the return label.
  3. Leave the package outside for pickup on the scheduled date. No need to be home for pickup.

For non-FedEx return option:

  1. You are not required to pack the item in a box.
  2. Show the bar code to the delivery driver when they arrive and hand them the item(s).
  3. You must be home to hand off the return.

Find Your Return Label

If a member cannot find their return label:

  • Please find the return label under order details in the Walmart app or website, or
  • Check their return confirmation email.

Delayed or Canceled InHome Delivery Orders

If there’s a delay with your InHome delivery, you may get an email, text message, or push notification inviting you to:

  • Reschedule your InHome delivery.
  • Switch it to pickup.
  • Cancel your InHome delivery.

If your InHome order is canceled, we won’t charge you for the order.

Doorstep Delivery

Follow these steps to set up doorstep delivery:

  1. Open the Walmart app and select your Account.
  2. Select the gear-icon on the top right to open Account settings.
  3. Select Addresses.
  4. Select InHome preferences on the address you want to set up doorstep delivery for.
  5. Under Delivery location, Select Doorstep. 

If you want to add additional instructions for your InHome orders, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Walmart app and select your Account.
  2. Select the gear-icon on the top right to open Account settings.
  3. Select Addresses.
  4. Select InHome preferences on the address you want to update instructions for.
  5. Under Delivery instructions, select Add instructions or gate code.
  6. Select Property type (optional).
  7. Enter the gate code or call box code if you live in a gated community.
  8. Enter any specific delivery instructions you want Walmart associate to follow.
  9. Select Finish Set Up.

You can also set up this delivery preference during the checkout process when you’re placing an InHome order. Select Edit on the Review Order page to open InHome preferences.

Appliance Delivery Frequently Asked Questions

What steps should I take to ensure the installation goes smoothly?

Ensure you have measured, and your appliance fits in the required space. Make sure the unloading zone is clear and easily accessible, with no obstacles blocking the installation area. Additionally, an adult, 18 years or older, must be present at the time of delivery.

What should I do if my new appliance is damaged or not functioning properly upon delivery?

Ensure you inspect and test the appliance before the delivery agent leaves. If you spot any damage or if the appliance isn’t functioning properly, address the issue with the delivery agent right away. You must request a return within 48 hours of delivery. If you notice any defects or damage after the 48-hour return window, please refer to the manufacturer’s warranty.

What could lead to my delivery getting delayed or rescheduled?

For a successful installation, ensure that all electrical outlets, water and gas shutoff valves, and cabinetry meet appliance requirements and comply with local codes.

Are built-in appliances included in installation?

Certain appliances are eligible for built-in installation but not all.

Can the delivery agents connect gas appliances to propane hookups?

No, delivery agents can’t connect gas appliances to propane. Agents aren’t licensed to install liquid propane or convert gas appliances to propane.

What if I become unavailable for my delivery?

Ask RXO to reschedule your delivery.

Marketplace Item Conditions - Books

Marketplace sellers must list the condition of the books they’re selling on Walmart.com when they create a listing.

Items Listed as New

  • New: The book is new, unread, and unused in perfect condition and includes all supplemental materials (E.g., digital codes for textbooks).

Items Listed as Pre-Owned

  • Like New: The book appears new but has been read with very minimal signs of use. The cover has no visible wear. If applicable, hard covers come with their dust jacket. 
    • Item has no missing or damaged pages, no creases or tears, and no markings such as underlining, highlighting, or writing in margins.
    • Pre-Owned textbooks don’t require the inclusion of supplemental materials.
  • Good: Book has been read and shows minimal signs of wear like an owner’s inscription or discoloration, but no tearing and all pages are present.
    • Pre-Owned textbooks don’t require the inclusion of supplemental materials.
  • Fair: The book has possible discoloration, creasing, or small tears, and may not contain non-vital pages like endpapers but its integrity is still intact.
    • There may be underlining and highlighting of text and writing in the margins.
    • Pre-Owned textbooks do not require the inclusion of supplemental materials.

Marketplace Item Conditions - Fashion

Marketplace sellers must list the condition of the Fashion items they’re selling on Walmart.com when they create a listing.

Items Listed as New

  • New: Brand new with tags and labels still attached or in the original box or packaging (With box or tags).
  • New without Box (or) Tags: Brand-new and unused but without original boxes, packaging or tags attached.
  • New with Defects: Brand-new, unused, and functional but with cosmetic imperfections caused during production or delivery.
    • This could include missing threads, discoloration, scuffing, scratches, label malfunction, etc. 

Items Listed as Pre-Owned

  • Like New: Excellent condition but has been gently used or worn previously.
    • Tags, dust bags, pouches, and/or labels may not be attached to fashion items.
  • Good: Good condition with signs of wear or usage (may have scuffs, creasing, small tears, odor, minimal discoloration, slight pilling marks, fading, stains or scratches).
    • Tags, dust bags, pouches, and/or labels may not be attached to fashion items.
  • Fair: Fair condition with visible signs of wear or usage (which can include scuffs, creasing, marks, tears, odor, discoloration, defects, scratches, fading, missing parts and accessories).
    • Tags, dust bags, pouch, and/ or labels may not be attached. Notable signs of flaws are declared in listing.
    • May be missing accessories. 
    • Signs of wear on the item can include scuffs, marks, stains, scratches, fading or missing parts and accessories.

Marketplace Item Conditions - Home

Marketplace sellers must list the condition of the home items they’re selling on Walmart.com when they create a listing.

Items Listed as New

  • New: A brand-new, unused, unopened, undamaged item in the original packaging.
    • Must also be factory sealed, with tags (and include warranties and instructions for appropriate categories).
  • New without Box (or) Tags: Brand-new and unused but without original packaging or tags.
    • Original accessories are included.
    • Instructions may not be included. 
  • New with Defects: Brand new, unused, and functional but with cosmetic imperfections caused during production or delivery.
    • This could include missing threads, discoloration, label malfunction, etc.
    • Instructions and accessories are included. 

Items Listed as Restored

  • Like New: “Like-new” condition with very light micro-scratches, invisible at a distance of 8-12 inches (arm’s length). 
    • Battery life, if applicable, must be 80% of the “like-new” equivalent or higher.
    • At least 90-days free returns.   
  • Good: The item has slight signs of wear/use, including small scuffs, marks, scratches. barely visible when holding the product 12 inches away, and imperceptible to touch.
    • Battery life, if applicable, must be 80% of the “like-new” equivalent or higher. 
    • At least 90-days free returns. 
  • Fair: Item may have visible signs of wear/use, including more significant scratches or marks, visible when holding the product 12 inches away, and perceptible to touch.
    • Battery life, if applicable, must be 80% of the “like-new” equivalent or higher.
    • At least 90-days free returns.

Items Listed as Pre-Owned

  • Like New: Perfect working condition with no signs of wear or usage.
    • Instructions are included for appropriate categories, and the item includes all product accessories and original packaging. 
  • Good: Functions properly and has minimal signs of wear or usage (may have small scuffs, marks, or scratches).
    • Instructions are included for appropriate categories.
  • Fair: Functions properly and has visible signs of wear or usage (which can include scratches, fading, scuffs, marks, and/or missing parts and accessories).
    • Instructions may not be included. 

Marketplace Item Conditions - Overview

Marketplace sellers must list the condition of the items they’re selling on Walmart.com when they create a listing.

You can see these item conditions while shopping on Walmart.com and the app.

What is a Condition Type?

A condition refers to the state of an item including the level of wear, prior use (if any), appearance, and overall quality.

Condition Type Eligibility

Availability of condition types may vary by product/category as well as the seller eligibility per program.

  • Walmart currently has two programs:
    • Walmart Pre-Owned
    • Walmart Restored

Marketplace Item Conditions - Toys, Celebration, Occasion & Seasonal

Marketplace sellers must list the condition of the Toys, Celebration, Occasion and Seasonal items they’re selling on Walmart.com when they create a listing.

Items Listed as New

  • New: Brand new, unused, unopened, undamaged and in its original packaging.
    • Must be factory sealed with tags (and includes warranties and instructions for appropriate categories). 
  • New without Box (or) Tags: Brand-new and unused but without original packaging or tags.
    • Original accessories are included. Instructions may not be included. 
  • New with Defects: Brand new, unused, and functional but with cosmetic imperfections caused during production or delivery.
    • This could include missing threads, discoloration, label malfunction, etc.
    • Original packaging or repacking is required.
    • Instructions must be included.

Items Listed as Open Box

  • Open Box: Excellent unused condition with no signs of usage and still in its original packaging.
    • Packaging can be open or show signs of wear, but original accessories are included.
    • Instructions are included for appropriate products. 

Items Listed as Pre-Owned

  • Like New: Perfect condition with no signs of wear or usage. Item functions with no damage.
    • The original protective wrapping, if any, may be missing but the original packaging must be intact.
    • Instructions are included for appropriate products. 
  • Good: The item is well cared for with limited use, with minor cosmetic damage.
    • The item functions in proper working condition. Item instructions and original packaging may be included. 
  • Fair: The item shows obvious wear from consistent use but remains in working condition.
    • May be marked, identified, or show other signs of previous use or damage.
    • Original packaging and instructions are not included. 

Marketplace Item Conditions - Trading Cards

Marketplace sellers must list the condition of the trading cards they’re selling on Walmart.com when they create a listing.

Items Listed as New

  • New: Brand new, unused, unopened, undamaged and in its original packaging. Any item originating from an opened package must be assigned a condition rating; New isn’t applicable.

Items Listed as Graded

  • Graded: Professionally: Professionally graded, certified as genuine and meets industry grading values from a registered grading company.

Items Listed as Ungraded

  • Ungraded: Near mint Like new with minor surface indentations, scratches or wear at corners and edges. No discoloration, creases or staining.
  • Ungraded: Excellent: Minor to moderate wear such as minor discoloration, surface wrinkles and staining; and moderate edge chipping, indentations, corner wear and scratches.
  • Ungraded: Very good or good: A moderate to major amount of discoloration, chipping, indentation, creases or scratches. There may also be a slight paper loss.
  • Ungraded: Fair or poor: Major wear such as torn edges, extreme discoloration, multiple major scratches, and multiple creases and/or stains. There may also be missing corners.
  • Ungraded: Damaged: Imperfections beyond major signs of wear. This may include folds, creases, tears or other types of damage that impact the structural integrity of the card.

Marketplace Item Conditions – Automotive

Marketplace sellers must list the condition of the automotive items they’re selling on Walmart.com when they create a listing.

Items Listed as New

  • New: Brand-new, unused, unopened, undamaged item in the original packaging.
    • Must be factory sealed, with tags (and includes warranties and instructions for appropriate categories).
  • New without Box (or) Tags: Brand-new, unused item without the original packaging or tags.
    • Original accessories are included.
    • Instructions may not be included.
  • New with Defects: A brand-new, unused working item that has cosmetic defects caused during production or delivery.
    • This could include missing threads, discoloration, label malfunction, etc.
    • Instructions may not be included.

Items Listed as Remanufactured

  • A rebuilt automotive part that has been completely disassembled, cleaned, and examined for wear and breakage.
  • Worn out, missing, or non-functioning components have been replaced with new or rebuilt components.
  • It is the functional equivalent of a new part and is virtually indistinguishable from a new part that meets or exceeds original equipment (OE) specifications.
  • Instructions are included for appropriate categories. 

Items Listed as Open Box

  • Excellent condition with no signs of usage and should still be in its original packaging.
  • Packaging can be open or show signs of wear, but original accessories should also be included.
  • Instructions are included for appropriate categories. 

Items Listed as Restored

  • Like New: “Like-new” condition with very light micro-scratches, invisible at a distance of 8-12 inches (arm’s length). 
    • Battery life, if applicable, must be 80% of the “like-new” equivalent or higher. At least 90-days free returns. 
  • Good: The item has slight signs of wear/use, including small scuffs, marks, or scratches barely visible when holding the product 12 inches away, and imperceptible to touch.
    • Battery life, if applicable, must be 80% of the “like-new” equivalent or higher.
    • At least 90-days free returns.  
  • Fair: Item may have visible signs of wear/use, including more significant scratches or marks visible when holding the product 12 inches away, and perceptible to touch.
    • Battery life, if applicable, must be 80% of the “like-new” equivalent or higher. 
    • At least 90-days free returns.  
  • Premium: Eligibility is restricted to manufacturers, manufacturer-authorized or other qualifying sellers or suppliers. 
    • “Like-new” condition with very light micro-scratches, invisible at a distance of 8-12 inches (arm’s length). 
    • Battery life, if applicable, must be 90% of the “like new” equivalent or higher. 
    • A minimum one-year written warranty.30-days free returns and replacements, unless the item is otherwise excluded under the 15-day return window for certain electronics. 

Items Listed as Pre-Owned

  • Like New: Excellent working condition and comes from a low milage vehicle.
    • Item appears new with no obvious signs of being used. 
    • Instructions are included for appropriate categories.
  • Good: Functions properly, has limited signs of wear or usage and comes from the average milage vehicle for the vehicle model year.
    • Instructions are included for appropriate categories.
  • Fair: Functions properly, has visible signs of wear or usage and comes from a high-milage vehicle.
    • Instructions may not be included.

Marketplace Seller Reviews

Customers who purchased items online from a Marketplace Seller can leave a review for that seller. Reviews should be about the quality of service the seller provides and the customer’s experience with shipping and delivery.

Submit a product review

You’ll get an email inviting you to review the seller and the item a few weeks after your purchase. Use the links provided in the email to access the review forms.

In addition, you may also see special tags on item pages inviting you to buy and review these items.

  • Not everyone will see these tags.
  • If you buy one of these items, you must submit a review within the specified time to get the reward promo code.
  • You must review the items after they’re delivered to ensure that the reviews reflect your honest feedback about your experiences with the item.

Marketplace Seller review guidelines

Please keep in mind these guidelines when leaving a review for a Marketplace Seller. Clear and specific feedback ensures your review is posted for others’ benefit.

Reviews for Marketplace Sellers must be submitted in English and meet all of the following:

  • Focus solely on your experience with the seller, including
    • Delivery time
    • Shipping methods
    • Customer service
    • Remember the purpose of submitting a seller review is to provide insight for other customers who are considering purchasing from the same seller.
  • Give details about what you did or didn’t like about your experience.
  • Comply with our Terms of Use. 

We reserve the right not to post a review if it contains any of the following:

  • Any information not related to the Marketplace Seller
  • Obscenities
  • Offensive language
  • Other language not suitable for a public forum
  • Prices
  • Advertisements
  • Content considered as spam
  • References to other products
  • Offers
  • Websites
  • Competitors
  • Email addresses
  • Phone numbers
  • Links to websites
  • Physical addresses
  • Critical or spiteful comments about other reviews or reviewers
  • Reviews with no direct experience purchasing from the seller

You may rate a Marketplace Seller one time for each order you place with that seller. New reviews display on the website within 5-7 business days. If you’ve submitted a review recently, check back soon to see it posted to the site.

If you need to discuss your order with a Marketplace Seller, please contact them directly. Please don’t submit requests for assistance using this forum, Customer Care associates don’t monitor reviews and aren’t able to assist with requests made through this forum.

Marketplace Sellers on Walmart

Marketplace sellers offer more brands and wider selections for you. These sellers also accept eligible returns in our stores.

  • Only qualified businesses can sell on Walmart Marketplace.
  • Our selection process looks at the seller’s:
    • Catalog
    • Operations
    • Other business information

This helps us ensure sellers can give the same high-quality experiences to all our Walmart.com customers.

Walmart doesn’t share your financial information with any seller.

Walmart regularly monitors Marketplace seller performance

  • Sellers who give the best service earn a Pro Seller badge on the item page.
  • You can find the Sellers names next to the sold and shipped by label.

If Walmart fulfills your item:

The Marketplace seller keeps their inventory at Walmart fulfillment centers. Walmart will pick, pack, and ship the item(s).

From your Walmart account, you can:

  • Track items
  • View Returns/Replacements
  • View Refunds

Contact the seller with questions about:

  • Item specifications

  • Technical support

  • Any applicable warranties

  • Get Information about a Marketplace seller: 

    The seller of an item on Walmart.com will be indicated by the phrase, “Sold by” or “Sold and shipped by.”   You can see more information about a seller by clicking on the seller’s name.  Information about sellers of past purchases is available in your Walmart.com account. 

    Viewing seller information from a past order: 

    1. Log into your Walmart.com account. 
    2. Select Account. 
    3. In Purchase History, find the order. 
    4. Select View Details (next to order number and date). 
    5. On the Order Details page, select Contact Seller. 

If your item sold and shipped by a Marketplace seller:

  • You get the same secure checkout process and single payment that you have come to expect when shopping at Walmart.com.
  • Contact the seller directly for any problem with your order.
  • If the seller doesn’t solve your issue, Walmart Customer Care is available to help following the Walmart Marketplace Promise.
  • If you want to return an item sold and shipped by a Marketplace seller, you can return it to a Walmart store within 30 days (certain restrictions apply) without a box or shipping label. Please review the Marketplace Return Policy for more information.

Contacting a Seller

Contact the seller about your purchase from your account on Walmart.com using the Contact Seller link.

  • Sellers must respond to customers within 2 business days of receiving the message.
  • Walmart keeps copies of each email between you and the seller from your order details in your account. We will review them to resolve disputes, improve customer experience, and assess seller performance.

Benefits of contacting a seller directly:

  • By going through our website using the Contact Seller link, we create an encrypted email address for the seller to use to reach you.
  • The seller response will arrive in your own personal email account (Outlook, Gmail, etc.). You can reply directly to those messages. Customer Care agents can review the contact (if, on a rare occasion, any issues arise).

Contacting a seller from Your Account:

  1. Log into your Walmart.com account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. In Purchase History, find the order with the item you want to contact the seller about.
  4. Select View Details (next to order number and date).
  5. On the Order Details page, select Contact Seller. Note : “Contact Seller” option is unavailable for sellers who are not currently active on Walmart.com.  Customers can locate inactive seller contact information by clicking on the seller’s name on the Order Details page to contact the seller directly.  Contact Walmart Customer Care with any issues.

Walmart Marketplace Promise

This promise gives you peace of mind when buying items sold and shipped by our third-party sellers.

The promise applies in the following cases:

  • Two or more days have passed since the expected delivery date, and you haven’t received the item.
    • If you request a refund, we accept requests for 30 days after the last estimated delivery date of the item you ordered.
  • Tracking shows the item hasn’t shipped to the shipping address.
  • You received items(s) different than expected and the seller refused the return.
  • Your item returned with a trackable shipping method and the seller hasn’t issued you a refund within 2 business days of the receipt.
  • The seller has taken the cost of return shipping fees
  • The return was at the fault of the seller.

Walmart will contact the seller and give them the chance to make it right. The seller has 2 business days to find a satisfactory resolution. If you’re not satisfied, Walmart will step in and find the right final solution.

If a seller is not abiding by the Marketplace Seller Code of Conduct, please notify us using theReport Seller/Item Issue Form 

Walmart Marketplace Prohibited & Regulated Product Policy

Preparing for Your Major Appliance Delivery

Walmart uses RXO as a delivery partner to deliver and set up appliances bought through Walmart Marketplace.

Stress-Free Delivery Starts Here

You’ll get a text or phone call with a 4-hour delivery window the evening before your scheduled delivery.

Pre-delivery Checklist

  • An adult (18 years of age, or older) must be present for the delivery.
  • Measure all doorways, hallways, and stairways along the delivery path to ensure they’re wide enough for the appliance. The delivery team needs an unobstructed path at least 10 feet wide to make the delivery. RXO can remove doors when needed.
  • Measure the space for your appliance and review the appliance specifications on the product page to confirm it fits.
  • Remove all belongings from the old appliance.

Prepare the Delivery Area

  • Confirm there are no more than 3 flights of stairs to the installation area (unless an elevator is available).
  • Clear the indoor path to the installation spot. Remove rugs, furniture, and personal items.
  • Make sure the outdoor delivery path is free from snow and/or other obstacles.

Secure and Reliable Setup

The RXO delivery team will:

  • Unpack, inspect, and prepare new appliance(s) for service.
  • Install new appliance(s) in regulation to manufacturers specification.
    • Depending on local code, the delivery agent may need to schedule a second visit to complete the installation.
  • Level the appliance.
  • Test the appliance to ensure it functions and inspect it for any visible damage.

Before accepting delivery, please inspect major appliances (such as refrigerators, washers, dryers, ranges, dishwashers, and certain microwaves) for any defects or damage.

If you discover any defects or damage after accepting delivery, you may still return the product—just report the issue within 48 hours by reaching out to the seller via the Walmart app or Walmart.com. Please refer to our full returns policy for additional information.

Disposal and Debris Removal

The delivery team will remove and dispose of all packaging from your new appliance. If you selected the haul-away service, they’ll also move or take away your old appliance.

Report Marketplace Seller Activity

We want our customers to have confidence when you shop with our Marketplace sellers.

If you have questions about an order from a seller, please see Marketplace Sellers on Walmart.

There are a few ways to report issues with a Marketplace seller or item. 

Intellectual Property Rights Claims 

If you’re an authorized representative of a registered brand and if you believe there is a counterfeit product or other infringing content on Walmart.com, please notify us by using the Intellectual Property (IP) Claim Form or theBrand Portal. For more information on brand portal eligibility and features, please see the Brand Portal overview. 

Product Authenticity 

If you are not associated with a registered brand and you believe there is a counterfeit product or other infringing content on Walmart.com, please notify us by using the Report Seller/Item Issue Form. 

Incorrect Product Information 

If you wish to report a listing for a product that you believe is offensive, prohibited, misleading, potentially unsafe, or contains incorrect content please notify us by using the Report Seller/Item Issue Form. 

Stolen Goods 

The sale of stolen property violates the property rights of rightful owners and is illegal. Walmart strictly prohibits the sale of stolen goods on the marketplace. If you believe there is stolen property listed for sale on Walmart.com, please notify us using the Report Seller/Item Issue Form and report the activity to your local law enforcement agency.  

Ratings and Reviews  If a review contains offensive or inappropriate content, select Report next to the review. If the issue involves more than one review or relates to seller behavior, including concerns about review authenticity, seller requesting a customer update or change a review, or reviews that refer to incorrect items, submit a report using the Report Seller/Item Issue Form. 

Suspicious Marketplace Seller Activity 

If you see other unusual activity on Walmart Marketplace, please notify us using the Report Seller/Item Issue Form. 

TAKE IT DOWN Act Content Removal

Nonconsensual intimate images or videos, including digitally altered or AI-generated content depicting a person without their consent, is illegal. If you see such content appears a product listing, review, or other user-generated content, please follow the instructions noted under TAKE IT DOWN Act Removalto notify us through the Report Seller/Item Issue Form.

Reporting to Government Agencies 

Government agencies accept reports from consumers on the behavior of online sellers. See below or contact your local law enforcement agency. 

  • California Attorney General: Suspected criminal activity involving stolen goods can be reported to the California Office of the Attorney General using the Organized Retail Theft Webform.

TAKE IT DOWN Act Notice and Removal Request

Report Nonconsensual Content

Nonconsensual intimate images or videos, including digitally altered or AI-generated content depicting a person without their consent is illegal. Walmart prohibits sexually explicit content on the Marketplace. If you see a nonconsensual intimate image, video, or digitally altered/AI-generated content in a listing, review, or user generated content (UGC), please report it.

 Notification and Removal Process

We recognize this is a serious issue. In the report, it is important you provide thorough information where applicable, so we may review and action your request. Once submitted, we will review all submissions. Follow each step below: 

Gather information

First, identify all relevant details to help us locate and remove the image or video of concern. Examples of relevant details are: 

  •  Item name
  • Seller name
  • Creator handle
  • Page URL
  •  Image URL
  • Location of content on page

For help in locating the details above, refer to the FAQ section below.

Provide information

Second, input the gathered information:

  1. Launch the Report an Issue with this Seller form
  2. Under ‘Select the Category’, select Problem with Listing
  3. Under ‘What issue would you like to report?’, select There is an issue with product image(s)
  4. Check that you affirm you have a good faith belief the content was made available without consent of the identifiable individual
  5. Provide your electronic signature by entering your first and last name
  6. Input your email address
  7. Include all information you gathered in the Description of issue field. 
  8. Submit the request

Once submitted, your request will be reviewed, and appropriate action will be taken.

Frequently Asked Questions / TIPsQ: What is the Creator handle and where can I find it?

A: The text following the “@” symbol. This may be on the overlay in the bottom left corner of the content or displayed at the top of the Creator’s Storefront page.

Q: How do you copy and paste an item link while on mobile?

A: In your Walmart mobile app, tap the Share icon to highlight the page link, then select Copy. In the form, paste in the URL to the Description of issue field.

Q: Where can I launch the Report an Issue with this Seller form from?

A: If on item page, it will be located below the Seller’s name. If you select the Seller’s name to launch the Seller Information page, it will be under the About section. The link is also available on the Report Marketplace Seller Activity Help page, noted as the Report Seller/Item Issue Form.

Q: How can I locate an image URL?

A: Right click the image you need to report and select, copy image link or copy image address. The URL should start with i5.

Note: Copying an image link from the Walmart mobile app may not provide the image URL. To copy and paste an image URL, it is recommended to use the web version of the form to get the link.

Q: What are locations where content can appear?

A:  Locations include, but are not limited to, an item page image carousel, as an image within a review, on walmart.com homepage Creator sections, or on a Creator’s Storefront. 

Q:  What if the same image or video appears on multiple places?

A: We will make reasonable efforts to identify identical copies of reported content. However, if you

see identical copies of the image or video, submit one report and include details to help us locate every place it appears. Note that the image or video appears to be an identical copy across the included URLs.

Policies

Claims of Intellectual Property Infringement

IP Infringement Claims

Walmart respects the intellectual property (“IP”) rights of others and has set up the Brand Portal and the online IP Claim Form for owners of IP rights to report legitimate claims of infringement as to items listed on Walmart.com, including claims of copyright, trademark, patent, publicity and counterfeit. Walmart strives to promptly process and investigate such claims and take appropriate actions under applicable laws.

To make a claim of IP infringement, you will be required to declare, under penalty of perjury, that the information provided is correct and that you are the IP rights owner or an authorized agent. To understand what constitutes infringement, continue reading. To make an IP claim now, visit the Brand Portal or fill out the online IP Claim Form. If the information you submit is inaccurate or incomplete, we may be unable to process or respond to your request. If you have questions about IP or whether your rights have been infringed, consider seeking legal advice.

Copyright Claims

Copyright infringement is the unauthorized use of a creative work that is protected under state and/or federal copyright law. Examples of works protected under copyright law include photographs, videos, artwork and music. Pursuant to the Digital Millennium Copyright Act, Title 17, United States Code, Section 512(c)(2) (the “DMCA”), notifications of claimed copyright infringement should be made to Walmart’s “Designated Agent.” You may notify Walmart’s Designated Agent by using the Brand Portal or the IP Claim Form. Copyright protected content can be removed and/or disabled if it was utilized or disseminated by Walmart.com without proper permission from the copyright owner. Under the DMCA, claimants who make misrepresentations concerning copyright infringement may be liable for damages (including costs and attorneys’ fees) incurred by the alleged infringer or by Walmart, if injured by relying upon such misrepresentation in removing or disabling access to the material or activity claimed to be infringing.

If you received a DMCA notification and believe it was submitted in error, you may submit a counter notice to request that your listing be republished. The counter notice must contain all of the following information: 1) Contact Information – include name, email address, physical address and telephone number; 2) URL or other identifying information of material to be republished; 3) A statement under penalty of perjury that you have a good faith belief that the material was removed or disabled as a result of mistake or misidentification of the material to be removed or disabled; 4) A statement that you consent to the jurisdiction of Federal District Court for the judicial district in which your address is located and will accept service of process from the person who provided the DMCA notification or an agent of such person; and 5) A physical or electronic signature. Counter notices should be sent to the following email address: ipinvest@walmart.com.

Trademark Claims

A trademark is a word, phrase, symbol or design that identifies and distinguishes the source of goods or services of one party from those of others. Under United States trademark law, a trademark owner has the right to prevent competitors from using its trademark if the use would cause a likelihood of confusion. If you believe that your registered trademark has been infringed, please notify Walmart by using the Brand Portal or the IP Claim Form. Note that Walmart does not mediate trademark disputes between third parties and trademark owners. Rather, Walmart will forward the trademark claim to the third party before taking any action, with the intent that the third party and trademark owner will resolve between themselves any dispute over ownership rights and infringement. Walmart reserves the right to remove any content that is found to infringe the rights of a trademark owner.

Counterfeit Claims

Counterfeit goods are inauthentic items that are intended to appear authentic. If you believe that a counterfeit of your product is accessible or being sold on Walmart.com, please notify us by using the Brand Portal or the IP Claim Form. Select the counterfeit reporting option. Walmart reserves the right to remove any content it believes to be counterfeit and further reserves the right to take any additional measures it deems appropriate in handling a claim of counterfeit goods.

Patent Claims

A patent is a grant from the United States Patent Office that gives the holder exclusive right to its article of manufacture. If you believe that your patent has been infringed under United States patent law, please notify Walmart by using the Brand Portal and the IP Claim Form. Note that Walmart does not mediate patent disputes between third parties and patent owners. Rather, Walmart will forward the claim to the third party with the intent that the third party and patent owner will resolve between themselves any dispute over ownership rights and infringement. Walmart reserves the right to remove any content that is found to infringe the rights of a patent owner.

Repeat Infringer Policy

Walmart takes appropriate action against parties it categorizes as repeat infringers. A repeat infringer includes, but is not limited to, anyone who qualifies as such under the DMCA or who receives multiple claims of IP infringement and such claims are determined by Walmart to be valid. Action may include, but is not limited to, removal of listings and suspension or termination of any relationship with Walmart.

What is Not Enforced

Although a manufacturer may enter into an exclusive distribution agreement with a seller of a product, violations of such an agreement are not the subject of IP infringement. Under the IP laws of the United States, rights owners may lose their rights to prevent the further sale of a product after the “first sale” by the manufacturer. Therefore, the enforcement of exclusive distribution agreements is a matter between the manufacturer and its retailers, and Walmart will not take action to enforce such agreements.

Electronic Waste Recycling

Walmart partners with Manufacturers Recycling Management (MRM) for recycling used electronics in a number of states. Visit mrmrecycling.com/recycle-now.php to learn how you can recycle your used electronics.

Select here to view MRM’s Virginia Annual Report and recycled pound collection amounts for computer equipment. Please note this form applies only to computer equipment.

In Wisconsin, most consumer electronics, including cellphones, computers, monitors, printers, tablets, TVs, and video game consoles may not be thrown away. These electronics can be recycled but cannot go into recycling bins or carts. To find electronics collection sites and events in your area, visit MRM at 0 or the Department of Natural Resources E-Cycle Wisconsin at 1.

How to Recycle Electronic Devices in New Jersey

Walmart works with MRM to collect all covered electronic devices from consumers in New Jersey (including desktop or personal computer, computer monitor, portable computer, desktop printer, desktop fax machine, or television).  To find a convenient site near you, please go to www.mrmrecycling.com to find recycling locations, hours, and any limitations on collections. Under the New Jersey Electronic Waste Management Act, the cost to recycle covered electronic devices shall not be passed on to consumers. 

 For additional information on the New Jersey e-waste program, please go to 0  “Consumer” means a person, small business enterprise, State entity, school district, or local government unit that purchases a covered electronic device in a retail sale. Consumer does not include any business concern that purchases a covered electronic device.

“Covered electronic device” or “CED” means a desktop or personal computer, computer monitor, portable computer, desktop printer, desktop fax machine, or television sold to a consumer. A covered electronic device does not include any of the following: 1. An electronic device that is a part of a motor vehicle or any component part of a motor vehicle assembled by, or for, a vehicle manufacturer or franchised dealer, including a replacement part for use in a motor vehicle; 2. An electronic device that is functionally or physically a part of a larger piece of equipment designed and intended for use in an industrial, commercial, or medical setting, including diagnostic, monitoring, or control equipment; 3. An electronic device that is contained within a clothes washer, clothes dryer, refrigerator, refrigerator and freezer, microwave oven, conventional oven or range, dishwasher, room air conditioner, dehumidifier, or air purifier; or 4. A handheld device used to access commercial mobile data service or commercial mobile radio service, as such services are defined at 47 CFR 20.3.

New Jersey consumers who are not able to bring a covered electronic device to a collection site, or those with bulky covered electronic devices, are eligible for free pickup services. Please reach out to MRM at  www.mrmrecycling.com for more information.

Responsible Disclosure and Accessibility Policies

Responsible Disclosure Policy

Walmart Accessibility Policy

Walmart is committed to making our website accessible for all customers, including those with disabilities.

Consistent with this goal, we have taken several steps to enhance our site and increase its usability by those who access the web using assistive technology. Our efforts are guided by the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, version 2.1, Level AA (WCAG 2.1 AA). We will continue to enhance our digital properties to deliver accessible experiences.

If you experience difficulty accessing our website content, reach out to our Customer Care associates at 1-800-966-6546 for assistance and to provide feedback. For relay service, please dial 711.

Single-Use Bag Policy

What is Walmart’s single-use bag policy in my state?

  • Connecticut, Colorado, Delaware, Maine, New York, Rhode Island, Washington D.C., Washington, Vermont: Single-use bags are not available for pickup so please bring your own reusable bags or buy them at checkout. Deliveries will be fulfilled in paper bags or reusable bags charged to the customer.
  • Hawaii: Single-use bags are not available in Walmart stores or for pickup, so please bring your own reusable bags or buy them at checkout. Deliveries will be fulfilled in paper bags. 
  • New Jersey: Single-use bags are not available in Walmart stores or for pickup. Please bring your own reusable bags or buy them at checkout. For delivery, you can opt out of reusable bags when finalizing your purchase. Please leave totes or reusable bags at your doorstep if you opt out of buying more reusable bags.
  • All states: Bags will continue to be used as needed for raw meats/proteins, produce, and chemicals to ensure food safety and prevent cross contamination.

Is there a bag fee associated with my order?

Certain states or local municipalities may charge bag fees to encourage the use of reusable bags. Bag fees may vary by city, county, or state. Cities or counties may charge bag fees that aren’t included here.

  • California
  • Colorado
  • Connecticut
  • Maine
  • New York
  • Oregon
  • Vermont
  • Washington
  • Washington, D.C.

New Bag Policy in Pittsburgh, PA

Starting October 14, 2023, Pittsburgh, PA has a new law banning single-use plastic bags and requires a $0.10 fee per bag. This affects deliveries from five nearby stores (2281, 2300, 2588, 5040, 5381) to the city. For pickup orders, we’ll use paper bags, and customers can choose to opt-in/out with no fee at checkout. Delivery orders will be received in paper bags with a $0.10 fee per bag. There won’t be any changes for in-store shopping, as our stores can still use plastic bags for in-store shopping.

New Jersey Bag Ban Common Questions

Will I be charged for the reusable bags that my order is delivered in?

Walmart has provided free reusable bags in New Jersey while customers, the state legislation, and other retailers adjust to this new law. If you opt out of buying more reusable bags, please leave totes or reusable bags at your doorstep.

What are single-use carryout bags?

The State of New Jersey defines single-use carryout bags as ones made of paper or plastic that are not reusable. Learn more at NJ Bag Ban.

Why is there a ban on single-use bags in New Jersey?

The State of New Jersey passed this legislation in response to the growing problem of plastic pollution.

My local government previously enacted a bag ban and my store bagged online orders in paper bags. Why can’t they do that anymore?

The State of New Jersey’s bag ban supersedes all previously enacted bag ordinances, making its requirements uniform statewide. Paper bags, along with single-use plastic bags, are banned in New Jersey for this reason.

I order deliveries through other third-party delivery services. Why is their policy different?

Third-party delivery services are developing their own New Jersey bag ban guidelines. For Walmart, compliance and commitment to the environment are equally important components in our efforts to reduce our dependence on single-use plastic.

How do I prepare for an unattended/contactless delivery?

Please leave a container (tote, box, reusable bags, etc.) at the delivery location. Update the delivery instructions with instructions on where to leave the order. This will assist the delivery driver and ensure a safe delivery.

Where can I find more information?

Please visit New Jersey’s Get Past Plastic website. If you have questions or comments on this law, New Jersey has provided email address singleuseplastics@dep.nj.gov and phone number (609) 984-4250 for contacts.
