Walmart reserves the right to update or modify the terms of this policy at any time.

Registry

Adding and Managing Gift Registry or Wishlist Items

Adding Items

You can add items to a registry or Wishlist:

  • In-store
  • On the app or Walmart.com
  • From the registry or wishlist page

In-Store

You must have the Walmart app on your mobile device to add items in-store. When you find an in-store item you want to add:

  1. Open the Walmart app.
  2. Select the scan icon in the search box.
  3. Scan the UPC barcode on the item.
    • Select Add to Registry or Add to Wishlist on the item page.
  4. Select the registry or wishlist you want to add the item to.
  5. Select Save.

On the app or Walmart.com

  1. Go to an item page.
  2. Select the Add to Registry or Add to Wishlist button.
  3. Select the registry or wishlist you want to add the item to.
  4. Select Save.

From the Registry Page

  1. Go to the registry landing page.
  2. Select the Explore tab.
    • Select the Checklist tab to explore categories of popular items.
  3. Scroll to view popular items and categories.
  4. Select the Add to Registry button.

Items you’ve added will show Added to Registry.

From the Wishlist Page

  1. Go to the Wishlist landing page.
  2. Select the Explore tab.
  3. Scroll to view categories and popular items.
  4. Select an item to go to the item page.
  5. Select the Add to Wishlist button.

Items you’ve added will show as Added to Wishlist.

Managing and Removing Items

Gift registry and wishlist owners can modify items and quantities or mark something as purchased.

Gift Registries

From Walmart.com or the Walmart app:

  1. Select Registry at the top of the page.
  2. Select the Manage now button under Manage your registry.
  3. Select the gift registry you want to manage.
  4. Find the item you want to manage in the registry.

Select the Remove link to remove the item from your registry.

Select the Manage link to update the quantity needed or to mark the item as purchased.

Wishlists

From Walmart.com or the Walmart app:

  1. Select My Items at the top of the page.
  2. Select Lists.
  3. Select the wishlist you want to manage.
  4. Find the item you want to manage in the wishlist.

Select the Remove link to remove the item from your wishlist.

Select the Manage link to update the quantity needed or to mark the item as purchased.

Creating a Gift Registry or Wishlist

Gift registries and wishlists let event organizers create a list of needed gifts/items for an event or occasion. You can create the following types of gift registries at Walmart:

  • Baby
  • Wedding
  • Classroom
  • Spark Good
  • Wishlist
    • Any Occasion registries are now Wishlists.

Gift registries expire after 2 years of inactivity.

Creating a Registry

  1. Sign into Walmart.com
  2. Select Registry from the menu at the top of the page.
    • You can also select Services > Registry, Lists, & Gifts > Registries.
  3. Select the Manage now button under Manage your registry.
  4. Select the Create a registry button.
  5. Select the type of registry you want to create:
    • Baby
    • Wedding
    • Classroom
    • Spark Good Registry
  6. Enter the details.
  7. Select the event date.
  8. Select where you’d like to receive the gifts for shipped items.
  9. Select whether the registry is public or private.
    • Private registries won’t show up in searches. You’ll have to share the link with family and friends.
  10. Add items to your registry.
    • See Adding Items to a Registry or Wishlist.

Creating a Wishlist

Wishlists let you create a list of gift ideas for holidays, birthdays, or any occasion. You can share your wishlist with friends and family members. Friends and family members can purchase items on the list, mark them as purchased, and have the item shipped directly to you.

From the Walmart app or walmart.com:

  1. Select My Items.
  2. Select Lists.
  3. Select the Create a wishlist button.
  4. Give your wishlist a name.
  5. Add the date of the event.
  6. Add items to your wishlist.
    • See Adding Items to a Registry or Wishlist.

Managing a Gift Registry or Wishlist

Managing a Gift Registry

From Walmart.com or the Walmart app:

  1. Select Registry from the menu at the top of the page.
    • You can also select Services > Registry, Lists, & Gifts > Registries.
  2. Select the Manage now button under Manage your registry.
  3. Select the registry you want to manage.
  4. Select the Manage button.
    • Select the pencil in the Walmart app.

You can make changes to the registry information including:

  • Name
  • Registry Name
  • Event Date
  • Location
  • Make the registry public
    • Selecting the box to make your registry public allows people to search for it.
  • Shipping Address

Select the Save button when you finish making changes. Select the Delete this registry link to delete the registry.

You can share your registry with friends and family. To share your registry:

  1. Select Registry.
  2. Select Manage Now under Manage your registry.
  3. Select your registry.
  4. Select the Share button.
  5. Select how you’d like to share your wishlist.
    • Copy URL
    • Facebook
    • Twitter
    • Email

Managing a Wishlist

From Walmart.com or the Walmart app:

  1. Select My Items.
  2. Select the Lists.
  3. Select the Wishlist you want to manage.
  4. Select the Manage button.
    • Select the pencil in the Walmart app.

You can make changes to the wishlist information including:

  • Wishlist Name
  • Event Date
  • Location
  • Shipping Address

Select the Save button when you finish making changes. Select the Delete this wishlist link to delete the wishlist.

You can share your wishlist, but friends and family can’t search for it like a gift registry.

To share your wishlist:

  1. Select My Items.
  2. Select Lists.
  3. Select your wishlist.
  4. Select the Share button.
  5. Select how you’d like to share your wishlist
    • Copy URL
    • Facebook
    • Twitter
    • Email

Marking an Item as Purchased for Gift Givers

You can mark a gift registry or wishlist item as purchased without contacting the registry or wishlist owner.

Marking an Item as Purchased

From Walmart.com or the Walmart app:

  1. Go to the Registry or Wishlist.
    • See Finding a Gift Registry.
    • Select the wishlist link from the wishlist owner.
  2. Find the item you purchased.
  3. Select Mark as Purchased.
  4. Enter the details:
    • Purchased quantity
    • Who the gift is from
    • Where you purchased the item.
  5. Select Mark as Purchased to complete the entry.

Where You Purchased the Item

You don’t have to purchase gift registry or wishlist items from Walmart. You can select other retailers from a drop-down menu when marking the item as purchased.

If you choose Walmart, you can enter the TC number from your in-store receipt or your walmart.com order number.

TC Number

The TC number is a 16-digit number on the receipt near the barcode.

Walmart.com Order Number

The order number is in your purchase history.

Spark Good Registry

The Spark Good Registry lets you support your favorite charities in two ways:

  • Donate change by rounding up your purchase during checkout on Walmart.com.
  • Shop a wish list from a nonprofit’s registry and have the items shipped straight to them.

How to Find a Spark Good Registry

From the Walmart.com website or app:

  1. Select Registry.
    • Website: look at the menu across the top of the page.
    • App: look at the menu across the bottom of the screen.
  2. Go to the Find a Registry section and select Support a local cause or find a nonprofit organization.
  3. Go to the Find a local charity section and:
    • Search for a charity or nonprofit by location, type, or cause.
    • Select a charity or nonprofit from the list.

Walmart Private Brands: Product Feedback and Satisfaction Guarantee

Walmart offers a variety of private brands, including Great Value, bettergoods, Equate, Mainstays, and Marketside.

If you have questions, feedback, or concerns about a Walmart-branded product, we are here to help.

 

Walmart Satisfaction Guarantee

Many Walmart private-brand products are covered by Walmart’s Satisfaction Guarantee.

If you are not satisfied with an eligible product that has been used or consumed, you may qualify for assistance under the Satisfaction Guarantee.

For questions about Walmart’s Satisfaction Guarantee for private-brand products, contact: Satisfaction Guarantee Hotline: 888-287-1915

The Satisfaction Guarantee team can assist with:

  • Product satisfaction concerns
  • Quality-related complaints
  • Eligible refund or replacement inquiries
  • Questions about Walmart private-brand products

Before You Contact Us

To help you get the right support:

  • If the product is unopened, take it to the local Walmart store for a refund or exchange.
  • If the product has already been used or consumed and the customer is not satisfied, they may be eligible for assistance under the Walmart Satisfaction Guarantee.
  • Products that are expired or past their Use By or Best If Used By date are not eligible.
  • Some products may have specific satisfaction guarantee information printed on the packaging.
  • Return decisions made by store management cannot be changed by Customer Care.

Frequently Asked Questions on Walmart Satisfaction Guarantee

How Do I Share Feedback About a Walmart-Branded Product?

You can submit feedback through the Store Feedback page:

0

When submitting feedback, include:

  • Product name
  • Product size or variety
  • UPC or barcode number, if available
  • Date of purchase
  • Store location or order number
  • Details about the experience
I Have a Concern About a Walmart-Branded Product. What Should I Do?

If you have concerns about a product’s quality, packaging, ingredients, performance, or overall experience, they can:

  • Submit feedback through the Store Feedback page.
  • Visit their local Walmart store if the item may be eligible for a return or exchange.
Can I return an unopened product?

Yes. Unopened products should be returned to a Walmart store for a refund or exchange, subject to Walmart’s return policy and store review.

Can I receive assistance for a product I already used or consumed?

Many eligible Walmart private-brand products are covered by the Satisfaction Guarantee. If you are not satisfied with an eligible product that has been used or consumed, you may qualify for assistance. Go to your nearest Walmart Store and talk to Store Manager to know the full details.

Can I receive assistance for an expired product?

No. The Satisfaction Guarantee does not apply to products that are past their Use By or Best If Used By date.

What if the product packaging includes different return or guarantee information?

Some products may have specific information printed on the packaging. Always review the packaging for return, guarantee, or product-specific instructions.

What if a store declines my return?

Store managers make return decisions based on Walmart’s return policies and the condition of the item. Walmart Customer Care cannot override a store manager’s decision.

I have a concern about the quality of a Walmart-branded product. What should I do?

If you have concerns about the quality, packaging, ingredients, performance, or overall experience with a Walmart private-brand product, you can submit feedback through the Store Feedback page or visit their local Walmart store to see if the item may be eligible for return or exchange.

Tips for Buying a Major Appliance

  • Research your options.
  • Measure the space at least twice and compare to dimensions included on the item page to ensure fit.
  • Make sure the space has the right utilities, voltage, and plug type for your appliance.
  • Buy any necessary accessories for installation/use (E.g., hoses, plugs, vents, etc.).
  • Develop a plan to assemble and install the item.
  • Share any special delivery instructions with the delivery carrier (where applicable).

Accepting a Major Appliance Delivery

Before accepting a major appliance delivery, you should inspect your appliance for defects/damage when it arrives.

  • If any damage exists, please notify the driver, ask for options, and/or refuse the delivery.
  • Discounts for defects/damage are at the MP seller’s discretion, we recommend refusing delivery to avoid further complications.

Returns and Refunds

You can get a full refund for an opened/installed major appliance within two days of delivery.

  • Start the return in the Walmart app or on our returns page.
    • Major appliances aren’t returnable to Walmart stores.

Opened/Installed Appliances

An open/installed product refers to an item that has been received, inspected, and signed for by you, and for which the packaging/seal has been broken. You should inspect your items before accepting delivery, signing for it, and before opening the item. If you notice any damage before accepting and signing, the delivery can be refused at no charge.

  • Exchanges and refunds can occur within the 2-day timeframe.
    • For the remaining 28 days returns/refunds for opened items are at the seller’s discretion and may be subject to additional fees.
    • Installed items cannot be returned and customers should defer to the manufacturer warranty.

Unopened Appliances

Major appliances that are unopened, undamaged, and uninstalled appliances in original factory sealed packaging.

  • You can return these items to the seller within 30 days of accepting delivery in the original manufacturer packaging.
    • Unopened/uninstalled major appliances are subject to a restocking fee of up to 20% after the two-day time frame.

Exceptions

  • You can return small or dorm size appliances and wine refrigerators within 90 days.
    • You can return them within 30 days of delivery if sold on Walmart MP.
  • Any custom or made-to-order items cannot be returned for refund or exchange.

Refunds

We refund Walmart.com returns to your original method of payment. Outbound shipping charges aren’t always refunded upon return.

Refund Timelines

  • Credit/Debit Card
    • Up to 7 business days
  • Pre-Paid Credit/Debit Card
    • Up to 30 business days
  • Walmart Gift Card
    • Up to 3 hours
  • PayPal
    • Up to 30 business days depending on your financial institution.
  • EBT/SNAP Card
    • Up to 3 hours
  • Healthy Benefits Plus OTC Card
    • Up to 5 business days
  • Third Party Gift Card
    • Up to 10 business days, can be longer if linked to an international bank.
  • Walmart Cash
    • Refer to Walmart Cash FAQs
  • Walmart Balance
    • Up to 3 hours

Debit or credit card

Debit and credit card refunds will be available in up to 7 business days.

If your purchase was made using a debit or credit card, we’ll issue the refund to that same card. If the original card is not present and isn’t available by scanning the receipt, your refund is processed onto a Walmart shopping card or gift card.

If your purchase was a debit transaction, we’ll place the refund on the debit card.

Return in-store items without a receipt

If you don’t have your receipt, show us your valid government-issued photo identification. We’ll accept your return if your identification information matches with the one stored in our secured database.

You can then choose to do one of the following:

  • Exchange the item with another item.
  • Get a Walmart gift card.
  • If available, send the item to the manufacturer for repair.

Find more information on how to submit a return.

Review our information on authorization holdsif your order was canceled or didn’t ship. 

What if I cancel my order?

If you cancel your order before your item ships, we release the authorization hold on your payment method.

If the item has already shipped, we are not able to cancel the order. You can return the item for a refund.

Start an Online Return

Once you decide to return an item, make sure the item can be returned by reviewing our return policy. 

Return Labels for Online Orders

When you start a return, you’ll receive an email with your return label. You can print your label directly from the email or from your Purchase History.

To print your label follow these steps:

  1. Select Purchase History in your account.
  2. Select View details for the item you want to return.
  3. Select Start a return.
  4. Place a checkmark next to the item(s) you wish to return and select Continue.
  5. Select the reason you’d like to return; select Next.
  6. Select if you would like a refund or a replacement of the item and select Next.
  7. Add comments (optional) and select Save, then select Continue.
    • Repeat steps 6 through 9 if you’re returning more than one item.
  8. Select the method you’d like to use for return, select Continue.
  9. Select Submit, if everything is correct.

Return methods

There are four methods to return items. You’ll see the options available for an item when you start your return:

No repackaging required by customer:

  • Return to a Walmart store: For most items, print the barcode displayed on the screen or take your return email with you to return your item to the store.

Repackaging required by customer:

  • Schedule for pickup: Have the item picked up from where it was delivered for return.
  • Return by mail: Print the return label displayed on the screen, attach it to your package, and drop your return off at USPS or FedEx.
  • Drop off at FedEx location: Repackage and bring your items to an eligible FedEx Office location. No label printing required. 

If your item is oversized or you can’t take it to your local carrier, contact customer care by selecting the Chat with us button.

International Returns

For orders returned from outside the United States, in-store returns are not available. Return drop-off locations and available methods may vary by country. Please refer to your order details or contact customer care for specific instructions.

Walmart Marketplace Return Policy

Although the returns policies for items sold and shipped by a Marketplace Seller may be different from Walmart’s return policies, we’ve set up certain minimum return standards to ensure a consistent customer experience. Review the following guidelines to confirm your return is eligible.

For details, see the official Returns Policy on our Corporate Returns Page.

Most Marketplace items may be returned within 30 days, with these exceptions:

Major Appliances (2 days):

  • Major/large appliances

Consumer Electronics (14 days):

  • Computers
  • Computer and video game hardware
  • Printers (excluding 3D printers)
  • Camcorders
  • Digital cameras
  • GPS units
  • Digital music players
  • Tablets
  • E-readers
  • Portable video players
  • Drones
  • Pre-paid and post-paid cell phones

Wireless Phones, Tablets, Laptops and other electronic devices: Before returning items on which you’ve saved personal information, erase this information completely by following manufacturer’s instructions. For further help on how to remove your personal information from the device, visit How To Remove Your Personal Information Before You Get Rid of Your Phone.

Luxury items (14 days):

  • New and preowned apparel above $300
  • Fine art
  • Loose gems and gemstones
  • Jewelry and watches above $300

Refunds

Refunds issued for the following scenarios are subject to recharge if Walmart or the seller can verify delivery or frequent abuse.

  • Lost items
  • Wrong item returned
  • Suspected fraudulent activity

Items that require age verification via a valid government issued identification, such as alcohol, may have a refund delay of up to ten business days.

Re-stocking fees

Please refer to the Marketplace Sellers Return Policy for details regarding refunds:

  • See return details on the items listing page.
  • Some sellers may have a possible restocking fee (up to 20%).
  • For items greater than $600, it is recommended to insure the item prior to return shipping.
  • You may reach out to a Marketplace seller directly regarding your order.

When you return an item shipped by a Marketplace seller to a store:

  • We’ll send your return item back to the Marketplace Return Center for processing.
    • Please allow up to two business days after dropping off your return at a store for tracking to be available.
  • Once the Marketplace Return Center receives your return item, we’ll process the refund within two business days.

When you initiate a return for an item shipped by a Marketplace seller online or through Walmart Customer Care:

  • We’ll process the refund when the carrier scans the return package.
  • Please allow up to two business days for tracking information from the carrier to update on the carrier’s website.

Duty and Import Fees:

Walmart, Sellers on Walmart.com or shipping carriers shall not contact you to pay any fees for delivery of your item after purchase. If you receive a request to pay any fees that are not part of your original order, please contact us on Chat for assistance. Any fees paid outside of Walmart to the carrier or seller will not be refundable by Walmart.

Walmart Marketplace Return Policy – Return Restrictions

Although the returns policies for items sold and shipped by a Marketplace (MP) Seller may be different from Walmart’s return policies, we have set up certain minimum return standards to ensure consistent customer experience. Review the following guidelines to confirm your return is eligible.

Our Refund and Exchange Exceptions

Your item may have return restrictions and/or special instructions (E.g., Certain MP items, freight/oversized/heavy items, luxury products, hazardous materials). Contact the Marketplace seller directly for these items. See below for more details or check our returns page.

  • Some MP items aren’t eligible for return to a Walmart store.
    • These are typically items that are:
      • Freight
      • Some Hazardous Material
      • Heavy
      • Luxury items
      • Odd-sized
      • Oversized
    • MP sellers are responsible for processing, shipping, returns, and customer service related to your Walmart MP order.
    • Use the MP seller’s instructions for return shipping for such items.
    • Hazmat items may have mail back restrictions.* Examples may include: 
      • Aerosols
      • Corrosive materials
      • Compressed gases
      • Household chemicals
      • Some items with lithium or lead acid batteries
    • Items that include a rechargeable battery (E.g., tools, drills, lawn equipment, laptops, etc.) must contain the original battery to qualify for a return.
  • Items that require assembly (E.g., indoor/outdoor furniture, grills, etc.) must be fully disassembled and re-packaged prior to returning to a store or FedEx location.
    • FedEx may decline service for unpackaged assembled items.

Final Sale Items are ineligible for a return, replacement, or refund

To help keep our customers and associates safe, Walmart and MP sellers won’t replace, accept returns, or provide refunds for:

  • Alcohol (Beer, Wine, Spirits)
  • Airsoft & Air Guns
  • Ammunition (including powder, pellets, primer
  • Archery Bows
  • BB Guns
  • Bear Spray
  • Collectibles (i.e., Labubu items)
  • Crossbows
  • Diabetic Supplies* (including meters, strips lancet devices & syringes)
  • Gas Powered Recreational Vehicles (e.g., Dirt Bikes, Mini-Bikes, Go-Carts, Scooters, Ride-ons, UTVs & ATVs)
  • Home Diagnostic Testing Kits (including COVID-19 tests)
  • Hygienic Medical Equipment (e.g., bedpans, bath seats, eye drop guides, opened/unsealed breast pumps, sitz baths)
  • Items containing pseudoephedrine, ephedrine, phenylpropanolamine
  • Firearms
  • Ovulation & Pregnancy Tests
  • Precious Metals (e.g., gold bars, coins, currency)
  • Prescription Medications and Devices
  • Pepper Spray
  • RV sewer lines, toilets, toilet bowls and urinals (used or installed)
  • Sex Toys & Vibrators
  • Special orders made through Walmart Business
  • Tires, Wheels, Rims, Snow Tires (used or mounted)
  • Tobacco Products
  • Trading cards (opened or unopened)
  • Vertical Bows

*Diabetic supplies and items covered by Medicare Part B that Medicare supplier standards deem substandard or unsuitable are returnable.

Other Service Items & Digital Products Ineligible for Return/Refund/Replacement

  • Gift cards
  • Prepaid cell phone cards
  • Prepaid gaming cards
  • Sim cards
  • Video game download cards
  • Video on demand

Unless specified, electronic games and software downloads aren’t returnable after purchase. If you didn’t get an email containing the code or are unable to redeem the code provided:

  1. Go to our Help Center.
  2. Scroll to the bottom of the page.
  3. Select Chat with us.

Hazardous materials

MP items shipped by a third-party seller that are hazmat may have special rules for returns. Some hazmat items may only be returned in stores, while others may require you to contact the MP seller directly for mail-back instructions. Please refer to the product detail page for the specific return policy or contact us on Chat for assistance.

Hazmat items may include:

  • Aerosols
  • Compressed Gases
  • Certain cosmetics or chemicals 
  • Flammable liquids
  • Other common items that include a lithium or lead acid battery (E.g., tools, drills, lawn equipment, laptops, etc.).
    • For more information about what may be considered hazmat, see the Department of Transportation’s hazmat items guidelines. 

Walmart Standard Return Policy

Returns are available for nearly everything Walmart sells. Your purchase history on Walmart.com displays the latest eligible date for a return or replacement. However, we recommend keeping track of all manufacturer packaging and your receipt for a minimum of 90 days after purchase.

Walmart’s policy applies to returnsof products purchased in Walmart U.S. stores, Walmart.com, Walmart Business, or from Marketplace sellers on Walmart.com.

Items purchased from dealers or resellers and not Walmart or Walmart.com directly aren’t eligible for return, refund, or exchange.

Returning items purchased on Walmart.com

You have 90 days after purchase or upon receipt to return most items unless noted in our exceptions. Items sold and shipped by a Marketplace seller may be returned within 30 days. To ensure your item may be returned, review the exceptions on our Corporate Return Policy page.

Find more details about Marketplace Returns.

For photo returns, visit our Walmart Photo help page.

In store purchases

You have 90 days after purchase or upon receipt to return most items unless noted in our exceptions. Most Consumer Electronics are returnable within 30 days. Wireless phones are returnable within 14 days. To ensure your in-store item may be returned, review the exceptions on our Corporate Return Policy page.

Extended holiday returns

Most items purchased in-store or online from October 1 through December 31 are returnable until January 31 Marketplace seller participation varies. See the Return Policy for details. 

Damaged or defective items

If an item you received from Walmart.com is damaged or defective, your item may be eligible to be returned by mail or returned to any Walmart store and may qualify for a refund or replacement. Please start your return in the Walmart app or online by going to your Purchase History.

Walmart Financial Services

Express Bill Payments and fees associated with Walmart Financial Services products are non-refundable.

For more information about non-refundable financial services visit the Return Policy page.

Apple Services Offer

The Apple Services Offer is no longer available when buying qualifying items in stores and is now only available when purchased online. If you purchased qualifying items in stores before this change, you can claim these offers until July 2026.

Enjoy a world of entertainment from Apple. When you buy select items on Walmart.com, or the Walmart app, you may be eligible for Apple Service free trials which could include:

  • Apple TV+ (up to 3 months)
  • Apple Music (up to 4 months)
  • Apple Fitness+ (up to 3 months)
  • Apple Arcade (up to 4 months)
  • Apple News (up to 3 months)
  • Apple Books (up to 3 books)

Eligibility

This offer is open to all Walmart customers, but there are restrictions.

You must:

  • Buy a qualifying item on Walmart.com or the Walmart app.
  • Be new to the Apple Service you’re trying to sign up for or have an expired account.
    • Example: You wouldn’t be eligible for a free trial of Apple Music if you’re a current Apple Music subscriber.

You can check your current Apple services subscriptions on your iOS device by going to: Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions

If you’re unsure, contact Apple Support to confirm if you’re eligible for the free trials.

How It Works

In-Store

  • If you purchased a qualifying product in a Walmart store before April 15, 2025, you’ll see a code on your receipt. Use the code at www.wmt-offer.com to get your Apple Services free trial.

Online

  • When you buy a qualifying product from Walmart.com or the Walmart app, you’ll see a code on your Order Details page and in the confirmation email.
    • You’ll only see the code after you receive your order.
    • Select Redeem Now and follow the prompts to get your Apple Services free trial.

Troubleshooting

  • Contact Apple Support for all issues with Apple Services.
  • If you bought an eligible item online and didn’t receive a code, check your email and Order Details page in your Purchase History.
  • If you still don’t have the code, or the code isn’t working, select the Chat with Us button at the bottom of the page to contact Customer Care.

Lost Receipt

If you paid with a credit card in the store and lost your receipt, you may be able to find it using the Receipt Lookup Tool.

Extra Savings

At Walmart, we believe our Every Day Low Prices are key to saving customers money so they can live better. Check out the benefits of our Walmart+ program for more ways to save.

Some Marketplace sellers may offer extra savings on select items.

On eligible items, you’ll see a special banner.

For items with a special banner that says Save an extra $(amount):

  1. Select the checkbox on the banner to use the discount.
    • To see the eligible savings amount and select the checkbox, you must be signed in.

The seller may limit the quantity you can purchase with a discount. If you’ve reached the limit, the banner will say Savings redeemed.

For items with a special banner than says Buy (quantity), save $(amount):

  1. Add the stated amount of eligible items from that Marketplace seller to your cart.
  2. Select the View other eligible items link in the banner to see and select more eligible items from that seller. You may be able to mix and match eligible items offering the same savings when they are sold by the same seller. 
  3. You’ll see the discount split between the items.
    • Example:
      • For Buy 2, save $9:
        • Item 1 may originally be $10, but show as $7 (a savings of $3).
        • Item 2 may originally be $20, but show as $14 (a savings of $6).
        • The total will reflect a discount of $9 savings when 2 eligible items are selected.
        • You’ll see the eligible discounts in the cart and they will be applied at checkout. 

For information about using printed manufacturer coupons, please review our Coupon Policy. 

Please note that all savings outlined are subject to the Walmart Terms of Use. For further details, please view the Walmart Terms of Use.

Find, Purchase and Send a Gift

You can easily send gifts to family and friends from Walmart.com

  • We send an email to your gift recipient that includes your personalized gift message and digital receipt. We’ll itemize the receipt and won’t include the price of the gift.
  • For pickup orders, you’ll receive an email, which includes a gift receipt you can share with the recipient.

Find gift-eligible items

Follow these steps to find items eligible for gifting:

  1. On the search results page, under the filter Gifting, select the Gift eligible checkbox. 
  2. Select an item you would like to gift.
  3. On the item page, you can confirm that the item is gift eligible by finding the gift icon and the label This item is gift eligible below the shipment options.
    • Some items may have a Packaging Note below the eligibility label.
      • Ships in the manufacturer’s original packaging, which may reveal the contents.
  4. Add the gift to your cart.

Will the gift arrive in a Walmart box?

  • Shipped from Walmart.com:
    • Will be packaged in a Walmart box when possible.
    • An item can’t be packaged in a Walmart box will be shipped in its original manufacturer box, which may reveal the contents.
  • Delivery from store and pickup items: no, these items won’t be packaged in a Walmart box, which may reveal the contents.

Checkout with gift-eligible items

  1. In cart, check the box labeled This order is a gift.
  2. Confirm pickup and delivery options. These options differ between delivery and pickup.

Delivery orders with gift-eligible items

  1. Enter and confirm the recipient’s delivery address.
  2. Enter and confirm the recipient’s email address.
    • You may enter your own email address if you don’t know the recipient’s email. However, this means the recipient won’t receive your customized gift message, which is the only way they’ll know who gave them a gift.
  3. Add a customized gift message.
  4. Select a payment method.
  5. Review and place the order.

We’ll send two emails to the email address you gave us for the recipient.

The first email includes:

  • Estimated delivery date
  • Gifter’s name
  • Tracking details (we won’t reveal the prices or items)

The second email includes:

  • Gifter’s name
  • Gift details
  • Instructions on returns
  • Link to start a return
  • Gift receipt (we’ll itemize the receipt and won’t include the price of the gift)

Pickup orderswith gift-eligible items

  • Only the person placing the order will receive emails.
    • No recipient emails or gift message.
  • When you place the order, you’ll receive a confirmation once the order is picked up. This email includes the gift receipt with instructions on returns.
    • You can share the email or gift receipt with the person you’re gifting.

Food Safety

Walmart ensures the safety of our food through:

  • Maintaining clean facilities
    • We have routine sanitation schedules for all facilities and equipment.
    • We have our stores regularly inspected by local, state, and federal agencies and third party food safety auditors.
  • Associate training which includes:
    • Understanding food safety and quality.
    • Maintaining required standards for hygiene, cleanliness, cooking, proper temperature control, and proper bagging.
    • Bagging raw proteins in meat bags separately from other foods. This aims to prevent cross-contamination.
    • Bagging chemicals separately from all foods.
    • Time and temperature requirements for food safety.
  • Proper product management
    • For recalled products, we:
      • Work quickly to block the item from selling.
      • Remove it from our store’s shelves (including pickup & delivery).

 

 

Visit our corporate site for more information about how recalled products impact our facilities.

Food Safety Tips

To keep your food safe and fresh:

  • Place all chilled and/or frozen products in the refrigerator or freezer as soon as possible.
    • If using contactless delivery, retrieve and stow your order as soon as possible.
  • Place raw meat and seafood on the bottom shelf.
    • Avoid direct contact of raw meats/seafood with ready-to-eat foods.
  • Always wash whole produce thoroughly before you eat it.
  • Thoroughly cook foods to a recommended, safe internal temperature.
  • Place any leftovers in the refrigerator within two hours of cooking.

Date Labeling

  • Best If Used By: This date shows when the item is at peak quality (as suggested by the product supplier/manufacturer).
    • While it’s not an expiration date, it’s a good indication of the quality of the product.
  • Use By or Freeze By: This date shows a product that is time or temperature-sensitive.
    • You should either use or place the product in your freezer by this date.

Fresh-sliced Deli Labels

  • You may see today’s date on a fresh-sliced deli meat or cheese item. This is the date the meat or cheese was sliced, not an expiration date.

Online Vision Center Orders

You can now order glasses and frames on Walmart.com and contacts on Walmartcontacts.com! We ship the items to your home, and they arrive within 7-14 business days.

Placing an Order

  1. Login into your Walmart.com account.
  2. Search for eyeglasses and add your frames to the cart.
  3. Select Options to customize. 
    • Selecting eligible frames will show the prompt Make these frames your own.
  4. Select the prescription type, materials, and lens add-ons.
  5. Review your selection and select Add prescription. 
    • You’ll see a prompt to sign in (if needed) or a prompt to create a new Vision profile (if the prescription is for someone else).
  6. Enter your pupillary distance (PD). 
    • This is the distance in millimeters between the centers of your pupils. 
    • You can enter it manually or select Measure Now to have your camera measure it for you.
  7. Select Add to cart.
    • You can continue adding items until you’re ready to check out.
  8. Check out.
    • You’ll get a confirmation email when you place the order and another when it ships.

Returns and Refunds

You can return your glasses in the Walmart app. They’re eligible for refund to your original payment method only within the 60-day return window. They’re not eligible for replacement.

  1. Go to the Order Details page.
  2. Select Start a Return.
  3. Select the item(s) to return.
  4. Select the item issue and item condition.
  5. Select the return method
  6. Review the order and select Submit.

Common Questions

What information do I need to place a Vision order?

You need a valid, current prescription and a PD measurement. Prescription requirements vary by state. You can measure your PD on Walmart.com.

Can I use a prescription for contact lenses to order glasses?

Contact lenses and glasses lenses are different prescriptions. See Walmart Contacts for more information.

How will I be notified if there’s a problem with my prescription or order?

You’ll get an email or text within 48 hours letting you know that the order has canceled.

Can I order progressive or bifocal lenses?

No, only single-vision lenses are available at this time. Progressive and bifocal lenses will be available in the future.

What if I have questions about a frame fit or style?

Please contact your local Walmart Vision Center for help.

What if my frames need adjustment?

Please visit your local Walmart Vision Center for free adjustments.

Can I use insurance benefits or insurance reimbursement?

We don’t accept insurance for online eyewear orders at this time. We do accept most major insurance in the Vision Centers. Please contact your local Walmart Vision Center or your insurance provider for more information.

How can I find my order confirmation or track my order?

View your order in your purchase history or use the Walmart app to track your package.

Is there a warranty on my frames?

There is a 60-day satisfaction guarantee with online Vision orders. This doesn’t apply to eyewear from other departments, such as Sporting Goods or Apparel/Accessories. You can also buy a 12-month replacement guarantee at a Walmart Vision Center within 14 days of your purchase. The 12-month eyewear guarantee isn’t available in:

  • New York

Out of Stock Items

If an item isn’t available, it will show out-of-stock.

Unfortunately, sometimes an item may show available when you place an order, but by the time we process the order, the item is no longer in stock. If this happens, we’ll email you to let you know that we canceled the item or the order. We restock items as quickly as we can.

Price and Other Listing Errors

Listing errors are incorrect details about the product in item listings.

Some of the product details that may contain errors are:

  • The item’s price
  • The images or description (color, size, features, etc.)
  • Quantity or what’s included

If we catch a listing error while processing your order, we’ll cancel your order.

  • Canceling your order is the last thing we want to do, but it may be necessary when we find listings with incorrect details.
  • If we need to cancel your order, we’ll send you an email with the reason for cancellation.

We reserve the right to cancel item(s) and orders in accordance with our Terms of Use.

Quantity Limits and Bulk Purchases

Some items have limits on the amount we can ship to you. If you can’t add more of an item to your cart, it’s either due to quantity limits or stock availability. Unfortunately, we can’t send more than the quantity limit allows. 

Walmart.com reserves the right to limit the quantity of items purchased per person, household, or order. These restrictions may apply to orders placed by the same Walmart account; using the same credit card, gift card, and/or checking account; and orders that use the same billing and/or shipping address.

Our website is meant for personal, non-commercial use. Since our items are already at everyday low prices, we generally don’t offer a discount on bulk purchases. We reserve the right to prohibit dealers or resellers.

Promo Code Offer Terms

These terms apply to promotional offers, including ones where you must redeem a code as part of the offer or where no additional terms and conditions apply. These promotional offers provide additional discounts or benefits when you purchase one or more of the product(s) described in the offer (“Qualifying Items”).

How to claim: 

  1. Add the Qualifying Item(s) to your Cart (may be referred to as Basket in some parts of the site).
  2. Verify that the item is sold by the seller offering the promo code. You can find the seller name in the “Sold by” box located below the delivery options on the right-hand side. If it doesn’t match, select the same item from the correct seller to qualify for the offer.
  3. At checkout, enter the promo code in the designated field as described in the offer. Any applicable discounts will be automatically applied to Qualifying Item(s).

Terms and Conditions:

  1. Offer may be modified, canceled, or terminated at any time without notice.
  2. You may enter a maximum of five (5) unique promo codes is allowed per transaction. Unless otherwise specified, promo code offers may not be combined with other offers. All applicable offers will be evaluated at checkout.
  3. If you check out with more than the specified number of Qualifying Items , the discount will only apply to the lowest-priced Qualifying Items.
  4. If you return one or more of the Qualifying Items, the discount that was applied will be deducted from your refund.
  5. If you do not purchase the Qualifying Items added to your Cart during the time period that the offer is in effect, the discount will not apply.
  6. All Qualifying Items must be purchased in the same transaction and shipped to a single address.
  7. Promotional Code offers are limited time offers. Valid while supplies last. Offer void where prohibited.
  8. Digital content and services may only be available to customers located in the U.S.
  9. Shipping charges and taxes may apply to the full value of discounted and free promotional items.
  10. If the offer has a minimum purchase requirement, taxes, shipping and handling, and gift wrap charges do not apply when determining the minimum purchase amount.
  11. Customers shopping on Walmart.com from outside the United States, including those shipping orders to international destinations, may not have access to certain features, services, and promotions such as promotional codes, Walmart+ membership benefits, InHome delivery, free shipping options, and specific payment methods.
  12. If you violate any of the offer terms, the offer will be invalid.

Walmart Recognized Reviewer Program

The Walmart Recognized Reviewer Program invites selected customers to receive free products in exchange for honest reviews. If you’re invited, you can claim items at no cost, test them, and share feedback to help other customers make informed decisions.

How the program works

  1. If you’re selected, you’ll receive an email invitation to join the Recognized Reviewer Program.
  2. Select the Get Started link in your invitation email.
  3. Accept the program terms.
  4. Complete your tax profile.
  5. Once your profile is complete, you can begin claiming free items.

Note:

  • All products ship free.
  • Free sample orders must be placed separately from your regular Walmart purchases.

How to find and claim items

  1. Open the Walmart app.
  2. Go to the Account tab (bottom right).
  3. Scroll to My Profile and select Reviews.
  4. You’ll see available items you can claim for free.

Note: Available items are refreshed regularly based on seller participation, inventory, and program eligibility.

Claim limits

  • Participants start with up to 3 active claims at a time.
  • As you complete reviews, new claim slots may open.
  • You can continue participating as long as you follow program guidelines.

Writing reviews

After you receive your item:

  • Submit a rating and written review reflecting your honest experience with the item.
  • At least one review must be completed before requesting additional products.
  • Items that have already been reviewed can’t be claimed again.
  • Reviews must follow Walmart’s Product Review Guidelines and Terms of Use.

For full program guidance, see: Program FAQs and the Rules & Eligibility page.

Shipping and returns

  • All items and shipping are completely free for Recognized Reviewers.
  • Free sample items cannot be returned.
  • Free samples cannot be purchased with other items in the same order.

SSN and tax information

To participate in the program and continue claiming free items, participants must complete a tax profile that includes their Social Security Number (SSN).

Your SSN is required to comply with IRS regulations. If the total value of items you receive exceeds the applicable threshold, this information may be used to issue a Form 1099 to you and to the IRS.

Security and privacy

  • SSN data is collected through encrypted systems.
  • Information is stored according to Walmart’s data protection standards.
  • Access is limited to authorized personnel responsible for compliance and financial reporting.

Common questions

Will I receive a Form 1099?

A Form 1099 will be issued only if the total value of your claimed items exceeds the IRS reporting threshold for the calendar year. As Walmart does not provide tax advice, please consult a qualified tax professional.

What if I entered my SSN incorrectly?

Your SSN and legal name are validated using IRS-approved verification systems before submission. You may update your SSN details until you sign and submit your tax profile.

I’m having trouble entering my SSN. What should I do?

Try completing the form on a desktop or laptop using Google Chrome. If using the Walmart app, make sure it’s updated to the latest version.

I can’t find the Recognized Reviewer page anymore

Make sure your Walmart app is updated to the latest version. The page may occasionally be temporarily unavailable during system updates; if so, please check back later.

Why do I see the same items?

Available items depend on seller participation, inventory, and program eligibility. As the program expands, more items and categories may become available.

Can I have more than one Recognized Reviewer account?

No. Only one account per participant is allowed.

Can I sell or give away the products I receive?

No. Products received through this program are not for resale and are intended for your personal use.

How do I opt out of the program?

Visit the Recognized Reviewer Rules and Eligibility page and scroll to the bottom to select Opt-out of Recognized Reviewer.

Removal or reinstatement

Participants may be removed from the program for reasons such as inactivity or violations of program guidelines. For full details, review the Recognized Reviewer Rules & Eligibility page.

Product safety

If you believe a product you received through the program may be unsafe or defective, stop using the product and contact Walmart support.

Troubleshooting and support

If you need help with the Recognized Reviewer Program, contact: svcproductsampling@walmart.com

The Walmart Site and App Experience

Order everything from groceries to gadgets using Walmart.com or the Walmart app. Take advantage of the new features that make shopping simpler while saving you time and money.

How to get your items

You have three ways to order your items:

  • Pickup: Pickup your order curbside at a nearby store.
  • Delivery: We’ll bring your order to your home from a store. (Fees may apply)
  • Shipping: Your order will be shipped fast via UPS, FedEx, or another carrier.

Pickup and Delivery from store

Select a nearby store and timeslot to pick up your items, or we can deliver your order right to your home. 

How it works:

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. On the homepage, select How do you want your items?
  3. Under How do you want your items select Pickup or Delivery.
    • Select Delivery to check to see if your address can receive Delivery services.
    • If your address is within range of a store that offers Delivery services, the website or app will list those stores. You can choose a store from the list and then select Save As My Store.
    • If no stores are listed, the address is not within range of Delivery services from a store. You must choose Shipping or Pickup to place an order.
  4. Reserve a Pickup/Delivery time.
  5. Add items to your order.
    • Not all items are available for Pickup and Delivery.
  6. Select Checkout under the Pickup and delivery options section of your cart.
    • Select Checkout all items to place an order for all items, both Pickup/Delivery and shipping. 
    • Check out by the time displayed to keep your reservation.

If you order an item that isn’t available for pickup and delivery from your local store, we’ll ship it to you. We group shipped items separately in your cart and they ship separately from your reserved pickup or delivery order. Look for availability info on the item page and search results page.

Find what you need

Use search to find and find items, including groceries, and filter by how and when you want them.

How it works:

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. Enter an item in the Search bar at the top of your screen.
  3. On the Search results page, filter by how and when you want to get items:
    • Need it fast: use this filter to show items that are available for your time preference.
    • Pickup & shipping: use this filter to show just the items that are available for your preference.

Pickup, Delivery and Shipping Fees

Fees apply to some methods, and you can see any fees from your cart.

  • Pickup: Pick up orders over $35 for free. Orders under the $35 minimum have a below order minimum fee.
  • Standard Delivery from store: $9.95 delivery fee applies.
    • Delivery is free for Walmart+ members for orders over $35.
    • Learn about Walmart+ 
  • Shipping: Orders under the $35 order minimum have a below order minimum fee of $6.99.
    • We waive the fee for Walmart+ customers. 
  • Express delivery: $10 Express fee applies to all orders in addition to the $9.95 standard delivery fee.
    • We waive the standard delivery fee for Walmart+ members.
    • Learn about Walmart+
  • 3 hr. or less delivery: $6 fee applies to all orders.
    • $9.95 standard delivery fee applies.
  • Drone delivery: $19.99 delivery fee applies to all drone delivery orders. 
    • Walmart+ members pay zero drone delivery fees.
    • Learn about Drone Delivery
  • Extra Shipping fees:
    • Freight Items (items that are heavy or oversized) have separate surcharges.
    • Marketplace items may have separate shipping charges but count toward the $35 minimum amount for free shipping from Walmart.
    • Pharmacy, photo, wireless and tires don’t count toward the $35 minimum amount and don’t ship for free.
    • APO/FPO military addresses may have separate charges.
  • Hawaii, Alaska, US Territories, and Overseas Locations: Items that Walmart sells and ships have added shipping fees when we ship to these locations.
    • You can check the shipping fees for the item by adding it to the cart. There will be a separate line in the Payments section for this fee.
  • Bag fees: Certain states or local municipalities may charge bag fees to encourage the use of reusable bags. You can visit Single-Use Bag Policy to learn more.
  • Colorado (CO) Retail Delivery Fee: There is an added retail delivery fee of $0.28 for all deliveries by motor vehicle in Colorado. We charge this delivery fee within the state of CO for any item(s) that are subject to sales tax or use tax. For more details, you can visit Temporary Holds and Charges.

Mobile Money Services

Walmart offers money services in-store. Visit your store’s Money Center or Customer Service counter for these services:

  • Bill Pay
  • Money Transfers
  • Cash Checks

Money Services are not yet available in the app.

WALMART 12-MONTH EYEWEAR REPLACEMENT GUARANTEE

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully so that you understand your coverage under the Walmart 12-Month Eyewear Replacement Guarantee (referred to hereinafter as the “Plan”). This Plan is a legal contract between you and Walmart Inc. (or a Walmart Inc. affiliate depending on your state of residence as indicated in the State Specific Notices and Variations Section), 702 SW 8th Street Bentonville, AR 72716-0215 (“We”, “Us”, “Our” or “Walmart”), the company obligated to perform the services provided under this Plan.

WHAT IS COVERED. This Plan covers the cost of repair or replacement of your frames or lenses, within twelve (12) months of the date of purchase, due to the breakage of the frames or damage to the lenses (accidental or from preexisting manufacturer’s defect), including severe scratching of the center of vision of the lenses. We maintain the sole right to determine whether the broken frames or damaged lenses will be repaired or replaced. We may use non-original manufacturer’s parts for repairs. If we determine that the frames or lenses cannot be repaired and the same type of frames or lenses are not available, we will replace your frames or lenses with a product of like kind or quality.

THIS PLAN DOES NOT COVER NORMAL WEAR AND TEAR, INCLUDING HAIRLINE SCRATCHES; LOST OR STOLEN EYEWEAR; INTENTIONAL OR PURPOSEFUL DAMAGE; OR CONSEQUENTIAL OR INCIDENTAL DAMAGES.TO OBTAIN COVERAGE/SERVICE. To obtain repair or replacement of your broken frames or damaged lenses you must return your eyewear to a Walmart Vision Center along with the receipt of purchase. No deductibles or co-pays are required under the Plan.

TERM OF COVERAGE. Coverage under this Plan extends for twelve (12) months from your date of purchase as indicated on your receipt of purchase. Coverage under this Plan is non-renewable.

NON-TRANSFERABLE. This contract and the coverage and rights provided hereunder are non-transferable.

CANCELLATION. You may cancel this Plan at any time for any reason by providing notice to the Walmart Vision Center from which it was purchased. If the Plan is cancelled within thirty (30) days of the date of purchase, or you return your purchased eyewear to Walmart within the 60-day satisfaction period, you will receive a full refund of the purchase price of the Plan, provided that no repair or replacement under the Plan has been provided. If You cancel this Plan after thirty (30) days from the date of purchase and have not returned your purchased eyewear to Walmart within the 60-day satisfaction period, You will receive a pro-rata refund based on the time remaining on Your Protection Plan less the cost of any services received. Any refund owed and not paid or credited to You within thirty (30) days of cancellation shall include a ten percent (10%) penalty for each month that the refund is not paid or credited.

PLAN NOT INSURANCE. This Plan is not an insurance policy. Our obligations as the provider under this Plan are backed only by the full faith and credit of Walmart and are not guaranteed under any insurance policy.

ARBITRATION AGREEMENT.Please read this section carefully. It affects your rights under this Plan. We should be able to resolve any issues you may have with this Plan by contacting us at (800) WAL-MART. In the event that We cannot resolve any dispute, YOU AND WE AGREE THAT ANY CONTROVERSY OR CLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS CONTRACT, OR BREACH THEREOF, WHETHER BASED IN CONTRACT, TORT, STATUTE, FRAUD OR OTHERWISE SHALL BE SETTLED BY BINDING ARBITRATION ADMINISTERED BY THE AMERICAN ARBITRATION ASSOCIATION (“AAA”) INSTEAD OF THROUGH COURTS OF GENERAL JURISDICTION. YOU AND WE AGREE TO WAIVE ANY AND ALL RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY AND TO PARTICIPATE IN CLASS ARBITRATIONS AND CLASS ACTIONS. This arbitration agreement shall survive termination of the Plan and, as a transaction in interstate commerce, is governed by the Federal Arbitration Act. This section is intended to be interpreted broadly to include any dispute You may have with Us that arises from or relates in any way to the Plan.

To initiate arbitration, you must first send written Notice of Claim by certified mail to: Legal Department, 702 SW 8th Street Bentonville, AR 72716-0215. The Notice of Claim must describe the dispute and the relief requested. If We do not resolve the dispute within 30 days of receipt of the Notice of Claim, You may initiate arbitration with the AAA. You may obtain a free copy of the AAA rules and forms at www.adr.org or by calling 1-800-778-7879. We will reimburse you for any filing fees you pay to the AAA. If You are unable to pay a filing fee, We will pay it if You send Us written request. The arbitration shall be conducted by the AAA in accordance with the Consumer Arbitration Rules (“Rules”). The arbitrator shall be bound by the terms of this section and shall decide all issues relating to this Agreement with the exception that the issue of enforceability of this section may be decided by a court.

WALMART 12-MONTH EYEWEAR REPLACEMENT GUARANTEE TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully so that you understand your coverage under the Walmart 12-Month Eyewear Replacement Guarantee (referred to hereinafter as the “Plan”). WHAT IS COVERED. This Plan covers the cost of repair or replacement of your frames or lenses, within twelve (12) months of the date of purchase, due to the breakage of the frames or damage to the lenses (accidental or from preexisting manufacturer’s defect), including severe scratching of the center of vision of the lenses. We maintain the sole right to determine whether the broken frames or damaged lenses will be repaired or replaced. We may use non-original manufacturer’s parts for repairs. If we determine that the frames or lenses cannot be repaired and the same type of frames or lenses are not available, we will replace your frames or lenses with a product of like kind or quality.

THIS PLAN DOES NOT COVER NORMAL WEAR AND TEAR, INCLUDING HAIRLINE SCRATCHES; LOST OR STOLEN EYEWEAR; INTENTIONAL OR PURPOSEFUL DAMAGE; OR CONSEQUENTIAL OR INCIDENTAL DAMAGES.TO OBTAIN COVERAGE/SERVICE. To obtain repair or replacement of your broken frames or damaged lenses you must return your eyewear to a Walmart Vision Center along with the receipt of purchase. No deductibles or co-pays are required under the Plan.

TERM OF COVERAGE. Coverage under this Plan extends for twelve (12) months from your date of purchase as indicated on your receipt of purchase. Coverage under this Plan is non-renewable.

NON-TRANSFERABLE. This contract and the coverage and rights provided hereunder are non-transferable.

CANCELLATION. You may cancel this Plan at any time for any reason by providing notice to the Walmart Vision Center from which it was purchased. If the Plan is cancelled within thirty (30) days of the date of purchase, or you return your purchased eyewear to Walmart within the 60-day satisfaction period, you will receive a full refund of the purchase price of the Plan, provided that no repair or replacement under the Plan has been provided. If You cancel this Plan after thirty (30) days from the date of purchase and have not returned your purchased eyewear to Walmart within the 60-day satisfaction period, You will receive a pro-rata refund based on the time remaining on Your Protection Plan less the cost of any services received. Any refund owed and not paid or credited to You within thirty (30) days of cancellation shall include a ten percent (10%) penalty for each month that the refund is not paid or credited.

60-Day Satisfaction Guarantee Terms and Conditions - Vision

60-day Satisfaction Guarantee coverage:

Walmart offers a 60-day Satisfaction Guarantee from the date of purchase at no charge, in which the patient can return or exchange the glasses. Excludes wear and tear. The 60-Day Satisfaction Guarantee includes:

  • Frame Restyles
  • Measurement Changes
  • Lens Restyles
  • Doctor’s Rx Change

To obtain coverage/service for online orders:

To obtain service on your glasses, you must visit a Walmart Vision Center within 60 days of original purchase with a valid receipt and original eyewear.

To return online orders:

Prescription eyewear purchased online is returnable within 60 days and must be mailed back. Only items purchased in store may be returned to a Walmart Vision Center.

Term of coverage:

Coverage under this Guarantee extends for 60 days from your date of purchase as indicated on your receipt of purchase.

Baby Registry Welcome Box Offer Terms of Use

Eligibility : Offer is available to individuals who are 18 or older and reside in the fifty (50) United States and Puerto Rico, while supplies last. To receive a Baby Registry Welcome Box (“Box”), visit 0 and follow the directions to enroll in the offer. See the FAQs on the offer opt-in page for box content information.

Program Details: Offer begins at 12:01 A.M. Eastern Standard Time on February 1, 2025. Exact contents of Box may vary from what is shown or stated in any marketing for the offer and not everyone may receive the same Box contents; however, Box will always include at least 6 sample size baby and/or parenting products and discount coupons for baby and/or parenting items. Boxes are provided on a first come, first served basis. There is no guarantee that everyone who enrolls in the offer and completes the offer requirements will receive a Box. Once you enroll in the offer, you must create a baby registry with at least twenty (20) items, maintain your registry for at least seven (7) days, and you or someone you’ve invited to the registry must spend at least $25 (excluding taxes and shipping/delivery fees) on items from your registry. Please note that such items must be selected and purchased directly from your registry in order to fulfill this offer requirement. Once you have fulfilled the offer requirements, you must click on the redemption tile within your baby registry and follow the directions to redeem for your Box. Class Action and Mass Action Waiver.

YOU AND WALMART AGREE THAT ANY ARBITRATION REQUIRED BY THE ARBITRATION AGREEMENT WILL TAKE PLACE ON AN INDIVIDUAL BASIS. Nothing in these Terms and Conditions precludes you from bringing issues to the attention of federal, state, or local government agencies and, if the applicable law allows, such agencies may seek relief against Walmart for you.

Initiating a Demand for Arbitration.

Any arbitration required by the Arbitration Agreement shall be initiated by You or Walmart by sending the other a written demand for arbitration (“Demand”) only via first-class mail, FedEx, or UPS within the applicable statute of limitations period. Your Demand shall be delivered to: Walmart Inc. Legal Department, 811 Excellence Way, Mailstop 0215, Bentonville, AR 72716-0215. The Demand must include (i) the name, telephone number, mailing address, and email address of the person or entity seeking arbitration; (ii) a statement of the legal claims asserted and the factual basis for those claims; (iii) a description of the remedy sought and an accurate, good-faith calculation of the amount in controversy; (iv) the original personal signature of the party seeking arbitration; and (v) the original personal signature of any legal counsel or other representative purporting to represent the party seeking arbitration. For purposes of this paragraph, “original personal signature” does not include any digital, scanned, electronic, copied, or facsimile signature. An original personal signature on the Demand certifies the following: (i) the Demand is not being presented for any improper purpose, such as to harass, cause unnecessary delay, or needlessly increase the cost of litigation; (ii) the claims and other legal contentions are warranted by existing law or by a non-frivolous argument for extending, modifying, or reversing existing law or for establishing new law; and (iii) the factual contentions have evidentiary support or, if specifically so identified, will likely have evidentiary support after a reasonable opportunity for further investigation or discovery. The original personal signature by the party seeking arbitration shall verify under penalty of perjury that the factual statements contained in the Demand are true and correct. Compliance with this paragraph tolls any applicable statute of limitations as to any dispute or claim subject to the Arbitration Agreement that is stated in the Demand.

Filing a Demand for Arbitration.

A party seeking arbitration of any dispute or claim subject to the Arbitration Agreement shall submit a copy of the Demand to the American Arbitration Association (“AAA”) sixty (60) or more days after the Demand is initiated pursuant to these Terms and Conditions. The arbitration will be administered by the AAA pursuant to the current AAA Consumer Arbitration Rules, except to the extent modified by these Terms and Conditions. The AAA rules and instructions are available on the AAA website at www.adr.org/consumer.

Conduct of Arbitration.

In any arbitration of a dispute or claim that is subject to the Arbitration Agreement:

1. You or Walmart may file such dispositive motions as would be permitted by the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure without obtaining permission from the arbitrator. Upon the filing of any dispositive motion, the arbitrator may stay all further action and deadlines in the arbitration until deciding such motion.

2. The parties shall have the right to conduct such discovery from the opposing party or any third party that is proportional to the needs of the claim or dispute, considering the importance of the issues at stake, the amount in controversy, the importance of the discovery in resolving the issues, and whether the burden or expense of the proposed discovery outweighs its likely benefit. Proportionality shall be decided by the arbitrator when requested by either party.

3. The arbitrator shall conduct any calls, conferences, or hearings by teleconference or videoconference, unless the arbitrator determines that an in-person hearing is appropriate. Any in-person hearing will be held at a location that is reasonably convenient. You and an employee of Walmart shall attend all arbitrator calls, conferences, and hearings.

4. A party may make a written offer of judgment at least seven (7) days before the date set for the arbitration hearing.

5. If the arbitrator finds that a party’s claim, counterclaim, or appeal was frivolous, asserted in bad faith, or pursued for purposes of harassment, the arbitrator shall award the opposing party its attorneys’ fees, costs, and expenses and all amounts charged by AAA for the arbitration.

6. The arbitrator will follow these Terms and Conditions and the law. The arbitrator shall not have the authority to commit errors of law or legal reasoning. The arbitrator may award relief only in favor of the individual party seeking relief and only to the extent necessary to provide relief warranted by that individual party’s claim. The arbitrator may not award relief for or against anyone who is not a party, though the individual relief awarded by the arbitrator may incidentally affect non-parties.

7. You or Walmart may appeal an arbitration award that manifestly disregards the law by filing a notice of appeal with the AAA within 30 days after an award is rendered and delivered to the parties. The appeal shall be heard by a single arbitrator unless the parties agree to a multi-arbitrator appellate panel. The arbitrator(s) assigned to the appeal shall be selected by agreement of the parties from among those on the AAA Appellate Panel. If the parties are unable to agree, AAA shall appoint the arbitrator(s) from among those on the AAA Appellate Panel. An arbitrator who previously presided over any aspect of a case shall be ineligible from serving as an appellate arbitrator in that same case. The appeal, including briefing, shall be conducted pursuant to the parties’ agreement or the appellate arbitrator(s)’ orders if the parties are unable to agree.

Process for Arbitration Bellwether Demands.

If twenty-five (25) or more Demands for arbitration of a dispute or claim subject to the Arbitration Agreement are initiated (i) that involve common questions of law or fact and (ii) where the initiating parties are represented by the same law firm, the same group of coordinated law firms, or the same representative, then such Demands shall be coordinated pursuant to this paragraph. The group of claimants and group of respondents shall each select five (5) Demands, for a total of ten (10), to be filed with AAA (collectively the “Bellwether Demands”). Each of the Bellwether Demands shall be assigned by AAA to a different arbitrator chosen from its national roster. After ninety (90) days from the date all Bellwether Demands have been arbitrated and any appeals exhausted, any remaining Demands subject to this paragraph may be filed with AAA. The AAA Supplementary Rules for Multiple Case Filings shall apply to the extent they are not inconsistent with this paragraph. Notwithstanding any other provision in the Terms and Conditions, You and Walmart agree that a court of competent jurisdiction shall have authority to enforce the terms of this paragraph with injunctive or other relief.

Severability.

If (i) any dispute or claim subject to the Arbitration Agreement is filed as a class arbitration, class action, collective action, representative action, or Mass Action and (ii) if the Class Action and Mass Action Waiver is held invalid or unenforceable as to such dispute or claim, then the Arbitration Agreement does not apply to that dispute or claim and such dispute or claim must be brought in a court of competent jurisdiction. If any provision of Section 20 of these Terms and Conditions other than the Class Action and Mass Action Waiver is held invalid or unenforceable as to a particular dispute or claim, then such provision shall be severed from the Terms and Conditions, and the remainder of the Terms and Conditions shall be enforceable to the maximum extent permitted by law.

Applicable Law.

The Federal Arbitration Act (“FAA”) governs the interpretation and enforcement of Section 20 of these Terms and Conditions. If the FAA is found not to apply to any portion of Section 20 of these Terms and Conditions, then the applicable laws of the State of Arkansas shall apply without regard to choice-of-law principles.

5.     Information Provided by You; Recordings      5.1     Information Provided by You and Delivery Personnel. If you place an order for an InHome delivery via Walmart.com or the Walmart app, the information that you provide in connection with such order will be subject to the Walmart Privacy Policy (available here). The Companion Product Software and Walmart Software provides Walmart and third parties, such as the smart lock and garage door service providers, with information relating to your use and the performance of the InHome Services and the Companion Products, including use of the Companion Products outside your use for the InHome Service (“Technical Data”).  For example, such Technical Data may include information about the Companion Products and how they operate or occurrences of technical errors.  Additionally, the Walmart Software may collect image, video, or other types of recordings collected by cameras worn by our Delivery Personnel while on your property or in your Home (“Delivery Data”). Delivery Data may be collected as follows: (i) when Delivery Personnel arrive at your Home to complete an InHome delivery, the Delivery Personnel’s vest begins streaming and then they will unlock the smart lock or open the garage door; and (ii) the camera is designed to record video footage of the Delivery Personnel’s path within your Home, for the duration of the delivery (i.e., recording will typically commence before the door is unlocked or the garage is opened and will typically stop when the door is locked and closed or the garage door is closed by the Delivery Personnel after the delivery), in accordance with Section 5.2 below. For Delivery Personnel safety and your safety, the Delivery Personnel will not stop the recorded video footage at any point during delivery.  You may view the Recordings of our Delivery Personnel taken by our Delivery Personnel’s camera either in real time or at a later time via the Walmart App. You will not have the ability to speak to the Delivery Personnel via the Walmart App once they are in the Home; however, at any time you may contact InHome Customer Support who will contact the Delivery Personnel as needed.

     5.2      Recordings. The Walmart Software will be used to create Recordings of Delivery Data solely for use by Walmart.  Recordings are not shared with third parties, including providers of the Companion Products. Walmart retains Recordings for seven days after they are captured during the delivery window by Delivery Personnel.  After the seven-day period, the Recordings are destroyed.  Unless prohibited by law, Walmart may store, access and share Recordings only with its Affiliates to address special circumstances such as compliance obligations or to protect the safety, property, or rights of any party including Walmart.

6.    Codeof Conduct. Due to the personalized nature of the InHome Services, you may, from time to time, personally interact with our Delivery Personnel on your property or in your Home.  You must comply with, and ensure that all occupants of your delivery location comply with, the following code of conduct (“Code of Conduct”):

The purpose of this Code of Conduct is simply to ensure the safety, comfort and respect of all involved.  Accordingly, you agree that neither you nor any occupant of your Home shall: (i) physically  or emotionally harm, threaten to harm, or intentionally or recklessly cause harm to our Delivery Personnel, or create or fail to eliminate any condition that endangers the health, safety, or well being of our Delivery Personnel (e.g., unreasonable clutter or odors, uncontained animals or other obstacles); (ii) make or attempt any sexual advance or statement to our Delivery Personnel; (iii) threaten, harass, stalk, intimidate, or engage in any other aggressive or bullying behavior against our Delivery Personnel; (iv) use any vulgar or obscene language or otherwise engage in behavior that is likely to make others feel uncomfortable, embarrassed or offended; (v) engage in any behavior that discriminates against our Delivery Personnel because of the individual’s race, color, sex, gender identity, age, national origin, handicap, sexual orientation or religion; or (vi) request our Delivery Personnel to perform any tasks other than performing the InHome Services (including but not limited to stocking shelves and/or pantries) as described in this Agreement.
