Pay by Bank Program Terms and Conditions

Your participation in the Pay by Bank Program (the “Program”) and your Pay by Bank payment tender is subject to these Terms and Conditions (the “Agreement”). Your participation in the Program is also governed by our Walmart.com Terms of Use found here which incorporate our Privacy Policy. We may update these terms from time to time by posting updates on the Walmart.com website. By using this service, you accept the updated terms.

Participation in the Program allows you to register for the Program and tie your bank account information to your Walmart Account to initiate payment for purchase transactions at Walmart.com or SamsClub.com, which may be accessed on-line or through the Walmart App or Sam’s Club App. In summary, this service allows you to initiate a transfer of funds directly from your bank account to pay for goods or services.

Eligibility. You are eligible to register for the Program if you are 18 years of age or older and you have an eligible bank account. The Agreement is in addition to any agreement you may have with your Bank. We reserve the right, in our sole discretion, to impose limits on the amount of funds sent through this service, on a per transaction or cumulative basis. There may also be limits on the frequency and number of transactions that may be made by Pay by Bank.

Registration. To register for the Program, you must complete the Program Registration process. We reserve the right to deny your Program Registration, to reject your payment under the Program, and to terminate your ability to particpate in the Program for any reason and in our sole discretion. You may terminate your participation in the Program by deleting the Pay by Bank payment tender from your Walmart Account Payment Options page. You may also terminate your participation in the Program by calling your Bank to revoke authorization.

Authorization. This authorization applies to your Pay by Bank payment initiation that allows you to initiate a transfer of funds directly from your tied bank account to Walmart or a Walmart affiliate. By selecting the Pay by Bank payment tender, you authorize us to electronically debit your bank account up to the total amount of your purchase, including applicable taxes, fees, and shipping or delivery costs. You also authorize us to further debit or credit your bank account to correct any errors, make any necessary adjustments to your payment, or issue a refund back to your bank account.

Payment Returns. If your bank returns any payment using your bank account unpaid, we may retry the payment. You authorize our payment processor to collect a Returned Transaction Fee as an electronic fund transfer or draft if permitted by law. You also agree that the laws of the State of Georgia govern the Returned Transaction Fee and the collection thereof for online and in app purchases. The fee for online and in app Returned Transactions is $30.00. Your bank may also charge you an overdraft or other fees for payment failure.

Account Management. It is your responsibility for safeguarding your User Identification, Password, and any other credentials used to access these services on our website or mobile app. You are responsible for any activity occurring in your account (including, without limitation, any activity by additional users of your account). If you become aware of any unauthorized access to your account, please notify Walmart and your bank immediately.

You must keep the email address, contact information, and payment details associated with your account current and accurate. 

For questions about the Program, please contact us by telephone at 1-800-WALMART. For questions about unauthorized transactions, please contact your Bank. For questions about Pay by Bank transactions, please contact Telecheck Services, LLC by telephone at 888-905-3388. Telecheck Services, LLC is our Third-Party Service Provider that handles the Pay by Bank payment processing.

Ratings, Reviews, Question, & Answer Terms of Use

Guidelines for Submitting Ratings and Reviews

You can share your opinions on products you’ve purchased, or about Marketplace Sellers you’ve purchased from, on Walmart.com. Walmart employees can also submit reviews, which will be identified by a Walmart Associate label. Regardless of whether your experience with the product was positive or negative, your honest review will benefit other Walmart.com shoppers.

By submitting a review on Walmart.com, you (i) agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use, (ii) consent to any personal information in any Content (as defined in the Terms of Use, including for example, an image of your face or likeness, to be shared with Walmart affiliates anywhere in the world, and (iii) agree to comply with our ratings and reviews guidelines set forth herein, which we update from time to time.

Submit a Product Review

  • From the Purchase History page
    • Sign in to your Account
    • Navigate to the Purchase History page
    • Follow the prompt to review an item at the top of the Purchase history list
  • From the Order Details page
    • Sign in to Your Account
    • Navigate to the Purchase History page
    • Click on the “View details” button next to the order number for the product you wish to review
    • On the Order Details page, select “Review item” under the item name
  • From requests to review more items after you submit one review
  • From emails inviting you to review the products you purchased after your order is fulfilled; use the links provided to access the review forms
  • At the end of a post-purchase survey link printed on your in-store receipt
  • From the item’s page
    • Select Write a Review next to the Review Snapshot on the product details page

New reviews display on the website within 5-7 business days. If you have submitted a review recently, check back soon to see it posted to the site.  

Submit a Seller Review

We offer two ways to submit a seller review:

  • From the Order Details page
    • Sign in to Your Account
    • Navigate to the Purchase History page
    • Click on the “View details” button next to the order number for the product you wish to review
    • On the Order Details page, select “Review seller” under the item name
  • After submitting an item review, you will be given the option to write a review for the seller that sold your Marketplace item

Product Review GuidelinesPlease keep in mind the following guidelines when submitting a review for a product:

  • Reviews must be in English*
  • Reviews must reflect your honest opinion about the product
  • Reviews should focus on the product and your experience using it
  • Reviews should provide specific details about what you did or did not like about the product
  • Reviews must not include:
    • Content that is libelous, harassing, abusive, obscene, vulgar, sexually explicit or other similar language
    • Content that is discriminatory or prejudicial with respect to race, gender, sexuality, ethnicity, or other protected class
    • Content that is wholly unrelated to the product reviewed
    • Content considered as spam
    • Email addresses, phone numbers, links to websites, physical addresses, or other forms of contact information and personally identifiable information
    • Content that you do not own or do not have permission to use
  • In addition to the above guidelines, if you are submitting an image with your review, make sure:
    • The image is relevant to the product
    • The image does not infringe on any third-party intellectual property rights (including copyrights, trademarks, patents, trade secrets) or other proprietary rights
    • You have all intellectual property rights in the image, and permission to submit the image as part of the review

Please keep in mind the following guidelines when submitting a review for a Marketplace Seller:

  • Reviews must be in English*
  • Reviews must reflect your honest opinion about your experience purchasing from the Seller, including, for example, the customer service they provide
  • Reviews should provide specific details about what you did or did not like about your experience purchasing from the Seller
  • Reviews must not include:
    • Content that is libelous, harassing, abusive, obscene, vulgar, sexually explicit or other similar language
    • Content that is discriminatory or prejudicial with respect to race, gender, sexuality, ethnicity, or other protected class
    • Content that is wholly unrelated to the product reviewed
    • Content considered as spam
    • Email addresses, phone numbers, links to websites, physical addresses, or other forms of contact information and personally identifiable information
    • Content that you do not own or do not have permission to use

*Walmart reserves the right to translate submitted reviews into any other language.

Consequences for violations

If your review does not comply with the above guidelines, or if we find that you have engaged in any fraudulent, or other non-compliant activity, we reserve the right to:

  • Remove your reviews;
  • Not publish your review and you will not be able to submit a subsequent review for the same product;
  • Limit your ability to submit reviews;
  • Suspend or terminate your account

Reporting violations

To report suspicious seller activity related to reviews, please submit a report via our reporting form for reporting suspicious marketplace activity: Report Marketplace Seller Activity - Walmart.com.

To report a harmful review, please select the “Report” option available to the bottom right of each review on our website.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I edit or delete my posted review? A: No, you are currently unable to edit or delete your item or seller reviews.

Q: Will my reviews be anonymous? A: Your review will be posted under a nickname that you submit or, if no nickname is entered, it will be posted as “Walmart Customer”. We do not allow or publicize any personally identifiable information in reviews.

Q: Can I review a product that I have not purchased on Walmart.com? A: No, reviews should only be written for products that you have purchased from Walmart.com.

Q: Can I review a seller that I have not purchased from on Walmart.com? A: No, reviews can only be written for sellers that you have purchased from on Walmart.com.

Q: Can I rate a product without typing a written review? A: Yes, you can rate a product by selecting the number of stars without writing a detailed review. However, providing detailed feedback is always appreciated.

Spark Good Terms of Use

Spark Good Customer Terms of Use

By interacting with Walmart Spark Good programs, you agree that you are observing  Walmart.com Terms of Use and subject to the following terms:

  • Walmart does not share identifiable customer information with a charity unless you opted in to share your full name and email with the organization. 
  • In the case of round up donations and registry donations, only a unique identifier and donation for accurate reporting purposes are shared with the charity unless you opted in to share your Full name and email with the organization.
  • For more information on Walmart’s privacy and security policies click here.
Spark Good Round Up

Walmart works with two organizations (Deed and Network for Good) to ensure that customers have a broad choice of charities, and that there is a well-defined manner to disburse Round Up funds to the customer’s preferred organization. By participating in Round Up, customers understand that:

Any participation in Spark Good Round Up is subject to the following additional terms:

  1. You are donating to Network for Good-DAF (NFG-DAF), a donor advised fund sponsor. NFG-DAF is a Delaware nonprofit corporation and a Section 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization (EIN: 68-0480736). Network for Good has exclusive legal control over your donation. To update link for charitable solicitation disclosures to 0 and the Privacy Policy to 1 and Network for Good’s Charitable Solicitation Disclosures and Network for Good’s Privacy Policy. Network for Good, in its sole judgment, may grant donated funds to the recommended charity you have selected.
  2. Donation disbursements from Network for Good to eligible charities schools will be made on a monthly basis, no more than 30 days after the end of the month in which you made your donation. 
  3. Once a donation has been processed by Walmart, no funds will be returned to you. All donations to Network for Good are final. Under the tax laws, gifts are irrevocable. In very rare situations, your donation may not be honored for a number of reasons, including: your recommended Charity has lost its tax-exempt status, the Charity is listed on a government or other risk watch list(s), the Charity or NCES school was deemed ineligible by Walmart or Network for Good, or the Charity or NCES school will not accept the funds. If circumstances arise where Network for Good cannot provide a grant to your selected charity, you will be provided the opportunity to select an alternate eligible charity. If you do not provide an alternative selection, Network for Good will grant the funds to United Way Worldwide.

Spark Good Organization Terms of Use

Spark Good Account

Any use of the Spark Good Account (available at 0) is subject to Walmart.com Terms of Use and the following additional terms:

i.Access to Spark Good programs

  • To create a Spark Good account, an organization user will need to create or log in with your Walmart.com account. To add organizations to your Spark Good account, these organizations will need to be verified by Deed, a third-party verifier. All additional users will have to be added in Deed, and require a Walmart.com account before they can access the Spark Good account.
  • A Spark Good account provides access to various Spark Good programs based on organization eligibility. To learn more about program guidelines, eligibility and payment providers, visit Walmart.org/SparkGood for more information.

ii.Information Sharing

  1. To provide a seamless user experience and access to Walmart’s Spark Good community benefits, Deed shares an organization’s basic account information, including emails of authorized users, minus any bank account information, with both Walmart Inc. and the Walmart Foundation. Click here to review Deed’s privacy policy.
  2. Walmart does not share with Deed any personally identifiable purchase history or Walmart.com account activity from our customers, verified active organizations, or their authorized users. For more information on Walmart’s privacy and security policies click here.
  3. Charities acknowledge and agree that they are not entitled to receive, and Walmart will not provide, any identifiable customer information in respect of purchases made from any Spark Good Registry and customer donations made from Spark Good Round Up (unless the customers, opted in to share their name and email to the organization). In the case of Spark Good customer round up donations, only a unique identifier number and round up amount for accurate reporting purposes are shared with the charity, unless the customer opted in to share their name and email. In the case of customer donations from a Spark Good Registry, only an order number and name (if the customer chooses to share in a gift message) are shared with the charity.
  4. For organizations participating in Spark Good Round Up and/or spotlight campaigns, Walmart will share your organization nonprofit ID (NPO ID) and anonymized customer Round Up donation details with Network for Good. Click here to learn more about Network for Good Privacy Policy.

iii. Solicitation

  1. Charities agree to make their Spark Good Registry and Round Up searchable on the customer Spark Good site (www.walmart.com/sparkgood) to customers. The organization may elect to make the registry private and available only to those who have a link.
  2. Charities are solely responsible for compliance with all solicitation regulations under each jurisdiction where they promote their Spark Good Registry and Round up, or any portion thereof.
  3. Walmart generally will not promote any organization or an organization’s participation in any Spark Good programs, including Spark Good Registry or Round Up, without a co-venture agreement with the organization in place.

iv. Promotion

  1. Organizations may only promote or link to their Spark Good’s organization profile, Spark Good Round up, or Spark Good Registry on their own website, user-generated content published through a social media account, or page belonging to the organization, offline mailings, or email correspondence, and may only use certain Walmart’s trademarks or logos identified by Walmart, links to the Spark Good’s organization profile, or other Walmart Content Walmart may make available, in all cases in accordance with the following restrictions:
    1. Organizations may not promote or link to the Spark Good organization profile, Spark Good Registry or the Spark Good Round Up, in a way that is misleading, illegal, or confusing to viewers or that does not accurately represent, or which might adversely impact the Spark Good’s reputation.
    2. Organizations may not state, or imply that Walmart funds, endorses, supports, or is otherwise engaged in business with the organization.
    3. Organizations may not request, collect, obtain, store, cache, or otherwise use any account information of, or used by, other Walmart customers.

2.1 Redemption for a Walmart eGift Card to be Applied Against Walmart Purchases

When you request to apply your Walmart Cash to an in-store or online purchase at Walmart, subject to other terms contained herein, we will digitally redeem your Walmart Cash for a Walmart eGift card that will be instantly applied against your basket total. In order to do so, please follow the steps below. eGift cards are subject to the standard Walmart Gift Card Terms and Conditions found here, except that eGift cards under this Walmart Cash Offers Program are provided to you by Walmart as loyalty, award and promotional products.   • Tap “Use Walmart Cash” to redeem your balance for an eGift card to be applied against the purchase price and select how you would prefer to pay for any remaining amount (if applicable). If your Walmart Cash balance is less than your basket total (excluding prohibited items), your full Walmart Cash balance will be redeemed for an eGift card and applied against your basket total. If your Walmart Cash balance is greater than your basket total, only that portion of your Walmart Cash balance necessary will be redeemed for an eGift card and applied against the basket total.

Online:

  • On Walmart.com or the Walmart app, sign into your Walmart account where you have accrued a Walmart Cash balance.
  • In checkout, tap “apply Walmart Cash balance” in the Wallet section to redeem your Walmart Cash balance for an eGift card to be applied against the purchase price and select how you would prefer to pay for any remaining amount (if applicable).

Tire Warranty Terms and Conditions

Last Updated: October 9, 2023

Our Pledge To You

  1. We will complete only the service you authorize.
  2. We will not exceed the estimated cost of service without your permission.
  3. We will, at your request, return your old parts to you or hold them for your inspection.

LIMITED WORKMANSHIP AND MATERIALS WARRANTY

Congratulations on your purchase of your new tires from Walmart Inc.(“Walmart”)! This Limited Workmanship and Materials Warranty applies to all tires that are purchased from Walmart or Walmart.com and installed at a Walmart Auto Care Center (“ACC”) within a Walmart store. This warranty is backed by Walmart and protects the original purchaser from defects in the raw materials or quality of workmanship that require a tire to be removed from service. Walmart stands behind the warranties of the tires that we sell. We do not send tires back to the manufacturer for warranty.

HOW LONG IS THIS LIMITED WARRANTY VALID?

Under this limited warranty, tires found to be defective will be covered by this warranty for the life of the tire, as measured by the usable tread depth. Usable tread depth is defined as the depth of the tread down to the final 2/32nds of an inch. The last 2/32nds is not considered usable tread. Walmart will measure and determine the usable tread depth.

WHAT IS COVERED BY THIS LIMITED WARRANTY?

This Limited Workmanship and Materials Warranty (hereafter sometimes referred to as “Limited Warranty and/or “Warranty”) provides additional coverage to tires purchased and installed at Walmart that are “defective,” defined as conditions that require a tire to be removed from service due to defects in the raw materials or quality of workmanship. Walmart, at its sole discretion, will determine whether a tire is defective and is therefore eligible for replacement under this Limited Warranty. Tires that are deemed defective will be replaced free of charge (except for installation cost and applicable taxes and government-mandated charges) during the first 25% of usable tread or one (1) year, whichever comes first.  Tires that are worn beyond the first 25% of usable tread or are over one (1) year from the date of purchase, will be replaced on a pro-rata basis with comparable new tires based on tread depth remaining, in the form of a Walmart tire credit. Usable tread depth is defined as the depth of the tread down to the final 2/32nds of an inch. The last 2/32nds is not considered usable tread. In addition to the difference between the cost of the replacement tire and the credit amount, you pay the installation cost and any other service charges and applicable taxes and government-mandated charges. In addition, if the defective tire was covered by the Walmart Optional Road Hazard Warranty, you will need to purchase new Optional Road Hazard Warranty coverage on the replacement tire if you wish to continue Road Hazard Warranty Coverage for the new tire. If a tire is deemed eligible for warranty replacement and you have complied with the terms and conditions of the warranty, Walmart will replace the tires as described under “HOW REPLACEMENT CHARGES ARE CALCULATED.” Tires that fail during the warranty period will be eligible for free (except for installation cost and applicable taxes and government-mandated charges) or pro-rata replacement IF AND ONLY IF:

  • You are the original purchaser of the tires, and the tires have been used only on that vehicle.
  • At the time of the adjustment claim, the original tire installation record and the original invoice for purchase of the tires are presented to your local Walmart.
  • The tires have not become unserviceable due to a condition listed under “WHAT IS NOT COVERED.”
  • Tires have been rotated every 6,000-7,500 miles.

WHAT IS NOT COVERED BY THIS LIMITED WARRANTY?

This warranty DOES NOT COVER tires that are damaged or failed due to:

  • Improper repair
  • Vandalism
  • Accident
  • Road hazards
  • Rapid or irregular wear
  • Excessive abuse
  • Misapplication
  • Racing, under-inflation, over-inflation, or other abuse
  • Racing
  • Off-road use
  • Snow chains or studs
  • Worn mechanical components on the vehicle

In addition to the above exclusions, THE WARRANTY DOES NOT APPLY to:

  • Tires that have been used in commercial applications, including but not limited to taxi service, towing, government use, and contract sales.
  • Tires that have been used for racing or off-road purposes.
  • Tires that were not rotated every 6,000-7,500 miles.
  • Tires that have been installed on any vehicle other than the vehicle on which they were originally installed.

This Limited Warranty does not provide compensation for inconvenience or incidental or consequential damages. Some states do not allow the exclusion or limitation of incidental or consequential damages, so the above limitation or exclusion may not apply to you.

HOW ARE REPLACEMENT CHARGES CALCULATED?

If your tire is defective and you have complied with the terms and conditions of this Limited Warranty, Walmart will provide a free replacement tire (except for the tire installation cost and applicable taxes and government-mandated charges) during the first 25% of usable tread or one (1) year, whichever comes first. Tires that are worn beyond the first 25% of usable tread or are over one (1) year from the date of purchase, will be replaced on a pro-rata basis with comparable new tires based on tread depth remaining, in the form of a Walmart tire credit. Usable tread depth is defined as the depth of the tread down to the final 2/32nds of an inch. The last 2/32nds is not considered usable tread. In addition to the difference between the cost of the replacement tire and the credit amount, you pay the tire installation cost and applicable taxes and government-mandated charges. FOR EXAMPLE, if your tire is 1/2 worn at the time your tire is deemed defective, you would receive a credit of half the current price of that tire toward the current price of a new or replacement tire. If the price for a comparable tire is $120, you will pay $60 plus any additional charges such as tire installation cost and any other applicable taxes and fees.

HOW DO I MAKE A CLAIM UNDER THIS LIMITED WARRANTY?

When making a claim under the terms of this Limited Warranty, you must present your tires and the vehicle on which the tires were used to your local Walmart ACC for inspection. To find the location of the nearest Walmart that can process the replacement request, visit our website at 0 and click on “My Local Store” or call 800-925-6278. You must present your original invoice and your Walmart installation record.

This limited warranty does not provide compensation for loss of time, loss of use of vehicle, inconvenience, or incidental or consequential damages. LIMITED TREADWEAR WARRANTY FOR TIRES PURCHASED FROM, AND INSTALLED AT AND BY, WALMART

The original tread will be considered to be worn down when there are 2/32nds of an inch of tread remaining. If a tire does not reach the warranted mileage prior to becoming worn down to 2/32nds of an inch of tread and you have complied with the terms and conditions of the warranty, Walmart will replace the tires as described under “HOW REPLACEMENT CHARGES ARE CALCULATED.”

Tires that wear out before achieving the warranted mileage will be replaced on a pro rata basis ONLY IF:

  • You are the original purchaser of the tires and the tires have been used only on the vehicle they were originally put on at the time of purchase.
  • At the time of the adjustment claim, the original tire installation record, and the original invoice for purchase of the tires are presented to your local Walmart.
  • The tires were rotated every 6,000-7,500 miles.
  • The tires have not become unserviceable due to a condition listed under WHAT IS NOT COVERED below.

WHAT IS NOT COVERED

  • This warranty DOES NOT COVER tires that have become unserviceable due to:
    • Road hazard injury (Examples include, but are not limited to, cuts, snags, impact damage or puncture)
    • Improper repair
    • Misapplication, racing, under-inflation, over-inflation, or other abuse
    • Uneven or rapid wear caused by mechanical irregularity in the vehicle such as wheel misalignment
    • Accident, fire, chemical corrosion, tire alteration or vandalism
    • Flat spotting caused by improper storage, or brake lock
    • Cosmetic zone or weather cracking

 

In addition to the above exclusions, THE WARRANTY DOES NOT APPLY to:

  • Tires that have been used in commercial applications, including but not limited to taxi service, towing, government use, and contract sales.

  • Tires that have had the tread pattern altered in any manner such as, but not limited to, sipping, carving, shaving, or having any material applied to the surface.

HOW REPLACEMENT CHARGES ARE CALCULATED

A mileage tire meeting the conditions for pro rata replacement will be replaced with a comparable new tire based on mileage received, in the form of a Walmart store credit. Walmart will determine the credit amount by multiplying the percent of mileage received by the then current actual selling price at Walmart. In addition to the difference between the cost of the replacement tire and the credit amount, you pay the tire installation cost and applicable taxes and government-mandated charges. FOR EXAMPLE, if a tire warranted for 40,000 miles wore out after 20,000 miles, you would receive a credit of half the current price of that tire toward the current price of a new or replacement tire. So, if the price for a comparable tire is $120, you would pay $60 plus any additional charges such as tire installation cost and any other applicable taxes and fees.

HOW LONG IS THIS OPTIONAL WARRANTY VALID?

Under this optional Warranty, tires found to be defective will be covered by this Warranty for the life of the tires, defined as the duration of usable tread depth. WHAT IS COVERED BY THIS OPTIONAL WARRANTY?

This OPTIONAL Road Hazard Warranty provides additional coverage to tires purchased and installed at Walmart against tire failures caused by nails, glass, metal stones and other similar items that could damage or puncture a tire. The optional Road Hazard Warranty provides protection from tire failures caused by impact breaks and other non-repairable punctures caused by unforeseen hazards of the road. If a tire fails due to an unforeseen road hazard that is covered under this Warranty, this Warranty provides free (except for the cost the installation cost and applicable taxes and government-mandated charges, which must be paid by you) flat repair and pro-rata replacement if the failure is non-repairable. 2. WALMART+ CORE BENEFITS2.1 Walmart+ Free Shipping, No Order Minimum, Free Delivery From Your Store, & Free Pharmacy Delivery Benefits.

The Walmart+ free shipping, no order minimum benefit (“FSNM”) is dependent upon inventory availability, shipping speed, and in some cases, the delivery address and whether freight and location surcharges (see below) apply. Walmart+ FSNM-eligible orders are limited to items sold by Walmart or shipped by Walmart, through Walmart.com or the Walmart App, and certain items sold and shipped by select Marketplace Retailers. Eligible items will be identified on the website with “W+ Free shipping” or a similar badge. The Walmart + free delivery from your store benefit (“Free Delivery”), is available for orders $35 and over, applies to items available for delivery from physical Walmart stores located in your specific delivery area, and for which you select a specific delivery time slot when your order is placed through Walmart.com or the Walmart App. Free Delivery is dependent upon inventory availability, available delivery time slots, and in some cases, the delivery address. Delivery addresses eligible for free delivery may change from time to time, without notice to you. For more information about the details of Walmart+ FSNM and Free Delivery benefits and service, see FAQs, available at 0. The Walmart+ free pharmacy delivery benefit (“Free Pharmacy Delivery”) is available free of charge with no order minimum. It can be used for most types of medications, including maintenance medications, specialty medications and over-the-counter products. Some exceptions may apply. Free pharmacy delivery is not available in all locations or for all timeslots. For more information about Pharmacy Delivery, see FAQs in the lower section of the Pharmacy Delivery Benefit Detail Page

Location Surcharge Fees: As a Walmart+ benefit, for Members only, no location surcharge fees apply to shipments made to Hawaii, Alaska, and Puerto Rico. A surcharge fee applies to shipments made to the Virgin Islands, Guam, Alaskan Samoa, and Mariana Islands: a flat $15 fee is applied to orders weighing 2.5 lbs. or less; orders weighing more than 2.5 lbs. are surcharged at $6/lb. Location surcharges are subject to change without advance notice in these Terms; Fee amounts should be displayed via a separate line in the Payments section of the checkout Cart, as applicable.

2.2 Scan & Go

The Walmart mobile scan & go feature allows Members to use their mobile devices in participating Walmart stores to scan items for purchase into a digital cart, and then to authorize payment for that cart. Any access or use of Scan & Go  is subject to the following additional terms:

·        You agree to accurately scan the barcode for all products you wish to purchase, before checkout, and to pay for all products you obtain from any Walmart store. If you are unable to scan any products for any reason (including due to lack of connectivity with your mobile service), you must consult with a Walmart associate to make sure all items are either reflected in your digital cart before checkout or are reflected on your physical or digital receipt after checkout.

·        Upon scanning the relevant barcode for a product, that product will appear in your digital cart on your mobile device, along with the price for that product. Upon scanning certain products, like some fruits and vegetables, your digital cart will only reflect an estimated price for the product. The price for such products will be finalized as part of the exit and payment process, where you will be asked to weigh or provide the item count for the product. As a result, the total payment amount reflected for your digital cart may change.

·        You agree that Walmart may review the products in your possession and/or your receipt or proof of purchase on your mobile device at any time (sometimes referred to as an “item check”), and that Walmart can require that any products be re-scanned or removed from your physical and/or digital cart, and that any product price or digital cart total be re-calculated. In the event you and any Walmart associate calculate different totals for your purchase, the calculation confirmed by the Walmart associate will be the amount payable by you.

·        To finalize your purchase and exit the store, before leaving, you are required and agree: (i) to proceed to any available self-checkout register, and then pair your mobile device with the self-checkout register by scanning the QR code displayed on the screen; (ii) after pairing your mobile device with a self-checkout register, to follow the instructions provided , which may include, among other things, weighing certain fruits and vegetables, providing proof of age in order to purchase age-restricted items, or submitting to an item check; and (iii) upon completion of all instructions, to select your preferred payment method and complete your payment. After you complete payment, you will receive a digital receipt of the transaction (or, in some cases, a physical receipt may be rendered to you from the self-checkout register), and may exit the store.

·        In some Walmart locations where a self-checkout register is not currently enabled, or in other select circumstances, you may be required to complete a “digital cart transfer”, which transfers products scanned into your digital cart over to a self-checkout register or to a staffed register, where your transaction will be completed in the traditional manner (but without having to re-scan all of your items again at the register).

·        Subject to the laws of the jurisdiction of the store location in which you are shopping, you may be able to scan certain age-restricted items, like alcohol, into your digital cart provided you meet the minimum age requirements of that jurisdiction. Walmart may alter, suspend, or terminate use of Scan & Go at any time at its discretion without notice to you.

·        For certain large purchases, you will be asked to confirm your payment method and identity with a Walmart associate located at the store exit by presenting the credit card used for the transaction and a government-issued photo identification. If you are unable or unwilling to do so, you must pay for your purchase using traditional check-out methods.

·        We may elect to make certain items in our stores ineligible for purchase through Scan & Go at any time, in our sole discretion, with no prior notice to you (for example, firearms, ammunition, alcohol, tobacco, gift cards that are not pre-activated, tires, car batteries, hearing center items, R-rated movies and games, prescriptions and some harsh chemicals).

A. Order Acceptance and Billing

You represent and warrant that you have the right to use any credit card or other means of payment that you provide to us. We do this to ensure that the card details are still valid and that you have sufficient funds to complete the transaction. Walmart participates in account update services offered by some banks. If your bank participates in account updater services, these services will automatically update your card number or expiration date in our system when it changes. If you do not want to have your cards automatically updated, you can opt out of these services by contacting your issuing bank. 5. Conduct of Arbitration.

In any arbitration of a dispute or claim that is subject to the Arbitration Agreement:

  1. You or Walmart may file such dispositive motions as would be permitted by the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure without obtaining permission from the arbitrator. Upon the filing of any dispositive motion, the arbitrator may stay all further action and deadlines in the arbitration until deciding such motion.
  2. The parties shall have the right to conduct such discovery from the opposing party or any third party that is proportional to the needs of the claim or dispute, considering the importance of the issues at stake, the amount in controversy, the importance of the discovery in resolving the issues, and whether the burden or expense of the proposed discovery outweighs its likely benefit. Proportionality shall be decided by the arbitrator when requested by either party. The arbitrator shall take into account the individual, non-collective, non-representative, and non-class basis of the action when deciding discovery disputes.
  3. The arbitrator shall conduct any calls, conferences, or hearings by teleconference or videoconference, unless the arbitrator determines that an in-person hearing is appropriate. Any in-person hearing will be held at a location that is reasonably convenient, if practicable. You and an employee of Walmart shall attend all arbitrator calls, conferences, and hearings.
  4. A party may make a written offer of judgment at least seven (7) days before the date set for the arbitration hearing. If a party declines an offer of judgment and fails to obtain a more favorable award, the declining party shall not be entitled to its post-offer costs and shall be responsible for the offering party’s post-offer costs. The arbitrator may decide to include expert fees in said costs.
  5. If the arbitrator finds that a party’s claim, counterclaim, appeal, or violation of Section 20.30 was frivolous, asserted in bad faith, or pursued for purposes of harassment, the arbitrator shall award the opposing party their attorneys’ fees, costs, and expenses and all amounts charged by AAA for the arbitration.The arbitrator may enter such award against a party, any of their attorneys, or both.
  6. The arbitrator will follow these Terms of Use and the law. The arbitrator shall not have the authority to commit errors of law or legal reasoning. The arbitrator may award relief only in favor of the individual party seeking relief and only to the extent necessary to provide relief warranted by that individual party’s claim. The arbitrator may not award relief for or against anyone who is not a party, though the individual relief awarded by the arbitrator may incidentally affect non-parties. Subject to any available appeals, and consistent with the individual nature of the arbitration, the arbitration award shall be binding as between you and Walmart, but it shall have no preclusive effect on disputes between Walmart and other parties, even if represented by the same counsel on the same or similar issues.
  7. You or Walmart may appeal an arbitration award that manifestly disregards the law by filing a notice of appeal with the AAA within 30 days after an award is rendered and delivered to the parties. The appeal shall be heard by a single arbitrator unless the parties agree to a multi-arbitrator appellate panel. The arbitrator(s) assigned to the appeal shall be selected by agreement of the parties from among those on the AAA Appellate Panel. If the parties are unable to agree, AAA shall appoint the arbitrator(s) from among those on the AAA Appellate Panel. 6. Process for Arbitration Bellwether Demands.

If twenty-five (25) or more Demands for arbitration of a dispute or claim subject to the Arbitration Agreement are initiated (i) that involve common questions of law or fact and (ii) where the initiating parties are represented by the same law firm, the same group of coordinated law firms, or the same representative, then such Demands shall be administered pursuant to this paragraph. The group of claimants and group of respondents shall each select five (5) Demands, for a total of ten (10), to be filed with AAA (collectively the “Bellwether Demands”). Each of the Bellwether Demands shall be assigned by AAA to a different arbitrator chosen from its national roster. Each Bellwether Demand will be decided individually by the assigned arbitrator without preclusive effect as to the other arbitrations. After ninety (90) days from the date all Bellwether Demands have been arbitrated and any appeals exhausted, any remaining Demands subject to this paragraph may be filed with AAA. The statute of limitations shall be tolled during this process. You and Walmart agree that this bellwether process is useful to each party and their individual claim to encourage the efficient resolution of disputes. The AAA Mass Arbitration Supplementary Rules shall apply to the extent they are not inconsistent with this paragraph. This process shall also apply to any appeals that may be taken from arbitrations administered pursuant to this paragraph. Notwithstanding any other provision in the Terms of Use, You and Walmart agree that a court of competent jurisdiction shall have authority to enforce the terms of this paragraph with injunctive or other relief.

Walmart Services

Better Care Services

Better Care Services is a program on Walmart.com where customers can compare and access virtual care services offered by curated telehealth providers. These third-party providers offer urgent care, mental health, prescription renewal, and many other services.

The services offered may vary based on provider licensing and state regulations.

Participating Providers

  • Urgent Care
    • Teladoc Health, Doctor on Demand, Wheel, and Curai
  • Mental Health
    • Teladoc Health, Doctor on Demand, BetterHelp, and Cabana
  • GLP-1 Weight Solutions
    • MyCare by Twin Health, Curai, Wheel
  • Weight Management Support Services
    • Berry Street, Aaptiv, BetterHelp, Teladoc Health

Common Questions about Urgent Care and Mental Health Services

How it works

How do I book a virtual visit?

Choose a service and provider on Walmart.com. You’ll be redirected to the provider’s website or app to complete registration, schedule your visit, and make payment.

Do I need to create or have a provider account?

Each provider manages its own patient portal for scheduling, intake forms, and medical records.

What technology is required?

You’ll need a smartphone, tablet, or computer with internet access. Requirements may vary depending on the provider.

What if a customer needs emergency care?

Telehealth is not suitable for emergencies. Please call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room for serious or life-threatening symptoms.

Privacy and Security

Is customer health information shared with Walmart?

No, your medical information stays with the telehealth provider you select.

Are telehealth visits HIPAA-compliant?

Please see each telehealth provider’s privacy policies.

Payments & Insurance

How much does a visit cost?

Pricing, insurance coverage, and payment are handled directly by the telehealth provider.

Can customers use insurance?

Some providers accept insurance while others offer cash-pay options. You can confirm coverage on the provider’s website.

Who handles billing questions?

Please contact the telehealth provider directly for any billing or payment questions.

Support and troubleshooting

Who handles appointment or technical issues?

Once you’ve been redirected from Walmart.com, the telehealth provider handles all appointments, technical, and clinical support.

What if something goes wrong on Walmart.com before redirecting to a provider?

Walmart customer support can assist with browsing or Walmart.com site navigation issues. Once redirected, all support is handled by the telehealth provider.

After the Visit

Where can I find visit notes or results?

Your records will be available in the telehealth provider’s patient portal. Walmart does not store or have access to this information.

How do customers schedule follow-up visits?

Follow-up visits can be scheduled directly through the provider’s website or app.

Nutrition Hub

Nutrition Hub is an opt-in experience that provides personalized insights for your everyday wellbeing.  Nutrition Hub helps you understand how grocery purchases support your nutrition and wellness goals.  Get inspired with new foods and recipes aligned with your budget and shopping preferences.  And receive personalized recommendations designed by nutrition experts.

Common Questions

Data Accuracy

Why don’t I see any nutrition insights?

You may not see insights yet for a few reasons: 

  • If you’re new to grocery shopping with Walmart or just created an online account, it could take up to 24 hours to see the first insights
  • If you do not shop at Walmart or only use non-traceable payment methods like cash, Walmart may not be able to find your transactions. 

The total amount you’re saying I spent seems wrong. Why?

Some transactions may not be linked to your Walmart.com account, especially in-store purchases or purchases paid for with cash.

Why are the items different from what I see in my purchase history on Walmart.com?

Your Walmart.com purchase history shows your online orders and some in-store purchases made with payment cards saved to your Walmart.com wallet. Nutrition Hub may show more in-store purchases than what appears in your Walmart.com purchase history.

Can I use Nutrition Hub if I only shop in stores?

Yes, but you must create a Walmart.com account to access Nutrition Hub. Once you have a Walmart.com account, we will attempt to associate your online account with your store purchases. Using Walmart Pay or a saved payment method helps with this. Cash purchases can only be linked if you enter your phone number at checkout to get a text receipt.

Recommendations

Why don’t I have recommendations for all my purchases?

Some purchases may not be linked to your account. Others may not have enough nutrition data or may not have good alternatives. Using Walmart Pay or credit cards saved in your Walmart.com account is the best way to track your purchases.

Data and Privacy

Can I opt out of Nutrition Hub?

Yes. You can opt out of Nutrition Hub, Everyday Health Signals and any associated programs at any time under “Privacy & Data Preferences” in Nutrition Hub. Once you opt out, you will no longer have access to personalized recommendations or nutrition insights.

Will my goals or nutrition data affect my Walmart account in any other way?

No, your goals and nutrition data are used within Nutrition Hub only and will not impact your Walmart purchases, prices, or other personalized experiences.

Access and Features

How do I access Nutrition Hub?

You can currently use Nutrition Hub on Walmart.com.

  • On the website, simply search “Nutrition Hub” in the search bar and hat will open up the Nutrition Hub website in your browser, or
  • Go directly to: walmart.com/health-and-wellness/everyday-health-signals

Do I need a Walmart+ membership to use Nutrition Hub?

No. Nutrition Hub is available to all Walmart customers who have a Walmart account and opt-in.

Resold at Walmart

The Resold at Walmart program offers customers high-quality items in conditions other than “New.” These include:

  • Pre-Owned items: previously used products resold by trusted Marketplace sellers.
  • Restored items: professionally refurbished products that meet Walmart’s quality and performance standards.

All Resold items clearly display their condition and seller type, so customers know what to expect before purchasing.

Restored

Restored items are professionally refurbished and may be offered in these sub-conditions: Premium, Like New, Good, and Fair. Details for each are below.

What “Restored Premium” Means at Walmart

Restored Premium items are refurbished to the highest standard and tested to ensure like-new performance and reliability. These items are typically sold by manufacturers, manufacturer-authorized sellers, or trusted sellers authorized by Walmart.

Returns and warranty requirements include:

  • 30-day returns*
  • At least a 1-year warranty on all Restored Premium items (except select vacuum cleaners — see product page).
  • For third-party sellers, use the Contact seller option to request a copy of the warranty.

*Some return exceptions apply, as certain items may have a shortened return window or a restocking fee. See the item return details for more information.

What “Restored: Like New,” “Restored: Good,” and “Restored: Fair” Mean at Walmart

Restored items are professionally refurbished by a trusted seller, supplier, manufacturer, or authorized reseller. Each product is:

  • Inspected and tested for full functionality
  • Cleaned and repaired (if needed)
  • Verified to meet Walmart’s standards

Returns and warranty requirements include:

  • Free 90-day returns are available for Restored (Like New, Good, Fair) items.
  • To ask about warranties or product details, use the Contact seller link on the item’s page.
Who Refurbishes Restored Items
  • Manufacturer – the brand that originally designed and produced the item.
  • Authorized reseller – approved by the brand or manufacturer.
  • Walmart trusted seller – third party reviewed and authorized by Walmart to sell certain Resold items.
  • Walmart
Pre-Owned (Inclusive of All Non-New Conditions Outside of Restored)

Pre-Owned items are products that have been used before and are now sold by trusted third-party sellers on Walmart.com.

Return and warranty requirements include:

  • Free 30-day returns are available for most Pre-Owned items.*
  • To ask about warranties or product details, use the Contact seller link on the item’s page.

*Some return exceptions apply, as certain items may have a shortened return window or a restocking fee. See the item return details for more information.

All Available Non-New / Pre-Owned Conditions

  • Pre-Owned: Like New, Good, and Fair
  • Open Box
  • New without box or tags
  • New with defects
  • Remanufactured

Additional Details

  • All Resold items include a clear condition label that describes its appearance, functionality, and level of prior use. Condition types may vary by product category and seller eligibility.
  • Most Resold items are eligible for free returns within their designated return windows.
  • Return exceptions apply during the holiday season and on certain electronics, collectibles, and luxury fashion items. See our Marketplace Return Policy for more details.

How to Start a Return

  1. Go to your Walmart.com account.
  2. Select the order containing your Resold item.
  3. Choose Start a return and follow the prompts.
  4. You can also bring eligible Marketplace returns to a Walmart store.

Tracking updates usually appear within two business days after drop-off.

For more information about returns, refunds, and eligible items, see the Marketplace Return Policy or the item’s return details.

VIZIO & Onn powered by VIZIO TV Setup

Starting mid-March 2026, you must sign in with or create a Walmart account when setting up a new VIZIO or  Onn powered by VIZIO TV. A Walmart account is required to use Smart TV features and streaming apps. 

What’s Changing?

  • A Walmart account is now required during Smart TV setup. 

 

  • VIZIO Accounts are no longer used for Smart TV setup. 

To access apps, streaming services, software updates, and downloads, you must sign in with a Walmart account. 

Who to Contact for Help

TV setup or hardware issues- Contact VIZIO Customer Support at 844‑254‑8087 

Walmart account issues (password, sign-in, phone verification)- Contact Walmart Customer Care. 

FAQs

Do I need a Walmart account to use my TV? 

Yes. A Walmart account is required to use Smart TV features and apps. You can still watch TV through HDMI or antenna without signing in. 

Can I skip sign-in during setup? 

Yes. You can skip it and use basic TV functions. You’ll need to sign in later to use apps and Smart TV features. 

I already have a Walmart account. Why is it asking me to create one? 

Make sure you’re using the correct email or phone number. If needed, select “Forgot password” to reset your account. 

Why do I need to enter my phone number? 

Your phone number is used for identity verification and security. 

Can I use the same Walmart account on multiple TVs? 

Yes. You can use one Walmart account on multiple eligible VIZIO and onn TVs. 

I forgot my password. What should I do? 

Select “Forgot password” on the sign-in screen and follow the steps to reset it. 

My phone number is already linked to another account. What does that mean? 

Each phone number can only be linked to one Walmart account. You may need to use a different number or confirm moving the number to your current account.

Walmart Everyday Choice

Who do I call for any questions?

Look in the initial email sent to you or reach directly to your partnered organization. For Walmart related questions, call 866-448-7339 (TTY: 711), Mon-Fri, 6am-9pm CT excluding Thanksgiving & Christmas.

How do I add my card to my Walmart.com Wallet?

You will need a Walmart account before adding your card to your Walmart.com Wallet. Look in the initial email sent to you by your partnered organization. Click on Add to Wallet and follow the steps on your screen.

How can I find eligible items on Walmart.com?

  1. Add your card to your Walmart account before viewing eligible items.
  2. As you search for eligible items, look for the Walmart Card icon [include graphic] found under the item details and when clicking on the item for more details.
  3. To view only eligible items, use the “Benefit Programs” filter, then select your program to view program eligible items only. 
  4. When checking out, any balance available on your Walmart Everyday Choice card will be applied to pay for eligible items in your cart. You can use any additional payment type for the remaining items in your cart.

What types of products are not covered?

This will vary based on your program. Add your card to your Walmart account and follow the steps above to find eligible items.

How do I track the amount available and when they expire?

  1. On Walmart.com or via the Walmart App
    1. Add your card to your Walmart account
    2. Once added, you will be able to view balance and fund expiration dates using these ways:
      1. In your Walmart account where the card is saved
      2. At walmart.com/everydaychoice when your card is saved to your account
      3. During checkout, click “Edit Payment” to view funds that are being used and funds remaining
  2. You can also call the number listed on this page to retrieve your card balance

Do unused funds expire?

Your partnered organization chooses when your benefits expire and whether the benefits roll over. Review your initial Everyday Choice email, the Benefit Tracker, or reach out to your organization to know when your funds expire.

How do I shop with my funds in-store?

  1. Open “Services” on your Walmart app. Click “check a price”
  2. Hover your phone over the in-store item’s barcode to scan.
  3. The in-store item will show on your app and will show the eligible badging icon below Delivery and Pickup information.
  4. Pay with your Walmart Everyday Choice Card at any register when you checkout. The card will only pay for the eligible items. You will need a second payment method for any products not covered by your Walmart Everyday Choice card.

Are shipping costs covered with this program?

Coverage of shipping costs varies by program. If your program covers shipping, this will be automatically reflected during checkout.

Do I pay sales tax or tax on delivery or shipping charges?

Orders are subject to state sales tax based on the state in which you reside. Orders may also be subject to a tax on delivery or shipping charges. Coverage of taxes varies by program. If your program covers some or all these taxes, this will be automatically reflected during checkout.

What if my purchase costs more than my funds?

If your total is more than your available/remaining benefits on your Walmart Everyday Choice Card, you will need to pay the balance due out of pocket with another payment method. You can use any payment type for the remaining balance, in-store or online.

Where is my order?

When shopping online, you can track your order from your shipping confirmation email or by visiting Walmart.com. You can read more at the Walmart Help Center.

Can I return, exchange, or request a refund on products?

Items bought with your Walmart Everyday Choice Card in-store may be returned with a receipt for a refund to your Walmart Everyday Choice Card or exchanged for the same item. Items may not be returned for cash. Items purchased on Walmart.com will be refunded to the original method of payment.

What happens if my card is lost, stolen or damaged?

Call your partnered organization or Walmart Everyday Choice at 866-448-7339 (TTY: 711). Walmart call centers are open from 6am-9pm CT, 7 days a week, excluding Thanksgiving & Christmas.

Walmart Protection Plans by Allstate

The Walmart Protection Plans by Allstate are available for some products sold on Walmart.com.

How to Buy a Protection Plan

You can select a protection plan on the item page or at checkout for eligible items. Protection plans for online orders must be purchased during checkout. If you would like a protection plan after you checkout, you can buy a protection plan in store within 30 days of your online order with your receipt.

How Protection Plans Work

Coverage starts on the date of purchase and not after the manufacturer’s warranty expires.

  • The Manufacturer warranty covers when the item itself is defective.
  • The protection plan covers:
    • Defects
    • Accidents
    • Damage to the item
    • Replacements or repairs at no additional cost where applicable

To learn more, see Walmart Protection Plans by Allstate. Here you can find Frequently Asked Questions, Terms and Conditions, and more.

Types of Plans

The Standard Plan

  • The Standard Plan is for products such as TVs, home appliances, lawn & garden, power tools, etc.
  • The Standard Plan covers:
    • Mechanical and electrical failures
    • Power surges or power supply failure
    • Breakdowns during normal use

The Accident Plan

  • The Accident Plan is for select portable electronics such as laptops, tablets, phones, and headphones.
  • The Accident Plan covers:
    • Drops and cracked screens
    • Spills and liquid damage
    • Everything covered in Standard Plans

File a New Claim

  1. Go to Walmart Protection Plans by Allstate.
  2. Select File a claim.
  3. Login or set up your account.
  4. Follow the prompts to file a claim.

To Track an Existing Claim

Use these steps to track a claim you’ve already submitted:

  1. Go to Walmart Protection Plans by Allstate.
  2. Select File a claim.
  3. Login to your account.
  4. Follow the prompts to track a claim.

Unpause Membership

  • Select Undo pause to unpause your membership if it’s before the end of the current billing cycle, in which case you’ll be billed for your membership in the usual course.

Resume Membership

Once the paused month is over your membership will resume and we’ll bill you for your membership on your regular billing date. Once paused, you can choose to resume at any time during the paused month. The day that you resume will be your new billing date going forward.

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. Go to the Account page.
  3. Select Walmart+.
  4. Go to the Manage membership page.
  5. Select Resume membership.
  6. Confirm your payment method on the next screen.
    • This page shows the amount and date for the next charge.
  7. Select Resume Membership.
    • All benefits resume right away.
    • Date on which you resume becomes your new billing date. 

Cancel Membership

  1. Go to your walmart.com account.
  2. Select Walmart+.
  3. Select Manage membership.
  4. Select Manage beside Walmart+ plan.
  5. Select Cancel beside Cancel membership.
  6. Select one of the following:

 

    • Confirm cancellation
    • View exclusive offer
    • Keep membership

Remind Me Later

If you choose to cancel your membership, you’ll see a prompt to get a Remind Me Later email sent three days before your renewal date, so you don’t need to cancel immediately.

Reactivate a Canceled Membership

If you change your mind about cancelling your Walmart+ membership before the end of your billing cycle:

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Walmart+.
  4. Select the Reactivate membership.

Walmart+ Troubleshooting

Walmart App is Crashing or Not Working

  1. Turn on your phone’s location and camera services.
  2. If the location and camera are on, try hard closing and reopening the app.
  3. If the app is still not working, uninstall and reinstall the Walmart app.
  4. If you are unable to reactivate your account, double check your membership payment method. If expired or invalid, you must update the payment method before you can reactivate.

Activation Error

Follow the steps if you receive the following error message during sign up.

“Your payment method couldn’t be verified. Please check the card number, security code, and expiration date and try again, or use a different payment method.”

Confirm your payment card information:

  1. Re-enter the full card number.
  2. Confirm the expiration date.
  3. Confirm the name on the card.
  4. Confirm the billing address and Zip code for the card.
  5. Confirm the phone number.

How it Works

Free Flat Repair

Bring any tire with a puncture to the auto care center for repair. If we can repair the tire, we’ll do it for free. Non-members pay $15 for this service.

This benefit applies only to tires installed on passenger cars, light trucks, minivans, small recreational vehicles (RVs), & crossovers.

If you get a flat tire:

  1. Bring your flat or damaged tire into a Walmart auto care center.
    • No appointment needed.
  2. Check in with one of our certified technicians to verify your membership.
  3. We will take care of repairing your tire at no cost.

This benefit only applies to tires on:

  • Passenger cars
  • Light trucks (Pickup trucks, Vans, and SUVs)
  • Minivans
  • Crossovers
  • Small RVs (Camper vans and trucks)

Free Road Hazard Warranty

When you purchase a tire installation package, we’ll offer you the Value package with road hazard protection for the price of the Basic package. This saves $10 per tire.

  • If you have road hazard protection on an earlier purchase (Tires and vehicle), you can still get it on another set of tires on another vehicle.
    • Learn more about free road hazard warranty.

Learn more information about Auto care for Walmart+ members.

New York Auto Care Program Compliance

Due to a new law, Walmart+ members aren’t eligible to receive the Walmart+ Auto Care Center Road Hazard Warranty benefit in New York state after February 28, 2025.

If you bought tires and installation at a Walmart Auto Care Center in any state, including New York, before February 28, 2025, we’ll honor the Road Hazard Warranty.

  • You must be an active Walmart+ member.
  • The warranty must be applied to the tires at the time of purchase.

Walmart+ Benefits – Returns from Home

Returns have never been easier than they are with Walmart+. With Walmart+ you don’t have to go to a store to return your items. We come to you!

To start a return, go to the Walmart App and select Returns from Home. Depending on your availability and location, you may see one or both of these pickup options:

  • FedEx Pickup
  • Returns from Home Pickup

If FedEx Pickup option is selected, pack the item, print and attach the FedEx return label, and leave the package ready for pickup. You do not need to be home when FedEx arrives.

Return from Home Pickup

To initiate a return from home:

  1. When you’re logged into Walmart.com select Account.
  2. Select Purchase History and locate the order with the item(s) you want to return.
  3. Select Start a Return and place a checkmark next to the item(s) you wish to return. 
    1. Only eligible items will be available to return. Some restrictions apply – See Return pick up policy under Terms of Use.
  4. Select the reason you’d like to return and add comments. (optional)
    1. Repeat the above steps if you’re returning more than one item.
  5. Select the From Home option.
  6. Once From Home is selected, the member will see one or both the options below:
    • Return from Home pickup options
    • Some Walmart+ members may see only the FedEx Pickup option.
  7. Select date & time of pickup.
  8. Select the above as per your choice, review your return. 
    • If everything is correct, select Submit.

Cancel Return Pickup

To cancel return pickup:

  1. When you’re logged into Walmart.com select Account.
  2. Select Purchase History and locate the order with the item(s) that you set up the return for.
  3. Select Cancel return.

On Pickup Day

If FedEx pick up is selected:

  1. Print the FedEx return label from the app, website, or return confirmation email.
  2. Package the item and attach the return label.
  3. Leave the package outside for pickup on the scheduled date. No need to be home for pickup.

For non-FedEx return option:

  1. You are not required to pack the item in a box.
  2. Show the bar code to the delivery driver when they arrive and hand them the item(s).
  3. You must be home to hand off the return.

Find Your Return Label

If a member cannot find their return label:

  • Please find the return label under order details in the Walmart app or website, or
  • Check their return confirmation email.

Return In-Store

If a member does not have access to a printer or return pickup option not available, please return the item in-store.

Walmart+ Billing and Payments

We offer a $1 trial for Walmart+. During the trial period, you will be charged $1. After the trial ends, your membership will automatically renew, and you will be charged for your selected plan.See Walmart+ Membership for plans and pricing.

Walmart+ Payment Methods

You must use a credit/debit card or PayPal to sign up for Walmart+.

Updating Walmart+ Payment Method

To update your payment method:

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. Select Walmart+.
  3. Select Manage Membership.
  4. Select the arrow by Payments & Billing.
  5. Select Change by Current payment method.

Failed Payment Method Reminder

A few days before your selected payment method will be charged for your current monthly or annual term, we’ll check to see if your selected payment method can be charged (for instance, by checking to confirm the payment method has sufficient funds for the expected charge, or that it hasn’t expired). If there’s a problem, we may show you a message on the Walmart.com website or Walmart app, or via email, text, and/or push notification, asking you to select a new payment method to ensure continuous access to your Walmart+ benefits.

Providing a valid payment method will prevent your Walmart+ membership from expiring.

Change Billing Date

You can change the billing date of your Walmart+ and InHome membership. If you change your Walmart+ billing date, your InHome billing date changes, too.

When can’t I change my billing date?

  • During a trial period
  • Within 48 hours before your current billing date
  • If you’ve already updated it five times in a 12-month rolling period
  • If your InHome bill date is currently different from your Walmart+ membership bill date
    • Go to Manage Membership to see your bill dates
  • If you have Paramount+ Premium through Walmart+

To Change Your Billing Date

  1. Sign into your Walmart account.
  2. Select Walmart+.
  3. Select Manage Membership.
  4. Select Manage beside Walmart+ Plan.
  5. Select Change next to Change billing date.
  6. Choose the new payment date.
  7. Select Continue.
  8. Review changes.
  9. Select Confirm.

Billing Date Change - Examples

Monthly Membership

  • Current billing date: 15th of the month
  • New billing date: 2nd of the month
  • The amount you’ll pay on the 2nd (new date) will reflect the monthly cost plus the amount from the 15th (current date) to the 2nd (new date) of next month.
  • All bills after this change would be on the 2nd of the month unless you request a new date.
  • If you select a date from the 29th to the 31st, for months that do not have a date in that range, you will see a charge on the last day of that calendar month.

Annual Membership

  • Current billing date: January 15
  • New billing date: May 4
  • Choose a date up to 364 days ahead of the current billing date.
  • The amount you’ll pay on May 4th will reflect the annual cost plus the amount for the days between the current billing date (January 15) and the new billing date (May 4).
  • All bills after this will be on May 4 unless you request a new date.

You can change your billing date up to five times in a 12-month rolling period if you are on a monthly or annual plan.

You can change your billing date on the Manage Membership page up to 48 hours before your upcoming billing date.

Walmart+ Charges

When you sign up for Walmart+ and InHome, or Paramount+ Premium, you’ll see separate charges on your bank statement. After the first charge, all future charges will appear on or after your membership renewal date. On or after your billing date, we authorize a payment for these plans, and your bank places a hold on that amount to make sure there are enough funds. This will show as a pending charge on your bank account until it is posted.

Examples of Walmart+ Charges

  • Walmart+ Base Plan Example: “Walmart+ Member 08/25” or “Walmart+ Member PRORATED”
  • Plus Upfor Showtime Example: “W+Paramount+Prem08/25” or  “W+Paramount+PRORATED” or “W+Paramount+Prem2025”
  • Plus Upfor Inhome Example: “Walmart+Inhome 08/25” or  “W+Inhome+PRORATED” or “Walmart+Inhome2025”

Unrecognized Walmart+ Charges

You may have a compromised card if you don’t recognize Walmart+ charges on your credit/debit card. Use the Chat with us button to get immediate help. When prompted, type Unauthorized Charges in the chat window. See Account Security and Unrecognized Charges or Orders for more information. 

Walmart+ Refund Policy

We’re not able to offer refunds on Walmart+. See the Walmart+ Terms of Use for more information.
