Video Streaming Choice FAQ

Which streaming services are included in my Video Streaming Choice benefit?

Choose either Paramount+ Essential or Peacock Premium (both ad-supported). Paid members who are registered with the Paramount+ Essential plan through their Walmart+ membership can upgrade Paramount+ to the ad-free Paramount+ Premium plan for an extra charge through their Walmart+ account hub. Similarly,  Paid members who are registered with the Peacock Premium plan through their Walmart+ membership can upgrade to ad free peacock premium plus plan for an extra charge through their Walmart+ account hub.

What if I already have an account with one of the included streaming services? 

If you already have a Paramount+ or Peacock account, you’ll need to cancel your existing subscription before activating the streaming benefit through Walmart+. Once your current subscription has fully expired, go to your Walmart+ account hub and follow the steps to connect your account and start streaming. 

What happens if I have a free promotional upgrade trial and downgrade or cancel it?

If you’re on one of our free promotional upgrade trials, you’ll lose access immediately to the promotion if you downgrade or cancel the upgrade plan. If you change your mind, you can upgrade as long as you’re eligible.

How often am I allowed to switch between streaming services?

You may switch your streaming service provider once every 90 days.

Am I able to upgrade from the ad-supported tier?

If you want to upgrade from the ad-supported tier of your current service, Paramount+ Premium & Peacock Premium Plus is available for upgrade option. If your current service is Paramount+ or Peacock Premium, you can upgrade at any time. Your upgraded-tier subscription will start immediately and your monthly billing cycle will begin. If your current service is Peacock, you’ll need to wait until the end of the 90-day period to switch to Paramount+. Once you switch, you can then choose the upgrade option. 

What happens if I’m on the upgraded tier of a streaming service and downgrade?

If you’re on the upgraded tier of your streaming service and downgrade to the ad-supported version, no refunds will be issued. You’ll continue to have access through the end of your billing cycle and will not be charged at your next renewal date. If you’re on the upgraded tier and switch to a different streaming service, you’ll immediately lose access to both the upgraded and ad-supported tiers of your current streaming service and will receive a prorated refund for the canceled portion of that service.

What if I want to stay on my current streaming service instead of switching after 90 days?

If you want to stay on your current streaming service after 90 days, no action is needed. Your current streaming service will remain active.

Are trial members eligible for streaming services?

Trial members are welcome to use the Video Streaming Choice benefit. Only paid Walmart+ members can purchase a plan upgrade (e.g., Paramount+ Premium and and Peacock Premium Plus plans).

Walmart+ Student

Walmart+ Student is a discounted membership. Qualifying students get 50% off a monthly or annual plan by simply visiting www.walmart.com/plus/student & completing the Walmart+ Student sign-up process.

Eligibility

To qualify for Walmart+ Student, you agree:

  • You are 18 years of age or older
  • You are a current or incoming student enrolled in an undergraduate or advanced degree program at a Title IV-accredited college or university in the US who meets verification qualifications
  • You reside in the United States (including its territories, commonwealths and possessions)
  • To provide proof of enrollment.

Terms

  • Members will continue to get their discount for as long as they remain eligible.
  • Membership will start as a 30-day trial when qualified.
  • Following a 30-day trial, members will automatically be enrolled in the plan type they chose when signing up (monthly/annual).
  • Current members can switch to Walmart+ Student at any time when eligible.
  • Cancelled members can reactivate to Walmart+ Student if eligible.

Verification Process

You must first verify student eligibility through SheerID before redeeming the discount. You must be an active student to pass verification. SheerID will request more information from you, if needed to finish the process.

Eligibility Problems

If SheerID couldn’t verify you, you’ll need to contact SheerID to find out why. Walmart does not have access to SheerID’s systems to troubleshoot the issue.

Contacting SheerID

  1. Go to www.sheerid.com.
  2. Select the Get Help button in the top-right corner.
  3. Select the Contact SheerID support team button.
  4. Fill in the form and select Next.

Current Walmart+ Members Switching to Student

  • If you are a current paid member who qualifies, the system cancels your current membership and gives you a prorated refund. The system activates your new membership immediately.

    • We’ll bill you for the new discounted membership when it starts. You’ll get an email with the transaction history and your new renewal date.
    • If we can’t issue a refund to the original form of payment, you’ll get a Walmart Gift Card for the prorated refund amount.

  • If you are a member who joined Walmart+ through a membership program such as Verizon or Tracfone, you would have to end your current membership through the partner program before signing up.

Re-verification

We’ll automatically try to re-verify your Walmart+ Student membership status each year to ensure you still qualify. If we can’t automatically re-verify that you are a student, we’ll let you know through email. You must follow the link in the email to re-verify through SheerID.

If you’re no longer eligible, we’ll bill for the full membership fee unless you cancel.

Already Have a Walmart+ Membership?

You can now switch between different discount offers easily. If you already have a discounted membership, you can still sign up for a new one (like Assist or Student) to start when your current offer ends. This works the other way too. This means you can plan ahead without losing access to these plans. Not all discounted memberships are eligible for this switch.

If you’re a full priced paid member, you can switch anytime or wait until your current membership ends.

Walmart+ Student FAQ

What is Walmart+ Student?

Walmart+ Student is a program where eligible customers can join Walmart+ at a discounted rate. This program is offered to anyone enrolled in an eligible higher education institution.

What types of students are eligible?

You are eligible for Walmart+ Student if you meet all the following criteria:

  • You are 18 years of age or older
  • You are a current or incoming student enrolled in an undergraduate or advanced degree program at a Title IV-accredited college or university in the US who meets verification qualifications
  • You reside in the United States (including its territories, commonwealths and possessions)

Does Walmart+ Student offer a free trial?

Yes, customers that have never been a Walmart+ member before & are successfully verified will get a 30-day free trial to start their membership.

How is Walmart+ Student different from a full price Walmart+ membership?

Walmart+ Student members enjoy every membership benefit that full price Walmart+ members enjoy, just at a discounted rate of $6.47/month or $49/year.

Which membership types are eligible for Walmart+ Student?

New members, existing members that are not participating in select third party offers  and are not enrolled in Paramount+ Premium, canceled members, paused members & trial members are all eligible for Walmart+ Student. Walmart+ Assist members are not eligible.

  • In order to transfer your membership from Walmart+ to Walmart+ Student, simply visit www.walmart.com/plus/student & complete the Walmart+ Student sign-up process.

Note: If your Walmart+ membership is associated with a service you receive through another company (such as Verizon, Tracfone, etc.), you will need to end that association before being able to sign up for Walmart+ Student.

How will I be verified for eligibility to enroll in the Walmart+ Student discounted membership?

Walmart+ has partnered with a third-party verification provider called “SheerID” to verify your eligibility for Walmart+ Student. As part of the membership enrollment process, you will be requested to fill out a SheerID eligibility verification form. Documentation may be necessary for verification, in which case, you will be taken to the SheerID website where you will upload your document(s). Upon successful completion of verification, you will be requested to continue with your Walmart+ Student enrollment on the Walmart site/app.

What qualifying documents do I need to provide to verify my eligibility?

You may only need to show documents if your initial verification fails. SheerID will let you know what specific document you need to upload to prove eligibility.

What is SheerID?

SheerID is a third-party verification service that works on behalf of retailers to verify an individual’s affiliations. For information on their services, visit them at www.SheerID.com.

What happens if I can’t prove that I am eligible during membership enrollment?

If you cannot provide acceptable proof of eligibility, we will be unable to approve you for Walmart+ Student. You are of course eligible for our standard Walmart+ membership, which you can sign up for at walmart.com/plus.

How long will my verification last?

Your verified status will be valid for one year from the start date of your paid Walmart+ Student membership. Walmart+ will verify your eligibility for the program on an annual basis in an offline process without any customer input for most cases.

What happens if my annual re-verification fails?

If your annual re-verification fails, you will no longer be eligible for the Walmart+ Student program. Your plan will auto-renew for $12.95/month or $98/year plus applicable taxes until you cancel the membership. You will be notified via email about the changes to your membership plan.

How can an existing member switch their membership to a discounted membership?

If you are an existing member and want to switch to a Walmart+ Student plan, visit www.walmart.com/plus/student. We will then guide you through steps to verify your eligibility and switch plans. Upon selecting a new discounted plan, your old plan will be canceled, and you will be refunded for the unused portion of that plan. Your new discounted plan will start immediately. If we are unable to issue the refund to the original form of payment, you will receive a Walmart gift card for that amount.

Who can I reach out to for more questions?

You can call our help center at 1-888-537-5503.

Walmart+ Travel

Walmart+ members will get Walmart Cash when they book a trip through Walmart+ Travel powered by Expedia.

Members earn:

  • 2% in Walmart Cash on airfare
  • 10% in Walmart Cash on everything else (Hotel reservations, car rentals, and activities.)

How Walmart+ Travel Works

  • You must book travel through Walmart+ Travel. Non-members can book travel, but they won’t get Walmart Cash.
  • Walmart Cash from a trip appears as pending in your ledger until you complete your trip. Pending Walmart Cash will be available to spend 30-days after completing the trip.
  • If the trip includes a post-paid car rental, the Walmart Cash will auto-apply to your account 90 days after travel is complete.
  • You can see your Walmart Cash balance by going to My Account.
Reservations

If you need help with your reservations, you can contact Expedia customer service

  • Toll free: (800)-323-3897
  • International Toll: (312)-279-7755 

Common Questions

Where can I find my booking(s)?

Check your email inbox for a confirmation from Expedia. You can also find your booking(s) by selecting Trips on WalmartPlusTravel.com. You must go to your trip on Expedia.com if you want to make changes.

How do you calculate my Walmart Cash when I book vacation packages?

If you’re booking a combination of air travel and lodgings, you get 2% Walmart Cash for the air travel and 10% Walmart Cash on everything else.

What happens to my Walmart Cash if I cancel or change my reservation(s)?

We’ll adjust the pending balance of Walmart Cash you’ll get with each booking within 24-48 hours. Pending Walmart Cash will be available to spend 30-days after completing your trip.

Will I get Walmart Cash through Walmart+ Travel if I cancel my membership?

If you booked your trip before you canceled your membership, you’ll still get the Walmart Cash for that booking 30 days after you’ve completed that trip.

You must be a Walmart+ member when booking to get Walmart Cash. You can’t get Walmart Cash for past trips.

Does my Walmart Cash expire?

No, your Walmart Cash never expires.

Can I redeem my Walmart Cash on future bookings through Walmart+ Travel?

No, you can only use your Walmart Cash for future Walmart purchases or cash back. See Walmart Cash FAQs for restrictions on redeeming Walmart Cash.

When will I see the Walmart Cash I received in my account?

You’ll see your Walmart Cash as “pending” in your account until your travel is complete. The final amount of Walmart Cash you earned will be reflected in your account 30 days after the completion of your travel for most bookings. For pay later car rentals, the Walmart Cash will be reflected in your account 90 days after completion of your booking. 

Can I combine the Walmart Cash I get through travel with my other Walmart Cash?

Yes, we put all the Walmart Cash you receive into one balance. You can use it for future purchases in Walmart stores or Walmart.com. You can also redeem it for cash back at any Walmart store. See Walmart Cash FAQs for questions on Walmart Cash restrictions.

Do I earn loyalty points for Expedia or other loyalty sites?

No, Walmart+ Travel purchases are not eligible for points from other loyalty programs.

Who do I contact if I have any questions, changes, or issues with my trip or bookings?

You can contact Expedia customer service at 1-800-323-3897 (toll free) or 312-279-7755 (international toll) for help with your reservations. You can also contact the airline directly for specific questions about your flight. Visit the Walmart Help Center for questions about your Walmart Cash balance.

Your Order

Alcohol Orders

You can include alcohol in your delivery and/or pickup order if state or local laws allow it.

You’ll find alcohol items under the Grocery department in the Alcohol category.

Reasons You Won’t Get Your Alcohol Order

  • You’re under 21 years of age.
  • You can’t provide a valid government-issued photo identification.
    • For delivery orders, the entire order will be returned to the store if you can’t show a valid identification.
    • For pickup orders, the alcohol will be removed from your order if you can’t show a valid identification.
      • You will not be charged for the removed alcohol.
  • You appear intoxicated.
  • You appear to be giving alcohol to someone under 21.

Alcohol Sales Hours Vary 

Some states and local laws may prevent the sale of alcohol during certain business hours.

  • Orders with alcohol will only be delivered during alcohol sales hours. 
  • If you try to pick up your alcohol order outside the legal hours to sell alcohol, you’ll have to wait until the legal hours or the alcohol will be removed from your order. 

ID Requirements

You’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued photo identification for all orders with alcohol.

  • Pickup orders:
    • The curbside associate will ask for your photo identification. 
    • They’ll enter your birthday into their device to complete age verification.  
  • Delivery orders:
    • The delivery driver will ask for your photo identification. 
    • They’ll use their delivery driver app to scan your identification.
  • InHome orders:
    • The InHome associate will ask for your photo identification. 
    • They’ll use their device to scan your identification. 

Alcohol Delivery at Military Bases

Walmart+ Inhome now offers alcohol delivery to select military bases where permitted by local laws and base guidelines. Because alcohol is an age-restricted item, customers must show a valid government-issued ID, Driver License, State ID, or Military ID at the time of delivery. A signature is also required before the order can be completed. For security and privacy, Associates will manually enter ID details into the InHome Associate App and will not scan or take photos of IDs.

Canceled Orders

Sometimes we cancel orders to save you time and money. If we cancel your order, we won’t charge you.

You may see a temporary hold on your credit or debit card account associated with a canceled order. Your bank may have placed a temporary hold on that amount when your order was placed and will remove the temporary hold based on their policies and procedures. We cannot remove the temporary hold. Please contact your bank with any questions regarding any temporary hold. It is sometimes called an authorization hold and shows as pending in your account. Refunds to a credit or debit card can take up to 7 business days.

We may have canceled your order because:

  • it exceeded our rules for quantity limits and bulk purchases.
  • an item is out of stock.
  • our webpage had price and other listing errors.
  • our Credit and Fraud Avoidance department needs more information.
  • a carrier or shipping method was unavailable.
  • you were using an older browser or app version that‘s no longer supported by Walmart.

You’ll get an email if we canceled any part of your order, or if we need more information to process your order.

Chat With Your Shopper

The Chat with Shopper feature is available for Walmart.com delivery orders at select stores. You’ll get a notification when your order has live shopping available.

To access the chat:

  1. Select View Order
  2. Select Chat with Shopper

Use chat with your shopper to:

  • Communicate in real time.
    • The shopper can share product images in real time.
      • You can view the images during the chat but can’t download them.
  • Approve or decline substitutions.
  • Track your order.

Visit Track order & chat with your shopper to learn more.

Delayed Orders

We do our best to keep up with the growing demand for popular items. Sometimes, pre-transit order delays still happen. If an order is delayed, we’ll send order update emails in real-time.

Pickup Delays

Our goal is to get your order to you as quickly as possible. Contact customer care after you’ve:

  • waited for the Ready for Pickup email.
  • called the phone number on the pickup sign to check in for your Walmart order.

If you’re experiencing an extended delay, contact customer care using the Chat with us button.

Delivery Delays

If there’s a delay in your scheduled delivery, you may get a text message or push notification inviting you to change your delivery order to a pickup order. You can choose a pickup time slot within the next 24 hours. If you pick up your order, we’ll refund your delivery fees and tip.

Select the Chat with us button to contact customer care if you haven’t received your order after the delivery window has passed.

Delivery Returned to Store

If your driver returns your delivery to store, an associate will contact you to reschedule your delivery. If we can’t reschedule it, we’ll cancel your delivery order and won’t charge you for it.

Drivers return orders when:

  • they can’t find your address.
  • no safe location is found.
  • you aren’t reachable.
  • you canceled your order.
  • to comply with food safety rules.

Shipping and Carrier Delays

The order tracker displays new estimated delivery dates.

Select the Chat with us button if:

  • your tracking information hasn’t updated for two business days.
  • it’s two business days after your estimated delivery date.

Your order might be delayed because of events in some areas. You can check for known shipping delays in your area using the links below.

  • To check FedEx for carrier delays, go to FedEx Service Alerts.
  • To check USPS for carrier delays, go to USPS Service alerts.
  • To check UPS for carrier delays, go to UPS Service Alerts.

If you have any other concerns about pickup, delivery, and shipping delays, contact customer care using the Chat with us button.

InHome Delivery Delays

If there’s a delay in your InHome delivery, you may get an email, text message, or push notification inviting you to update your InHome order with the following options:

  • Rescheduling your InHome delivery
  • Switching it to pickup
  • Canceling your InHome delivery

InHome Delivery Returned to Store

If your driver returns your delivery to store, an associate will contact you to reschedule your delivery. If we can’t reschedule it, we’ll cancel your delivery order and won’t charge you for it. 

To comply with food safety rules, drivers are required to return orders when: 

  • they can’t find your address. 
  • no safe location is found. 
  • you aren’t reachable. 
  • you canceled your order. 

 

 

Driver Feedback and Tips

When you get items delivered from the store to your home with Walmart delivery services, you can tip your driver and give feedback on your experience.

Keep in mind:

  • Tips are optional and 100% go to the driver.
  • You can choose to tip before or after placing your order or after delivery.
  • You’re free to edit your tip amount for up to three hours after delivery.
    • You can add an additional tip for your driver after three hours and up to 24 hours after your order is delivered.
  • You have up to 14 days to add a tip for your delivery driver if you didn’t tip when the order was placed.

To add a tip for items delivered from your local store:

  1. Log into your Walmart.com account.  
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Purchase History.
  4. Select the appropriate order.
  5. Select Add tip or Add extra tip.

If you don’t see the option to add a tip, your order is not eligible.

We’ll also send you a push notification from the app for you to give feedback and/or a tip after your delivery.

To leave feedback, select Give feedback.

Drone Delivery

Walmart now offers drone delivery to select customers and Walmart+ members in select markets.

Who can use it?

Drone deliveries depend on your exact address, the weather, and the drone vendor’s rules. Typically, you can use drone delivery if:

  • You are customer with an eligible address and basket.
  • You live within a set distance of a store that offers drone delivery.
  • Your order is 2-8 lbs depending on the drone vendor.

Drone delivery availability is generally based on a customer’s delivery address, local weather conditions, feasibility, and each drone delivery vendor’s terms of service. Deliveries take up to 30 minutes to arrive.

See The Walmart Site and App Experience article for more information on delivery fees. Walmart+ members pay zero fees on drone deliveries (limited time).

How to Place a Drone Delivery Order

You can order drone delivery in three ways:

  • From your browser, go to www.walmart.com/shop/drone. If your address and basket are is eligible, you will be able to add items to your cart and place an order.
  • From the app and web, if your address and basket are is eligible, you can click the ‘Let’s fly!’ button link to shop “drone ready picks” in the global intent center where you select pick up, delivery, or ship from store.
  • If you click ‘Delivery’ and your address is eligible, you can click ‘Drone’ to reserve your order spot.
  • At Checkout, if your address and basket are eligible, you will be offered drone delivery as an option.

Delivery of Your Order

A drone will deliver your order right to your driveway or yard. After the drone picks up your order from the store, you’ll get a notification letting you know the drone is on the way.

You can:

  • Track your drone delivery order in real time delivery.
  • Cancel your drone delivery any time before the drone is out for delivery.

You must agree to keep your delivery area clear of people and pets for the drone to safely deliver your order.

Deliveries will be made to a predetermined location of your home:

  • Front yard
  • Backyard
  • Driveway

Drones will use a cable to gently lower the package to that predetermined location.

Delayed or Canceled Pickup Orders

If there’s a delay in your drone delivery, you may get a text message or push notification inviting you to cancel or change to a pickup order. If you pick up your order, we’ll refund your delivery fees, if applicable.

Returns

For returns, you can use the Walmart app to process your return. You will be provided with options to complete the return. Alternatively, you can come to the store. For returns from vendor operated sites, you can use the vendor app to process the return.

  • Wing Operated Sites: For failed deliveries and post-delivery returns, Wing will issue a refund or promotional codes.
  • Zipline Operated Sites: For Zipline, the store manager has discretion for store returns. Zipline can issue a refund.

Additional Terms

You can learn more about terms that apply to drone deliveries by reviewing our Drone Delivery Terms of Use.

Edit or Cancel an Order

You can edit or request cancellation for most Pickup, Delivery, and Shipping orders before they are processed. Go to Purchase history to view available options for your order. 

Edit Items in an Order

Pickup and Delivery orders:

For store-fulfilled items, customers can make changes until the order cutoff time. The cutoff is based on the scheduled Pickup or Delivery time and is shown in a banner in the customer’s Purchase History. Cutoff times vary by order type and location. 

For eligible Pickup and Delivery orders, customers may be able to: 

  • Add or remove items
  • Increase or decrease quantities
  • Allow or disallow substitutions
  • Reschedule their Pickup or Delivery time (one time only) 

If a customer misses their scheduled Pickup time, they can still pick up their order before the store closes. 

To edit an item on your order for items sold by Walmart:
  1. Log into your Walmart.com account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Purchase history.
  4. Select Edit items. 

For items sold by Walmart, shipping, delivery, or Pickup fees may apply depending on your order total and membership status. If you edit your order, your total may change, which could affect any applicable fees. For more information about fees, benefits, and Walmart+ membership, see our Walmart+ Benefits - Free Shipping and Free Delivery from Your Store - Walmart.com

Make other changes to your order

While your order for items sold by Walmart is being prepared, you can:   

  • Reschedule your timeslot
  • Choose a different store location
  • Edit your shipping address
  • Change your payment method 

To reschedule an order:  

  1. Log into your Walmart.com account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Purchase history.
  4. Find the order and select View details.
  5. Select Reschedule.   
    • You can only reschedule an order once. 
Changing Delivery Address

Only you can change your delivery address from your purchase history. Walmart Customer Care cannot change it for you. 

You can change the delivery address for some order types: 

  • Shiipped orders (Walmart fulfilled and Marketplace)
  • Delivery orders (scheduled and unscheduled) 

You can only change the address once. You must make the change before: 

  • The order ships for shipped orders
  • The store assigns a driver for Express Delivery orders
  • The order is in the driver’s car for delivery orders 

 

  • You cannot change the delivery address for these order types:

    • The order ships for shipped orders
    • Orders not paid with a credit card
    • Orders with multiple payment types
    • PetRx orders
    • Automotive Care Center (ACC) orders
    • Cake orders
    • Photo orders
    • InHome delivery

     

How to Edit the Address ?
  1. Select Edit next to the delivery address on the Order Details page.
  2. Select a delivery address.
  3. Enter the CVV from the card used to pay for the order.
  4. Review and confirm the delivery date and fees. 

You will get a confirmation email after the address is updated. 

Scheduled Delivery Delays

If there’s a delay in your scheduled delivery, you might get a text message or push notification giving you the option to change your delivery order to a store pickup. You can choose a time slot within the next 24 hours from when the notification was received. If you choose to pick up your order, we’ll refund the delivery fee and tip amount that was on your order. 

Cancel your order

To request an order cancellation:

  1. Log into your Walmart.com account.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Purchase history.
  4. Find the order you want to cancel.
  5. Scroll to the bottom and select Request Cancellation, if available.
Edit Options Unavailable

You might not have options to edit or cancel your order because:

  • Your order is on its way to you.
  • You ordered items from a Marketplace seller or chose Shipping
    • We are unable to cancel your Marketplace order.

If you can’t edit or cancel your order, you can return most items. For more information, review the Walmart Return Policy, the Marketplace return policy, or Start a Return Online once you’ve received the item.

Guided Delivery Instructions

Guided delivery helps you be in control of your delivery. With this feature you can tell us where you’d like your order dropped off.

To ensure a more successful delivery make sure your address has the correct USPS format when you enter it. You can select the address from the drop-down menu when it appears. This helps our drivers deliver your order right where you need it.

To learn more about the USPS format visit: What is the Format and Sequence of Information for the Recipient’s Address?

You can also add guided delivery instructions to your order:

  1. Select Review order at checkout.
  2. Select Add delivery instructions.
  3. You can provide us the following information:
    • Property type (E.g., house, apartment, business, other)
    • Gate or call box code
    • Delivery notes
  4. Select Save.
  5. Select Leave at my door or I’ll sign for my order.

How to Update Your Address Rooftop Pin

Your rooftop pin allows us to provide you with better delivery.

Google Maps

  1. Open your web browser and go to Google Maps. 
    • 0
  2. Search for your street address.
    • If the pin isn’t over your house complete steps 3-9
  3. Select Suggest an edit on… from the box on the left side of the screen.

Missing Items

Multiple Item Orders

Your items may be shipped from different warehouses.

  • Your items may arrive separately.
  • Each package will have its own tracking number.
  • Visit your Purchase History to see if your order was split into multiple packages.
  • If you’ve received all packages from your order and you’re still missing items, select the Chat with us button.

Deliveries from Stores

Check the receipt in your email to see if the item was out of stock or substituted. If we charged you for the item but it’s missing from your delivery, select the Chat with us button.

If your entire order is missing, check the delivery confirmation photo. Do you recognize the doorway in the image?

  • If it’s the wrong house, check your address in Google Maps to see if the rooftop pin is correct.

If you’re still not able to find the missing package, select the Chat with us button.

Order Not Received

Follow the steps below if you didn’t receive your items but got a delivery notification.

Shipping Orders

If your Purchase History shows your package has arrived, but you can’t find it:

  1. Look around the delivery location.
  2. Check the delivery confirmation.
  3. Ask your household and neighbors.
  4. Review the address saved in your Walmart.com account. Make sure it doesn’t have any spelling errors or numerical mistakes.
  5. Wait two business days to see if it arrives. It’s rare, but sometimes carriers may mark packages as delivered before they arrive.

If you still haven’t received it after two business days, select the Chat with us button.

Delivery Orders

If you have a delivery and your Purchase History shows your package was delivered, but you can’t find it:

  1. Check the delivery confirmation photo. Do you recognize the doorway in the image?
    • If it is the wrong house, check your address in Google Maps to see if the rooftop pin is correct.
  2. Select the Chat with us button.
  3. Request a refund by starting a return.

Use the optional delivery instructions to verify your information before checking out. You can add the following information:  

  • Property type
  • Gate or call box code
  • Delivery notes
    • Do any of the items require a signature?
    • Is it a business address with specific hours of operation?
  • Dropoff location

Pickup and Delivery

You can take advantage of Walmart’s Everyday Low Prices and save time on your shopping with our pickup and delivery service.

Simply place an order online, choose a timeslot, and an associate will gather your items and place them in bags. When your order is ready, we’ll send a Ready for Pickup email if you’ve chosen to pick up from your local store or your order can be delivered right to your door.

Pickup Orders

To check-in online or the app:

  1. Open the app or email.
    • You can also use the link in your text message.
  2. Select I’m on my way.
  3. Once you’ve checked in, head to the store and park in one of the Curbside Pickup parking spots.
  4. When you arrive, select I’ve parked.
  5. Enter the spot number and color of the vehicle.
  6. A Walmart associate will bring your order to you.

If you’re having issues checking in from the Walmart app, you can use the store check-in steps.

To check-in at the store:

  1. Use one of the Curbside Pickup parking spots.
  2. Call the phone number on the parking sign or in your confirmation email.
  3. A Walmart associate will bring your order to you.

Delayed or Canceled Pickup Orders

Our goal is to get your order to you as quickly as possible.

Before you contact customer care for a delayed or cancel order, be sure to:

  1. Wait for the Ready for Pickup notification.
  2. Use our check-in option before you leave for the store and when you arrive.

Call the store if you’ve received the notification and checked in before you arrived and are still experiencing a delay. You’ll find the phone number in our app or when you arrive at the pickup location.

Select the Chat with us button for any other concerns about wait times.

Delivery Orders

To see if your address qualifies for delivery:

  1. Sign into your account or create an account.
  2. Select How do you want your items?
  3. Select Delivery.
    • If delivery isn’t available, you’ll see one of two notifications:
      • Delivery isn’t available from your store. We can deliver your order from a nearby store.
      • Delivery is not available for this address.
  4. Choose a timeslot.
  5. An associate will gather your items and place them in bags.

When your order is ready, we’ll send a Ready for Pickup email if you’ve chosen to pick up from your local store or your order can be delivered right to your door.

Delivery of Your Order

A local, third-party delivery driver will bring your order right to your door. After the driver picks up your order, you’ll get a notification letting you know the driver is on their way. In some cases, the delivery can take up to two hours to get to you.

If you select, I’ll sign for my order, this will require you to provide a pin or signature when the driver delivers your order. A pin may also be required for certain orders or high value items. You’ll be notified at checkout if this is required.

  • Once the order is out for delivery, the four-digit passcode will show under the tracking status bar under Order Details. You can also view the pin when selecting Track Order.
  • If your order is being delivered to someone else, you’ll need to provide the recipient with the pin for a successful delivery.

If you’re satisfied with your delivery experience, you can leave feedback and add a tip for your driver.

Delayed or Canceled Delivery Orders

If there’s a delay in your InHome delivery, you may get an email, text message, or push notification inviting you to update your InHome order with the following options:

  • Rescheduling your InHome delivery
  • Switching it to pickup
  • Canceling your InHome delivery

if your InHome order gets canceled, you won’t be charged for the order.

Pickup and Delivery Changes and Exceptions

How do I change my Pickup time?

You can change your store pick up time if the order is still in process, and it is before the cutoff time. The cutoff time will appear as a banner at the top of your purchase history. Before the cutoff time, you can:

  • Add or remove items.
  • Increase or decrease quantities.
  • Allow or disallow substitutions.
  • Reschedule the time slot (only once).

How do I change my order from Delivery to Pickup or, Pickup to Delivery?

You can’t change the fulfillment type after you place your order and checkout. The only exception is if you get a text message about a delayed scheduled delivery that gives this option.

If you have checked out and then want to change from Pickup to Delivery, or from Delivery to Pickup, you must request to cancel and then place a new order.

What if I am late to my scheduled Pickup?

  • If you are late to your scheduled Pickup, and the Pickup window is prior to 8 p.m., you can still check in by 8 p.m. local time on the Pickup date.
  • If you are late to check in for your Pickup order and it is after 8 p.m., you should reschedule or cancel and reorder.
  • Frozen and perishable items such as produce are stored at the correct temperature until you pick up your order.
  • If you don’t pick up the order by the end of the day, the store cancels your order the next day. This releases the authorization hold on your payment method. Refunds to a credit or debit card can take up to 7 business days.
  • You can reschedule your timeslot, if needed.
    • Select the reschedule button on the Order Details page.

Can someone else pick up my order?

If you can’t pick up your order, you can add an alternate Pickup person.

During checkout:

  1. Go to the Review Your Order screen. 
    • This is the last page before completing your order. 
  2. Select Checkout all items.
  3. Select Edit next to Pickup person. 
  4. Add the Pickup person’s name and email address.
  5. Select Save.

To change the Pickup person after you’ve placed your order:

  1. Go to your Walmart Account.
  2. Select Purchase History.
  3. Navigate to and select the order you want to update.
  4. Select Edit next to Pickup person.
  5. Add the Pickup person’s name and email address.
  6. Select Save.

Can I change the Pickup store location or Delivery address?

You may be able to change your Delivery address or Pickup location for a brief time after you place your order.

  • You will have up to three hours before the Delivery/Pickup window to update the order (express orders excluded).
    • You can only change once per order.
  • If you try to change to an address outside of the Delivery/Pickup area, you will see this message:
    • Sorry – your order can’t be delivered to that address. Please try a different address.
  • The option to change the Delivery/Pickup address will also appear when you try to cancel an order.

To change the Delivery/Pickup address:

  1. Go to your Walmart account.
  2. Select Order History.
  3. Navigate to the order you want to update.
  4. Select Edit beside the store location.
  5. Select the store where you want to pick up your items.
  6. Select Save.
  7. Select a date and time on the Reserve a time page.
  8. Select Save.
  9. Enter the last three digits of your card number.
    • Note: The order total may change when you switch stores due to taxes and fees. 
  10. Select Confirm.

Reorder

We’ve made it easy for you to reorder your items you’ve previously bought from your scheduled deliveries or in-store.

To Reorder All Items from a Past Order:On Walmart.com

  1. Select Account.
  2. Select Purchase History.
  3. Scroll to the order you want to duplicate.
  4. Select View Details.
  5. Select Reorder all.
  6. Use the - or + quantity buttons to add or remove items from your order.

In Walmart App

  1. Select Purchase History.
  2. Scroll to the order you want to duplicate.
  3. Select View Delivery Details.
  4. Select Reorder all.
  5. Use the - or + quantity buttons to add or remove items from your order.
  6. Checkout.

To Reorder Recently Ordered on Items from Walmart.com or the Walmart App:

  1. Select My Items.
  2. Select Reorder.
  3. Select +Add next to recently ordered items.
  4. You can reorder from these tabs on the My Items page: Reorder, Lists, or Registries.
  5. Checkout.

You can also reorder from My Items in your Walmart account.

Sparky

What is Sparky?

Sparky is an AI-powered assistant that helps you find your favorite items, synthesize reviews, and make informed purchase with confidence. For example, ask Sparky to help you find the best laptop for an art student or the best birthday gift for a two-year-old.

How does Sparky work?

Sparky uses advanced AI models to interact with you conversationally, understand your shopping needs, suggest relevant products, answer questions, and provide recommendations based on your preferences.

Sparky is designed to help you shop with Walmart. Please do not rely on Sparky for medical, legal, or financial advice.

Where can I access Sparky?

Soon, you will be able to access Sparky by clicking on the smiley face in the middle of the bottom navigation bar when using the Walmart app. Open Sparky, and ask Sparky a question!

Sparky is only accessible in the Walmart app for US customers. You must be signed into the app to start a conversation with Sparky. 

Is Sparky utilizing my data?

Sparky only leverages limited customer data to provide you with the best recommendations. Sparky adheres to the data collection and use restrictions within the Walmart Privacy Policy found here.

How do I give feedback about the assistant?

While Sparky is designed to be as accurate as possible, mistakes can happen. And we always love to hear from our customers! Please provide feedback by giving the conversation a thumbs up or thumbs down once completed, or leaving additional feedback when prompted by Sparky. Need more assistance? Contact the Help Center.

Substitutions for Store Pickup and Delivery Items

If an item you ordered is out of stock, we’ll offer a similar item as a substitution. You have the choice to accept, decline, or return substituted items. We’ll charge you the price of any substituted item(s). You’ll notice a temporary authorization hold. Refunds to a credit or debit card can take up to 7 business days. This is the amount we authorize to cover weighted items, replacements, and any bag fees in your state.

Choosing Substitutions

If your ordered item isn’t available, we’ll send an email and offer a similar item. There is a limited amount of time to respond. The email will give you time to accept or refuse the substitution(s).

If you don’t accept or decline the item offered, we’ll substitute it. If you’re unhappy with the substitution, you can start a return from Purchase History on the Walmart app or Walmart.com.

Selecting Substitutions During Checkout

Before placing your order, you can choose the items that you don’t want substituted. You can select the items you prefer as a substitution. If an item on your order is out of stock and you picked a substitution, we’ll replace it with the one you chose. If the item isn’t in stock and you let us know you don’t want us to substitute it, we’ll remove it from your order.

Substitutions on SNAP/EBT orders

For orders placed with SNAP/EBT, you can choose substitutions and we’ll charge you the price of the item based on the price of the item and the payment method. If you don’t select a backup method of payment for the order but allow for substitutions:

  • We’ll substitute with an item that is the same or lower priced as the original item.
    • If an alternate item is not available, the original item will be canceled, and we’ll refund your SNAP/EBT card.

If you select a backup method of payment for the order and we must substitute with an item of higher price:

  • Any difference in cost for your substitution will be charged to the alternate payment method.
    • Amounts charged to non-SNAP/EBT payment methods are subject to sales tax.

Reject Substitutions During Pickup

If you don’t want the substitution, simply let the associate at the store know, and they’ll remove it from your order.

Reject Substitutions During Delivery

Delivery drivers can’t remove the item from your order and return it to the store. You’ll need to start a return from your Purchase History on the Walmart app or Walmart.com.

Track Your Order

You can track your order from your shipping confirmation email or by visiting Walmart.com.

When your package ships, we’ll send you an email with the tracking link. You can use the link at any time to check its progress.

Track your order on Walmart.com:

  1. Log into your Walmart.com account. 
  2. On Walmart.com, select Account. 
  3. Select Purchase history.
  4. Select Track Shipment.

To track your order in the Walmart app:

  1. Open the Walmart app.
  2. Select Account.
  3. Select Purchase history.
  4. Scroll to the order you want to track and select Track Shipment.

Undeliverable Order Options

Sometimes a driver can’t deliver an order and it has to be returned to the store. At some stores, when this happens you’ll have the chance to change your Delivery order to a Pickup order in the Walmart app. If this is available, you’ll get an email and a message in your Walmart.com account when the driver updates your order status.

Here’s how the update to your delivery works:

  1. The driver updates the order status and returns the order to the store.
  2. The store sends an email and an app notification with your available options:
    • Reschedule your order.
    • Convert your order to Pickup:
      • You can choose a timeslot within 24 hours.
    • Cancel your order.

If your order is converted to Pickup, the store will send an email and an app notification when your order is ready for Pickup. When your order is ready you’ll be able to check-in through the app.
